raw.title: Senior Data Scientist
raw.excerpt: Company Overview At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents.
raw.description:
Company Overview

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

Be part of a team that makes a real difference.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement machine learning models and algorithms to address business problems related to medical claims
  • Conduct exploratory data analysis to identify patterns, trends, and insights
  • Clean, preprocess, and transform large, complex datasets to ensure data quality
  • Create compelling data visualizations and dashboards to communicate findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy models into production environments
  • Monitor model performance and implement improvements as needed
  • Mentor junior data scientists and contribute to best practices documentation
  • Stay current with emerging techniques and technologies in data science and machine learning
  • Present findings and recommendations to leadership and business stakeholders

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, or related quantitative field
  • 3+ years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, or related analytical role
  • Strong programming skills in Python or R, and proficiency with data manipulation libraries (pandas, numpy, dplyr)
  • Experience building and deploying machine learning models using frameworks such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch
  • Solid understanding of statistical methods, experimental design, and hypothesis testing
  • Proficiency with SQL and experience working with relational databases
  • Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts to non-technical audiences

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with cloud computing platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Experience with Snowflake cloud data platform, including:
    • Writing optimized SQL queries for Snowflake's architecture
    • Leveraging Snowflake's unique features like Time Travel, Zero-Copy Cloning, and Secure Data Sharing
    • Working with Snowflake's semi-structured data capabilities (VARIANT, ARRAY, OBJECT types)
    • Using Snowflake's integration with Python via connectors and Snowpark
    • Experience with Snowflake's performance optimization techniques
  • Knowledge of big data technologies (Spark, Hadoop)
  • Experience with version control systems (Git) and collaborative development workflows
  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience with NLP, computer vision, or time series analysis
  • Contributions to open-source projects or research publications

Required Technical Skills

  • Programming: Python, SQL, R (preferred)
  • Cloud Data Warehousing: Snowflake SQL, Snowflake data objects and architecture
  • Machine Learning: Classification, regression, clustering, dimensionality reduction
  • Data Processing: ETL pipelines, data cleaning, feature engineering
  • Statistics: Hypothesis testing, experimental design, A/B testing
  • Tools: Jupyter, Git, Docker (preferred)
  • Visualization: Matplotlib, Seaborn, ggplot2, Tableau, PowerBI

Soft Skills

  • Problem-solving and analytical thinking
  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • Collaboration and teamwork
  • Attention to detail
  • Time management and prioritization
  • Continuous learning mindset

Benefits

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full-time or part-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $110,000 - $135,000 annually, and will be based on a number of additional factors including skills, experience, and education.

The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and underrepresented minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Citizenship / Access Requirements: U.S. citizenship is required. Personnel must satisfy all VA suitability, background-investigation, PIV, privacy, information-security, and system-access requirements.

Security Requirements: No classified clearance is specified. Favorable VA screening, National Agency Check initiation, PIV eligibility, and applicable ADP-sensitive access requirements apply.

Estimated Compensation: $35.21 per hour.

Working Hours: Work must be staffed within the Monday-through-Friday service window of 6:00 AM–6:00 PM local facility time. Individual schedules will be assigned based on operational needs; off-hours work requires prior approval.

Work Arrangement: Remote work is authorized through an approved VA VPN. Work is normally performed at the contractor facility or another approved location within a U.S. jurisdiction unless otherwise agreed.

Period of Performance: November 1, 2026 through October 31, 2028, including one option year, with a potential extension of services of up to six months.

Summary of Services

The Inpatient Facility Coder will review and code inpatient records, discharges, and related professional and surgical services for the VA Northeast Ohio Healthcare System. The role assigns and validates diagnosis and procedure codes, abstracts required data, issues provider queries, and meets VA accuracy, productivity, and timeliness standards.

Mandatory Qualifications

U.S. citizenship and fluency in spoken and written English.

Current acceptable AHIMA or AAPC credential, such as RHIT, RHIA, CCS, CCS-P, CPC, COC, or CIC, maintained throughout performance.

At least two years of continuous professional coding experience in a comparable VA Level 1A healthcare environment or equivalent complex healthcare setting.

Proficiency with ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT, HCPCS, E/M coding, modifiers, and compliant provider queries as applicable to assigned work.

Proficiency with Oracle Health coding workflows; familiarity with Solventum CRS, VistA, CPRS, and VIRR is preferred or required for assigned duties.

Ability to meet VA productivity, timeliness, data-security, privacy, quality, and coding-accuracy requirements.

Duties and Responsibilities

Review inpatient records and assign ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS codes with appropriate sequencing.

Code related professional, surgical, and ancillary services using CPT, HCPCS, and E/M requirements as applicable.

Abstract diagnoses, procedures, present-on-admission indicators, and other required data elements.

Submit compliant provider queries when documentation is incomplete, conflicting, or insufficient.

Correct coding edits, rejections, audit findings, and identified documentation issues.

Meet contract standards for coding accuracy, productivity, timeliness, and data integrity.

Use Oracle Health, Solventum CRS, CPRS, VistA, VIRR, and other authorized VA systems as required.

Protect patient information and comply with HIPAA, the Privacy Act, VA security requirements, and applicable coding standards.

Required Candidate Submission Documents

Current resume documenting qualifying education, credentials, systems proficiency, and at least two years of relevant coding experience.

Copy of a current qualifying AHIMA or AAPC certification.

About Us

Fidelity Partners is an Inc. 5000 USA company that provides medical, technical, logistical, and administrative services to the federal government and commercial clients across the country. Fidelity offers competitive salaries and benefits packages.

Qualified applicants are encouraged to learn more about us at www.fidelitypartners.org, call us at (210) 822-4005, or visit our careers page to join our team.

We’ve been around since 2006 and in that time frame, we have successfully completed 400+ projects and have become a partner of choice for EA, Sony, Disney, Rovio, Ubisoft, and many other companies.

Our #ilogos_team unites professionals that love, live and breathe games we dare say. This is a place where you’ll find freedom of action and where bureaucracy and micromanagement are unheard of. Now we are growing rapidly and looking for professionals to join the team.

  • Make your personal contribution to the games millions of people are playing;

  • Develop yourself professionally in an atmosphere of trust and support;

  • Work remotely from anywhere in the world on your own schedule;

  • Get your support from teammates and the company.

Growth Opportunity

The initial focus of this role is art leadership for the mobile shooter project.

Following a successful collaboration on the project, there may be an opportunity to gradually expand the role and take on part of the company-level art responsibilities, including presales, hiring and evaluation of artists, team development, and supporting the overall art direction and processes across the company.

We are looking for an experienced Art Lead to define and drive the visual direction of a mobile shooter project and oversee the full art production cycle.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can combine strong artistic judgment with effective team management — setting the visual bar, making independent creative decisions, and ensuring consistent quality throughout production.

What we’re looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience in game art, including experience as an Art Lead, Lead Artist, Art Director, or in a comparable leadership role

  • Experience working on mobile shooter games

  • Strong artistic background and ability to make independent visual and creative decisions

  • Strong understanding of the full game art pipeline, from concept to final implementation

  • Ability to assess quality across 2D, 3D, animation, UI, VFX, and related disciplines

  • Strong experience with stylized 3D

  • Experience leading multidisciplinary art teams and conducting constructive art reviews

  • Solid understanding of real-time graphics, optimization, and technical constraints

  • Experience with task scoping, estimation, workload planning, and production coordination

  • Strong communication skills and ability to clearly present and defend artistic decisions

  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional game development teams

Nice to have:

  • Experience in outsourcing or service-based game development

  • Hands-on experience with Unity and/or Unreal Engine

  • Familiarity with Jira, Trello, Figma, or similar production tools

What the role is about:

  • Define and develop the project’s visual direction, principles, and production guidelines

  • Create and maintain the Art Bible

  • Lead and coordinate specialists across Concept Art, 2D/3D, Animation, UI/UX, VFX, and Technical Art

  • Conduct art reviews, provide clear and actionable feedback, and maintain quality standards

  • Ensure visual consistency across characters, environments, weapons, VFX, UI, and other game content

  • Plan and break down art production tasks, estimate scope, and monitor timelines and workload

  • Collaborate closely with Game Design, Development, and Production teams

  • Identify artistic and production challenges early and find practical solutions

  • Balance visual quality, readability, technical limitations, and performance requirements

  • Mentor and support artists throughout production

Working conditions:

Our people are what we value the most at iLogos. We treat everyone with respect no matter where you are from or what you believe in. If you share our values which are Mastery, Maturity, Trust & Care, and Positive Mindset – we are a perfect match for each other! Join #ilogos_team and we guarantee you an opportunity for growth, support, and an atmosphere of trust and care that feels more like a family. And as well:

  • Work remotely from anywhere in the world;

  • Flexible working hours.

VISN 7 Health Information Management Services - Remote United States

This Position Is Contingent Upon Contract Award

Work Location

Department of Veterans Affairs

Veterans Integrated Service Network 7

Health Information Management Services

Remote within the United States

Supporting VISN 7 medical facilities

Fully remote coding and auditing services

Citizenship / Access Requirements: U.S. citizenship and English-language proficiency are required for VA system access. Personnel must satisfy all VA onboarding, identity-verification, training, and access requirements applicable to the position.

Security Requirements: No classified clearance is specified. The position is designated Low Risk and requires a favorable National Agency Check with Inquiries background investigation, annual VA privacy and security training, and all applicable system-access approvals.

Number of FTEs: Not specified. Staffing must be sufficient to meet assigned workload, quality, accuracy, and turnaround requirements.

Type of Employment: Full-Time or Part-Time, based on assigned workload.

Estimated Total Compensation: $38.00 per hour.

Working Hours: No fixed individual shift is specified. Remote schedules are assignment-dependent and must support required turnaround times and coverage aligned with Charleston VA Medical Center business hours.

Work Arrangement: Fully remote within the United States. All work must be physically performed in the United States using approved equipment, software, encoder tools, internet connectivity, reference resources, and a secure workspace.

Period of Performance: January 1, 2027 through December 31, 2031, if all four option periods are exercised.

Summary of Services

The Professional Fee Coding Auditor will independently review inpatient and outpatient professional-fee coding for VISN 7. The auditor will assess documentation sufficiency, diagnosis and procedure coding, modifiers, bundling, compliance, and financial impact; report findings; recommend improvements; and provide facility-specific education.

Mandatory Qualifications

Must be a U.S. citizen and be able to read, write, speak, and understand English.

Must satisfy the coder education and credential requirements, including an active RHIA, RHIT, CCS, CCS-P, CPC, or CPC-H credential.

Must have at least two years of coding experience in the applicable coding area.

Must have at least three years of consultant experience reviewing records in large tertiary-care hospitals and outpatient organizations with primary care and subspecialty services.

Must have at least three years of education and training experience and be able to present audit findings and facility-specific coding education.

Must be proficient with applicable ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT, HCPCS Level II, DRG, modifier, bundling, reimbursement, documentation, and compliance requirements.

Must successfully complete the Low Risk NACI background process and all required VA privacy, information-security, and mandatory training.

Must be able to work securely within the United States, maintain audit accuracy of at least 95 percent, and meet all reporting and turnaround requirements.

Duties and Responsibilities

Independently audit inpatient and outpatient professional-fee coding for accuracy, documentation support, compliance, and reimbursement impact.

Evaluate ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS Level II, evaluation and management, modifier, professional-component, and bundling assignments.

Verify provider information, scope of practice, billability, and documentation support for reported professional services.

Identify incorrect, missing, unbundled, upcoded, downcoded, unsupported, or otherwise noncompliant codes and modifiers.

Review relevant diagnoses and procedures in the electronic health record and approved audit tools using established sampling requirements.

Document each finding with clear supporting authority, financial impact, risk, and recommended corrective action.

Maintain audit accuracy of at least 95 percent and participate in calibration processes that support inter-reviewer consistency.

Contribute to audit work plans, collection tools, facility reports, consolidated reports, and required progress updates.

Review preliminary findings with HIMS leadership, the COR, management, and designated facility personnel.

Prepare or support final reports addressing accuracy, documentation issues, financial impact, process improvement, and educational needs.

Develop and deliver facility-specific coding education and support exit conferences when assigned.

Protect VA information and follow all privacy, information-security, encryption, and remote-work requirements.

Kindsight builds technology that helps fundraisers make a difference. For decades, Kindsight has supported the education, healthcare, and nonprofit sectors with fundraising tools and the largest charitable giving database on the market. And as the giving sector evolves, so does Kindsight. As the leader in fundraising intelligence, Kindsight leverages real-time data and AI to help thousands of organizations around the world identify, manage, and engage with donors - at any scale. With purpose-built CRMs that corral all of that donor information and campaign tracking into one place, donor prospect research tools that offer proactive insights and real-time donor intel, and generative AI that creates personalized, meaningful content drafts at scale, Kindsight’s product suite is truly changing the game for donor fundraising.

Position Summary:

The Senior Director, Solutions Engineering is responsible for leading Kindsight’s high-impact, customer-facing pre-sales function across technical solution design, bespoke product demonstrations, and complex enterprise proposal execution. This leader oversees Solutions Engineering and Proposal Management resources that support strategic sales and client expansion pursuits across nonprofit, education, and healthcare fundraising markets.

The Senior Director ensures Kindsight delivers compelling, accurate, tailored, and timely product demonstrations, RFP/RFI/RFQ responses, and technical engagements that clearly map platform capabilities to customer requirements and fundraising outcomes. The role requires close coordination with Sales, Product, Partnerships, Legal, Security, Finance, Services, Client Success, and external vendors to produce winning proposals and high-quality technical engagements.

This is a highly visible leadership role that directly influences enterprise deal success, win rates, partner ecosystem strength, and pre-sales operational excellence. The Senior Director must bring an established enterprise SaaS Solutions Engineering playbook and be able to apply it within a high-growth environment, balancing strategic deal support with operational rigor while ensuring team capacity is highly utilized, scalable, and aligned to growth priorities.

What You’ll Do:

Solutions Engineering Leadership

  • Lead and develop a high-performing Solutions Engineering team responsible for custom demonstrations, technical discovery, use-case mapping, and technical pre-sales engagements.

  • Ensure delivery of high-quality, scenario-based product demonstrations ranging from virtual overviews to multi-day on-site enterprise presentations.

  • Establish demo standards, playbooks, reusable assets, certification paths, and demonstration governance to improve consistency and scalability.

  • Drive deep product knowledge and domain fluency across nonprofit, healthcare, education, advancement, and fundraising workflows.

  • Translate complex fundraising and advancement requirements into compelling technical solutions, demonstrations, and value narratives.

  • Partner closely with Sales and Client Success leadership to align demo strategy with account priorities, expansion opportunities, and deal strategy.

  • Implement ongoing training and certification programs to continuously upskill Solutions Engineers and relevant internal team members.

  • Improve demo environment readiness, performance, repeatability, and quality control.

  • Establish measurable pre-sales performance indicators and continuously evaluate the impact of Solutions Engineering on win rates, deal velocity, technical validation, capacity, and revenue outcomes.

Proposal and RFP Program Leadership

  • Lead end-to-end execution of complex RFP, RFI, and RFQ responses across enterprise opportunities.

  • Manage Proposal Managers responsible for timeline control, task assignment, contributor coordination, and response assembly.

  • Establish proposal governance, content libraries, response frameworks, review workflows, and quality standards.

  • Coordinate cross-functional contributors across Product, Engineering, Security, Compliance, Finance, Legal, Services, Partnerships, and external vendors.

  • Ensure proposal responses are accurate, complete, compliant, and aligned with win strategy.

  • Oversee pricing matrices, technical documentation, security responses, compliance artifacts, and required supporting materials.

  • Drive continuous improvement in proposal turnaround time, response quality, content reuse, and partner response workflows.

  • Ensure proposals demonstrate a clear understanding of fundraising and advancement challenges and connect technical capabilities to measurable customer outcomes.

Cross-Functional and Partner Coordination

  • Serve as the central coordination leader for pre-sales technical and proposal activities.

  • Build strong working relationships across internal departments and partner vendors.

  • Improve partner contribution workflows for joint proposals and multi-vendor opportunities.

  • Support strategic partner alignment in opportunities involving Salesforce, integrated vendors, or broader ecosystem participation.

  • Collaborate with Product and Marketing on reusable technical content, market positioning, proof points, and field enablement.

  • Provide structured feedback to Product, Implementation, and leadership on recurring buyer requirements, technical gaps, competitive themes, and demo/proposal trends.

Operating Model and Capacity Management

  • Establish capacity planning, utilization reporting, prioritization rules, and engagement models for Solutions Engineering and Proposal resources.

  • Ensure strategic opportunities receive the right level of technical and proposal support.

  • Define intake standards, SLAs, review checkpoints, escalation paths, and quality gates for demos and proposal work.

  • Build scalable processes that reduce ad hoc work, improve quality, and increase field confidence.

  • Support hiring, onboarding, development, performance management, and succession planning across the SE and Proposal teams.

  • Travel up to 30% as required.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Technical Pre-Sales, Solution Consulting, Proposal Management, or related roles in enterprise SaaS.

  • Proven experience directly leading, developing, and scaling technical pre-sales, Solution Consulting, Solutions Engineering, or proposal teams.

  • Demonstrated experience building, implementing, or significantly evolving a repeatable Solutions Engineering operating model, including discovery, demonstrations, technical validation, capacity planning, prioritization, enablement, and performance measurement.

  • Proven success operating within a high-growth SaaS environment, with demonstrable results tied to pre-sales effectiveness, revenue growth, win rates, deal velocity, technical win rates, team productivity, utilization, or other measurable business outcomes.

  • Experience supporting fundraising, advancement, nonprofit, higher education, healthcare fundraising, or closely related mission-driven technology environments.

  • Strong understanding of fundraising and advancement workflows, including donor engagement, constituent management, campaign management, prospect development, giving, reporting, or related fundraising operations.

  • Experience responding to complex enterprise RFPs and managing proposal operations.

  • Strong organizational, process design, and program management capabilities.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to synthesize large volumes of technical and business information into clear narratives and structured responses.

  • Experience coordinating cross-functional contributors and external partners.

  • Strong executive presence and presentation leadership.

  • Familiarity with CRM platforms, integrations, data workflows, and enterprise SaaS architectures.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working directly with fundraising technology, advancement CRM, donor management, prospect research, or fundraising intelligence platforms.

  • Salesforce ecosystem familiarity strongly preferred.

  • Experience supporting enterprise nonprofit, healthcare, education, university advancement, foundation, or other mission-driven organizations.

  • Experience managing demo environments, technical enablement, proposal content libraries, and partner response workflows.

  • Experience scaling pre-sales operating models during periods of significant SaaS growth or organizational transformation.

  • Experience establishing measurable Solutions Engineering KPIs and demonstrating the function’s impact on revenue and enterprise sales performance.

Join our expanding Product Growth team! We’re actively recruiting a Senior Growth Marketing Manager as we continue to scale at M-KOPA. Most senior growth hires get one channel and one pod for years. This role is built differently: you’ll own two of our core growth pods in your first year, then land where you’ve had the most impact. It’s a fast track to pod leadership, not a support seat.

The Impact 💚

You’ll drive the conversion growth that turns customers into long-term, high-value ones, creating financial inclusion for Africa’s traditionally excluded. We’ve already helped over 10 million customers access over $2 billion in credit 🌍

The Opportunity

🏗️ Real ownership from day one. You'll be the one accountable for delivery in Repeat Phones, not shadowing or supporting someone else's plan.

🎒 Two growth motions, one year. You'll take on Digital Lending mid-way through, working directly with one of our strongest performers to understand cash loans end to end, then carry that pod solo for a defined stretch. Few people get this breadth this early.

🧭 A defined path, not indefinite floating. You'll build real expertise in our two conversion pods first, then move into Lifecycle in the second half of next year, reporting to the Lifecycle CRM Lead once you're there. The destination is set. What you bring to it is up to you. 🌍 Work inside a proven CLV engine. M-KOPA has helped more than 10 million customers access over $2 billion in credit. You'll be executing inside systems that already work, not guessing at what might.

What You'll Do

Phase 1: Repeat Phones. Take ownership of reactivation and upgrade campaigns in CleverTap, working closely with the Growth Lead there to understand what's driving the pod's numbers and where the next opportunity is. You'll be trusted to make real calls here, not just execute a checklist.

Phase 2: Cross into Digital Lending. Work directly with the Digital Lending lead, one of our top performers, to understand cash loan growth end to end before taking it on yourself.

Phase 3: Own Digital Lending. Carry primary responsibility for Digital Lending for a defined period, with the Repeat Phones lead available if you need a second opinion.

Phase 4: Move into Lifecycle. In the second half of next year, join the Lifecycle pod full-time, reporting to the Lifecycle CRM Lead. You'll bring a year of hands-on conversion experience into a pod that's still being built, real currency for shaping what Lifecycle does next. Throughout all phases, you will:

  • Build and run multi-channel campaigns (SMS, WhatsApp, push, in-app) in CleverTap against pod goals

  • Track funnel performance and flag drop-off points to the pod lead you're supporting

  • Run structured experiments (creative, audience, incentive, or timing) with clear hypotheses

  • Turn what works into documented playbooks the next person can pick up

  • Keep data quality and campaign tracking clean enough that leadership can trust the numbers

Key Metrics You'll Influence

Repeat Phones: Reactivation rate, upgrade conversion %, unit economics per sale

Digital Lending: Approval → disbursement rate, digital loan volume, approval quality

Campaign ROI and payback period across both

Your Environment

💼 Tech Stack: CleverTap (primary), Looker Channels: WhatsApp, SMS, push, in-app messaging

Markets: Kenya, Nigeria, Uganda, Ghana

What You Need

  • 5+ years in growth, performance, or lifecycle marketing, ideally in fintech, telco, or e-commerce, with real ownership over what a campaign or a pod achieved, not just involvement in it.

  • Judgment as much as skill. You can walk into a pod, understand what's working and why, and make calls on where to push, not just follow a brief.

  • Genuine appetite for pod leadership. This is a deliberate path toward owning a pod outright, and the breadth here is designed to get you there faster than a single-channel role would.

  • Hands-on fluency in CRM platforms like CleverTap, Braze, or similar, and comfortable reading a funnel or cohort without translation.

  • Energized, not unsettled, by ambiguity. You'll work across two pods and land in a third decision point by mid-year. If that sounds like an opportunity rather than a risk, you'll thrive here.

  • Strong enough presence to build trust quickly with senior leads across two different pods.

Location & Benefits

  • 🌍 Fully remote role within UTC -1 to UTC +3 time zones

  • 🤝 Work with diverse teams across UK, Europe, and Africa

  • 📚 Professional development programmes and coaching partnerships

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements

  • 💚 Well-being support and career growth opportunities

Our Mission 🌍

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low-income communities.

Our Impact 💚

Our technology has created measurable change:

  • Connected 📱: 2.5 million first-time smartphone users connected

  • Prosperous 💰: 70% of customers use M-KOPA products for income generation, with 35,000+ livelihoods created for agents

  • Green 🌱: 2.1 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided through clean energy products, with over 127,700 circular economy products provided

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at .

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships.

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.

If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.

We are looking for a Product Designer to help us evolve and maintain a consistent, scalable, and high-quality design system across Revizto. The system as a whole is owned by the design system lead; you will own your part of it. You will work closely with Product Designers and Engineering to improve components, patterns, documentation, and design system adoption across the product. Design QA is a standing part of this role. You will check what ships against what was designed, log and triage the gaps, and work with engineers to close them.
This role is hands-on and focused on building strong design system foundations, improving consistency, reducing design debt, and helping teams use the system effectively.

Who You Are

  • 3+ years of experience as a Product Designer, UI Designer, or in a similar design role, including at least one year contributing to a design system in production
  • A portfolio that shows production-quality UI and systematic thinking. We want to see components and patterns you have built and the reasoning behind them, not only finished screens
  • Strong visual design craft and attention to detail across typography, colour, spacing systems, layout grids and responsive behaviour
  • Hands-on experience contributing to, maintaining, or evolving a design system, including work with design tokens and component documentation
  • Experience running design QA against a spec or a component library, and spotting UI inconsistencies and design debt
  • Working knowledge of WCAG 2.2 AA as it applies to components: focus states, contrast, keyboard operation, and semantics
  • Advanced knowledge of Figma, including components, auto-layout, variables, and prototyping
  • Experience working closely with engineering teams
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Experience using AI tools to accelerate design work and improve workflows
  • Fluent in English; any other language is a plus
  • Located and authorised to work in Germany, France, the UK, or Armenia
Nice to have
  • Experience with design audits and design-to-code workflows
  • AEC/BIM domain experience
  • Motion design and micro-interactions
  • Basic understanding of HTML/CSS

Where You Will Make the Difference

  • Contribute to the evolution and maintenance of the design system, including components, patterns, tokens, and documentation
  • Own and improve assigned design system components and patterns throughout their lifecycle
  • Support design system adoption and consistency across product teams, working to the adoption approach set by the design system lead
  • Participate in Design QA and design reviews to identify visual inconsistencies, incorrect component usage, and gaps between design and implementation, then log, triage and follow those issues through to a fix with engineering
  • Identify and help reduce design debt and UI inconsistencies across the product
  • Create high-quality UI solutions using the design system and established product patterns when needed
  • Build accessibility into the components you own, meeting WCAG 2.2 AA, and document the accessible behaviour so product teams inherit it by default
  • Collaborate closely with Product Designers, PMs, and Engineers to ensure designs are practical, consistent, and implemented accurately
  • Share knowledge, best practices, and AI workflow experience with the design team through design reviews and team sessions

Why Join Us

  • Recognised as one of Switzerland’s Best Managed Companies by Deloitte in 2024, 2025, and 2026

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Big Ideas is seeking a meticulous, commercially minded, and proactive remote Financial Analyst to support our US-based client, a growing company in the beauty and wellness industry. In this role, you will report directly to the FP&A Manager and serve as a core analytical resource responsible for financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and commercial decision support. Supporting an omnichannel consumer brand footprint spanning direct-to-consumer (Shopify DTC), Amazon marketplace, and wholesale retail partner channels, you will transform transactional data into clear financial models, variance analyses, and strategic executive narratives.

This is a full-time, contractual, freelancer position for a trial period of 3 months while working at home. If you are a highly motivated and detail-oriented individual with experience and qualified based on the criteria below, we encourage you to apply.

Upon successful completion of the evaluation period, the contractor's performance will be reviewed, potentially leading to a contract renewal that may include a benefits package.

JOB DESCRIPTION
1. Weekly Cadence

  • Database Support:Operate the existing NetSuite and third party file loads into BigQuery. Extend them to new sources using the patterns already designed. Watch for schema changes and failed loads, and fix the cause rather than re-running. Design changes are specified by FP&A and reviewed before deployment.

2. Weekly and Monthly Cadence

  • Retailer door sales sync:Run the two-stage pipeline. Excel and VBA calculation engine on Dropbox feeding the Google Sheets values layer through Apps Script. Reconcile door counts and investigate breaks in the source file. Update monthly FC and maintain report backends.

3. Monthly and Quarterly Cadence

  • Budget versus actuals:Produce the pack across GL account, department and channel. Draft first-pass variance commentary. Maintain the transaction-type dispatch engine and the Description Aliases sheet as new posting patterns appear. Lock latest monthly & Quarterly FC.

  • Clinic KPI reporting: Produce reports. Maintain the Boulevard service category mapping.

  • Shipping profitability and 3PL billing: Run the shipping file checks and add new ones when a gap is found. Classify job tickets, flag duplicate orders and quantity convention errors, and keep the profitability model current across accounts.

  • Field team bonus calculator:Run the Field and Corporate pool calculations. Reconcile the output and confirm caps, gating and payout rates apply correctly before anything is released.

  • Sales team bonus calculator: Maintain and update the sales lead / customer mapping. Reconcile against the GRTs.

  • Profitability:Maintain, update and archive Brand Pricing schedules for SKUs

4. Ad Hoc and Continuous Cadence

  • International pricing calculator: Maintain VAT, Tariff and FX logic. Run new markets and new SKU scenarios. Check margin outcomes against the intended landed cost build.

  • Master data:Own the customer, vendor and employee master tables, channel and sub-channel tagging, and GL account groupings. Onboard new records ahead of each close rather than after a variance surfaces.

  • Internal reporting portal:Keep the resource directory (HUB) and its links current as reports move or are replaced.

  • Pricing:Maintain / update and archive Brand Pricing schedules for SKUs.


Requirements

  • QUALIFICATIONS
    • Bachelor’s Degree with studies in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or related quantitative field. CPA, CMA, or CFA track is an advantage.
    • Minimum of 4–5+ years of proven corporate experience in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), commercial finance, or corporate finance.
    • Demonstrable experience supporting omnichannel consumer products, retail, or fast-scaling Direct-to-Consumer (DTC/e-commerce) brand environments.
    • Strong business background and financial acumen.
  • REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
    • FP&A, financial reporting, business analytics, or a finance shared services experience (4+ years preferred)
    • Intermediate SQL. Joins, CTEs, aggregation, window functions. Able to read a long query written by someone else and explain both what it returns and where it would break
    • Advanced Google Sheets and Excel. Array formulas, QUERY, INDEX/MATCH and XLOOKUP, pivot tables, Power Query or equivalent.
    • Strong VBA. Able to read, debug and extend an existing macro-driven calculation workbook. Recording macros is not enough on its own.
    • Demonstrated ability to teach yourself a new language or tool. Most of the reporting layer runs on Google Apps Script, so you will be writing/editing JavaScript within the first few months
    • Able to read a P&L unaided. Understands debits and credits, accruals, gross to net revenue, cost of goods sold and gross margin.
    • Strong English skills, both verbal and written.
    • Ability to document all processes for a cold execution.
    • Comfortable asking questions and escalating issues.
    • Self-starter. Evidence of self-directed automation preferred. Something you built because the manual version was slow, and you’re able to explain the design choices behind it.
    • Reliable attendance.
  • REQUIRED TECHNICAL AND OTHER SKILLS
    • Intermediate to Advanced skills and proficiency with NetSuite
    • Advanced Excel & Scripting Mastery:Expert proficiency in Microsoft Excel, complex formula architecture, and VBA calculation engines. Experience with Google Sheets and Google Apps Script integrations.
    • Database & Data Pipeline Management: Practical experience with NetSuite ERP extractions, BigQuery database file loads, schema monitoring, and third-party data pipelines.
    • Data Integrity & Master Data Ownership: Hands-on experience maintaining chart of accounts groupings, customer/vendor master tables, and product SKU hierarchies.
  • SYSTEMS & TECHNOLOGY STACK
    • Database & Data Warehouse:NetSuite, BigQuery, third party file loads.
    • Calculation Engines & Scripting: Microsoft Excel, VBA calculation engines (Dropbox), Google Sheets, Google Apps Script.
    • Internal Portals & Repositories:Internal reporting portal / resource directory (HUB).
    • Enterprise ERP & Accounting Systems:NetSuite (cloud ERP) for GL account extraction, department, channel, and master data management.
    • Highly organized, independent, self-motivated, and detail-oriented team player.
    • Proactive problem solver who takes initiative without constant direction.
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate with US-based executive personnel.
  • PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
    • Experience within the DTC (Direct-to-Consumer), retail, or CPG (Consumer Packaged Goods) beauty, wellness, and clinic services sectors.
    • Experience as a Freelancer or servicing US clients is a big plus.
    • Familiarity with Boulevard platform workflows or similar service booking systems.
    • Knowledge using and having strong prompting skills with AI tools is a big plus.
  • REQUIREMENTS FOR REMOTE WORK
    • Eligible to work as a remote freelancer legally or as a contractor based in the Philippines
    • Natural-born Filipino citizen or Foreigner with a working VISA or permit to work in the Philippines legally.
    • Has own computer or laptop capable of handling the rigorous demands of work.
    • Has a fast and reliable internet connection at home (at least 200-300 MBPS)
    • Has a quiet and distraction free work environment at home.
    • Willing to work in graveyard shifts or changing shift US schedules.

HOURS OF WORK

  • Work from home. Full-time freelancer, contractual position

  • 8:00AM to 5:00PM PST Mondays to Fridays

  • 8 hours guaranteed shift per work day

  • With 1 hour daily “lunch break” (unpaid)

  • US Holidays off and unpaid

  • PH Holidays are normal working hours / days during the evaluation period

  • Any overtime needs to be pre-approved by the client


Benefits

  • COMPENSATION:$9 to $12 per hour GROSS rate depending on experience. Payroll is disbursed once a month.
  • TAXATION:As per Philippine Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) regulations, professional fees for self-employed individuals are subject to a5% or 10% Expanded Withholding Tax (EWT). The final tax will be calculated based on the freelancer's submission of a valid Certificate of Registration (COR) as self-employed. For those without a COR, there will be a 10% withholding tax as required by law.
  • CONTRACT:This is a 3-month long freelancing trial contract (full-time) that can be done remotely at home with a computer and a fast and reliable internet connection. There are no benefits for Freelancers during the evaluation period.
  • EXCLUSIVITY OF ENGAGEMENT:By accepting a full-time freelancer contract with Big Ideas, you agree that this position serves as your sole full-time role. Upon executing this contract, you are required to formally resign from and relinquish any existing full-time employment or contracts. Secondary part-time roles or freelance commitments are permitted, provided they are transparently declared prior to signing, do not present a conflict of interest, and do not compromise your availability or performance.
  • POSSIBLE RENEWAL:If the Freelancer passes the trial or evaluation period after a performance evaluation, the Client may decide to renew the service and there may be certain benefits such as paid sick leaves, paid vacation leaves, HMO health insurance and 13th month pay. These are not guaranteed and everything will depend on performance and client discretion and decision.
  • REPORTING TO:Although you will be reporting directly to the designated manager from our client, you will also be reporting to and will be supervised by Big Ideas, who is the consultant and service provider (Agency) of the US business. Big Ideas will be the ones to provide and disburse your compensation and other HR and administrative needs locally.
  • LEGAL STATUS:You will be classified as “Self-Employed” when it concerns all legal functions and taxation. You will not be considered an employee of our Client or Big Ideas but instead, you will be a self-employed freelance professional.
  • SCREENING AND VETTING PROCESS: We use AI tools to assist our team with initial application reviews and resume screening. These tools are strictly supportive; human judgment is at the core of our process, and all final hiring decisions are made by people. For information regarding your data privacy, please contact us.
  • EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT:Big Ideas is an Equal Opportunity Recruitment and Outsourcing Partner. We represent diverse talent and are committed to an inclusive, bias-free selection process. All candidate evaluations, endorsements, and placement decisions are based strictly on merit, skills, and client business requirements—without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. We expect all our client partners to uphold these same non-discriminatory hiring standards.

Systems Engineer – Territory

Our Team

The Fortinet Systems Engineering team is a group of technically skilled and commercially aware professionals who are passionate about solving our customer’s challenges through the delivery of industry-leading cybersecurity solutions.

As a Systems Engineer you will work closely with customers and sales teams to understand technical and business requirements, develop appropriate security solutions and lead the technical aspects of opportunities through to successful closure.

With us you will:

  • Lead all technical aspects of the sales cycle with customers, from initial discovery and RFIs through to RFPs and RFQs when required.
  • Work closely with the sales team to understand customer requirements and develop Fortinet solutions that address their business and technical challenges.
  • Be the primary technical point of contact for customers, working closely with your sales partner and relevant commercial partners.
  • Lead and support POCs, coordinating technical activities with customers, partners and relevant internal teams through to technical closure.
  • Deliver technical presentations, product demonstrations, whiteboarding sessions and solution workshops to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Listen to and understand the technical requirements of customers, using your knowledge and problem-solving skills to develop solutions that meet their needs and differentiate Fortinet from the competition.
  • Continuously develop your knowledge of Fortinet products and solutions, while maintaining an understanding of the competitive landscape and evolving cybersecurity threats.
  • Identify opportunities to expand and improve customer security architectures through the appropriate positioning of Fortinet solutions.
  • Manage multiple opportunities simultaneously, prioritising activity effectively while maintaining a positive customer experience.
  • Maintain accurate activity, contact and account technical information for customers and prospects within Salesforce.
  • Collaborate with sales, channel, professional services, customer success and other internal teams to support successful customer outcomes.

Apply if you:

  • Have a high aptitude for security technology, including encryption and authentication, with knowledge of network security, intrusion detection/prevention, endpoint security, routing, switching, LAN, WAN and VPN.
  • Have experience in a pre-sales engineer, systems engineer, solutions engineer, technical consultant or similar customer-facing technical role.
  • Have experience managing the end-to-end technical aspects of sales opportunities through to technical closure.
  • Have a good understanding of modern security architectures, including SASE, SD-WAN, Zero Trust, cloud security and SOC solutions.
  • Have working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, RADIUS, PKI, IKE, certificates and IPsec.
  • Can demonstrate problem-solving skills and how these have contributed to successful customer outcomes or key wins.
  • Can build and maintain effective customer relationships and communicate technical concepts clearly to a range of technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Have experience delivering technical presentations, demonstrations, whiteboarding sessions and/or POCs.
  • Have an understanding of competitive networking and security technologies.
  • Fortinet experience and relevant certifications such as NSE, CCNP or CISSP would be beneficial.

What You Can Expect from Us

  • Excellent training and development opportunities, providing you with all the tools you need to be successful.
  • An open working environment, sharing knowledge and information collaboratively and transparently, with respect to everyone’s thoughts and opinions.
  • The opportunity to be part of an innovative, collaborative and high-performing team.
  • A competitive salary and incentive compensation package, including stock awards, health and welfare benefits.

Why Join Us

At Fortinet, we embrace diversity and inclusivity. We encourage applications from diverse backgrounds and identities. Explore our welcoming work environment designed for a rewarding career journey with an attractive Total Rewards package to support you with your overall health and financial well-being.

We will only notify shortlisted candidates. Fortinet will not entertain any unsolicited resumes, please refrain from sending them to any Fortinet employees or Fortinet email aliases. Should any Agency submit any resumes to Fortinet, these resumes if considered, will be assumed to have been given by the Agency free of any related fees/charges.

This role is governed by the applicable CCNL, including its classification, minimum salary levels and pay progression rules, and benefit. In line with EU pay transparency requirements, remuneration is determined based on objective factors, including the relevant National Collective Labor Agreement (CCNL), the specific job profile, and seniority level. The target gross annual salary (RAL - Retribuzione Annua Lorda) for this position is expected to range between €60,000 and €80,000. The exact salary offer will be determined based on the successful candidate’s skills, qualifications, experience, and specific geographic location/work arrangements. We do not request or consider salary history at any stage of the recruitment process.

raw.description:
Agentify — це міжнародна аутсорсингова компанія, яка з 2013 року задає тренди на ринку клієнтського сервісу та продажів. За понад 13 років роботи ми виросли з локального стартапу до потужного міжнародного хабу. Сьогодні Agentify — це сотні однодумців, які працюють як у наших сучасних технологічних офісах, так і в зручному віддаленому форматі (Remote) з будь-якої точки світу. Ми обслуговуємо провідні світові бренди, спілкуємося 5 мовами та щодня допомагаємо тисячам людей. Ми працюємо на перетині технологій та комунікацій, а кожен наш співробітник стає мультифункціональним експертом, опановуючи ключові напрямки сучасного бізнесу.

Наші Core-ніші та експертиза:

  • 🔹 E-commerce & Retail — повний супровід клієнтів інтернет-магазинів: від оформлення замовлень до координації міжнародної логістики та повернень.

  • 🔹 Активні продажі — робота з теплими лідами, телемаркетинг, cross-sell/up-sell та повернення клієнтів до покинутих кошиків.

  • 🔹 Омніканальний Customer Care — клієнтська та технічна підтримка користувачів у режимі 24/7/365.

  • 🔹 Цифрові чати — спілкування з клієнтами без голосу через Live-чати на сайтах, Email та популярні месенджери (Viber, Telegram, WhatsApp).

  • 🔹 Інтелектуальна телефонія — робота з сучасним програмним забезпеченням, професійними CRM-системами та AI-інструментами автоматизації.

В свою команду зараз ми шукаємоОператор call-центра \ sales manager !

🌟Чому кандидати обирають Agentify?

  • Стабільність з 2013 року —прозорі виплати та впевненістьу завтрашньому дні.

  • Власна Академія —безкоштовне навчання з нуля(ділова комунікація, техніки продажів, робота з програмами та сервісами). Ми інвестуємо в розвиток співробітників і підтримуємо їх на всіх етапах адаптації.

  • Дохід без обмежень —погодинна ставка + відсоток від викупуза виконання KPI. У продажах твій заробіток залежить насамперед від твоїх результатів.

  • Реальний кар'єрний ліфт — більшість наших Team Lead, Supervisor та QA-менеджерів виросли всередині компанії.

  • Абсолютна інклюзивність— ми вільні від стереотипів. Для нас важливі лише твої навички, енергія та бажання розвиватися.

Ми пропонуємо:

  • Своєчасна оплата праці,що складається зфіксованої ставки 3,25 євро/год + % від викупу товарів.Середній дохід 400-700 євро на місяць.

  • Повністю віддалена робота.

  • Зручний позмінний графік :8.00−15.00 та з 15.00−22.00. 2 плаваючі вихідні на тиждень.

  • Кар'єрний ріст: можливість вирости до Team Lead, Тренера чи Менеджера QI

  • Постійне навчання за рахунок компанії та підвищення кваліфікації

  • Бонус за успішне проходження навчання

  • Дружній колектив і наставники, які завжди допоможуть.

  • Подарунки на річницю роботи та дітям співробітників на свята.

  • Спеціальні бонуси для менеджерів з найвищими показниками: індивідуальний графік, оплата спортивних абонементів або оплата курсів з іноземної мови, оплата розваг та інші привілеї.

  • Акція «Бонус за новачка» (ти отримуєш приємний бонус за кожного працівника, що прийшов по твоїй рекомендації)

Наші бізнес-цінності:

Відкритість—ми цінуємо вміння говорити прямо, чути інших і шукати нові підходи.

Надійність— для нас важливо, щоб на кожного члена команди можна було покластися, і ми створюємо умови для відповідальної роботи.

Безперервний розвиток—ми не чекаємо досконалості, але очікуємо бажання вчитися та вдосконалюватися.

Націленість на результат— ми працюємо, щоб досягати реальних результатів, а не для виконання формальних планів.

Клієнтоорієнтованість— ми ставимо потреби клієнтів у центр уваги та працюємо над тим, щоб забезпечувати якісний сервіс та пропонувати рішення, які створюють реальну цінність

  • Фіксувати замовлення в CRM-системі.

Що потрібно, щоб до нас приєднатись:

  • ПК/ноутбук, дротова гарнітура та стабільний інтернет.

  • Базове володіння ПК і офісними програмами.

  • Уміння продавати або бажання навчитися це робити.

Що для нас важливо?

Щоб ви бачили сенс у тому, що робите, були чесними з собою та колегами й не боялися вийти за межі звичного, коли це потрібно.

Якщо ви шукаєте місце, де ваші дії справді впливають на результат, ми будемо раді познайомитися!

SAP TM S/4HANA Rollout Consultant, Portugal

Contract: 6 months initially, extensible. Long-term programme. Start: 1 November 2026 Location: Remote, for consultants based in Portugal. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

A global manufacturing organisation is moving its transportation processes onto SAP Transportation Management (TM) on S/4HANA. The global template is the base, and it is being rolled out to sites in waves. Each wave brings new plants, new carriers and new country requirements into the template.

You will own the TM solution for the waves you are given. You will run fit-to-standard sessions with the business, decide what the template already covers and what is a real local gap, and design the answer without breaking the global standard. You will then carry that design through build, testing, cutover and early support after go-live.

What you will work on

Fit-gap for each rollout wave. Local transport practice, carriers, legal and document needs measured against the global design. TM solution design on S/4HANA. Freight planning, carrier selection and tendering, freight order execution, charge calculation and freight settlement. Integration across the S/4HANA logistics chain. Outbound sales orders and deliveries, inbound purchasing flows, warehouse execution, and freight cost through to finance. Carrier connectivity. EDI or business network onboarding, tracking, and status messages from carriers. Functional specifications for the build team, working closely with integration, development and test leads. Test planning and defect resolution through integration and user acceptance testing. Cutover, hypercare and handover to support for each wave. Feeding what each wave teaches back into the template, so the next wave starts from a better base.

What you bring

8 or more years in SAP logistics, with SAP TM on S/4HANA as a core part of it. At least one TM rollout or global template programme for a manufacturing business, where you did the fit-gap and the solution design yourself, not only the configuration. Working knowledge of how TM connects to SD, MM, EWM and FI/CO, and where those integrations tend to break. Experience running workshops with business users and turning what they say into a design and a specification. Comfort working remotely across countries in a programme team made up of several companies.

Useful but not essential:

SAP Business Network for Logistics, or a carrier visibility platform. Both embedded and side-by-side TM deployments. Automotive, industrial or process manufacturing. Multimodal, international or dangerous goods transport. SAP TM certification.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent TM rollout: the countries or sites in scope, whether TM was embedded or side-by-side, and what you personally designed.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced SAP TM people in front of a global manufacturing organisation.

raw.description:
We're hiring a Machine Learning Engineer to join the team of one of our clients, a computer vision AI company whose platform turns standard cameras into intelligent systems that raise productivity and reduce operating costs for enterprise customers in healthcare, manufacturing, and retail.

You will be responsible for the design, accuracy, and backbone of the client's computer vision applications: preparing data, training and configuring neural networks, deploying models in real customer environments, and refining algorithms. The role involves regular interaction with technical and non-technical stakeholders and close collaboration with the solutions engineering team, with room to grow, lead technical projects, and improve current processes.

The Product

The platform helps hospitals automate supply room monitoring and inventory management. Fixed cameras and AI continuously track supplies in storage areas and update on-hand counts in real time. When inventory falls below defined thresholds, replenishment orders are generated automatically and sent to ERP systems, eliminating manual counts and barcode scanning. Hospitals reduce critical stockouts, optimize inventory levels, and free clinical and supply chain teams to spend more time on patient care.

What You Will Do

  • Design, train, and fine-tune models for object detection, classification, segmentation, tracking, and anomaly detection on real customer video and images.
  • Adapt pretrained and foundation models (YOLO-family detectors, ViTs, CLIP-style and vision-language models) to new use cases with limited labeled data.
  • Own data pipelines end to end: curation, labeling guidelines, augmentation, synthetic data, and dataset versioning.
  • Optimize models for production and edge hardware using quantization, pruning, distillation, ONNX export, and TensorRT, meeting agreed latency and accuracy targets.
  • Build evaluation suites with clear metrics (mAP, precision/recall, false-alarm rates per camera-hour) and catch regressions before release.
  • Deploy and monitor models in production, diagnose drift and failure cases, and close the loop with retraining.
  • Write clean, tested, reviewed code and contribute to shared ML tooling.

Requirements

  • Solid experience building ML systems, with at least 2 years focused on computer vision.
  • Strong Python and hands-on experience with PyTorch (or TensorFlow) for training and debugging deep learning models.
  • At least one computer vision model shipped to production, with the ability to explain the trade-offs made along the way.
  • Solid grasp of CNN and transformer architectures for detection, segmentation, and classification.
  • Experience with OpenCV and image/video processing: decoding streams, preprocessing, and augmentation.
  • Working knowledge of model optimization for inference (ONNX, TensorRT, quantization, or similar).
  • Comfortable with Docker, Git, Linux, and training on GPUs in a cloud environment (AWS or Azure).
  • Sound ML fundamentals: loss functions, overfitting, class imbalance, evaluation metrics, and experiment design.
  • Clear written and verbal communication in English.

Why join us:

  • Remote job from LATAM
  • USD compensation
  • Paid time off
  • Long-term engagements
  • Collaborate with international teams on innovative, real-world AI projects.

Turn your passion for travel into a rewarding career!

Do you have a passion for travel and a talent for creating memorable experiences? AAA Club Alliance is seeking an experienced Full-Service Travel Agent with both domestic and international travel booking expertise to join our remote Travel Contact Center team.


In this work-from-home position, you’ll help Members and non-Members plan and book personalized vacations—from weekend getaways to complex international itineraries. You’ll build lasting client relationships, provide exceptional service, and have the opportunity to earn monthly performance incentives.


Who Can Apply?

To be considered, candidates must reside in one of the following locations:

Connecticut, Delaware, Indiana, Kansas, Kentucky, Maryland, New Jersey, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Dakota, Virginia, Washington, DC, or West Virginia.

Why You’ll Love Working at AAA

  • 100% Remote: Work from the comfort of your home.
  • Competitive Pay: $18.00–$24.00 per hour, based on experience and geographic location, plus monthly performance incentives for sales and bookings.

  • Tuesday: 9:30 AM–6:00 PM
  • Wednesday: 10:00 AM–6:00 PM

What You’ll Do

As a Remote Full-Service Travel Agent, you will:

  • Plan and book domestic and international vacations, including customized FIT (Fully Independent Travel) itineraries.
  • Assist Members and non-Members through phone, email, and web chat.
  • Recommend destinations, travel products, and exclusive AAA benefits based on each traveler’s needs.

  • Excellent communication, customer service, sales, and problem-solving skills.
  • Extensive knowledge of worldwide geography.
  • The ability to succeed in a fast-paced, high-volume contact center environment.

Training & Schedule Requirements

Successful candidates must:

  • Work a set schedule that includes one weekend day each week, along with one weekday and one weekend day off.

Apply today and start helping people explore the world!

Mechanical Engineering Expert (MSc. or PhD)

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible—you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

We are looking for a highly skilled Mechanical Engineering Expert to contribute to an AI training project involving engineering design, physical modeling, simulation, technical problem-solving, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating engineering tasks across structural, thermal, mechanical, and multiphysics domains. A representative task may require translating physical requirements into a computational model, generating the required geometry or mesh, applying materials and boundary conditions, running an engineering simulation, and determining whether the resulting artifact and analysis satisfy the applicable physical and design constraints.

This is a very coding heavy role. Candidates must have experience using coding agents in their workflow.

Required Skills

  • Python

  • Mechanical Engineering

What You’ll Work On

  • Solve and validate mechanical-engineering problems involving design, analysis, simulation, testing, or R&D.

  • Translate physical systems and engineering requirements into analytical or computational models.

  • Create or modify geometry, meshes, materials, loads, contacts, constraints, and solver inputs.

Required Qualifications

  • An MS or PhD in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline; or

  • Strong understanding of applied mechanics and mechanical-engineering fundamentals.

  • Experience developing analytical, computational, or simulation-based engineering solutions.

  • Practical proficiency with coding agents.

Process

  • Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.

  • Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.

  • Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure

  • Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

  • Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

At Lumeris, we believe that our greatest achievements are made possible by the talent and commitment of our team members. We're excited to consider every qualified candidate authorized to work in the United States, although we are unable to sponsor visas for this role at this time.

Position:

Grievance Coordinator

Position Summary:

Works an important part of the Medicare Grievances Program, which is the heartbeat of Plan operations and a direct insight to member experience. Reviews and investigates member complaints and works with internal and external partners to reach mitigation and resolution for the member. Handles each grievance in accordance with organizational and regulatory guidelines.

Job Description:

Primary Responsibilities

  • Conducts thorough investigations into member complaints, identifies all issues or components of the grievance, and achieves resolution through action and education to the member. Utilizes senior resources as needed.
  • Conducts rigorous root cause analysis on escalated member grievances, using structured diagnostic techniques to identify underlying system, plan, or provider issues.
  • Researches, gathers information and evidence, and conducts timely outreach with members, providers, internal and external partners, reviews issues, and assesses appropriate resolution.
  • Documents investigation as an accurate and complete chronological record of actions taken, communication and information obtained, and member resolution and notification for each grievance.
  • Ensures grievance resolution reflects the member's complaint and accurately and completely addresses all components of the complaint. Keeps track of several cases simultaneously while making sure each member gets the attention they deserve in a high-volume, high-touch environment.
  • Creates and maintains good rapport and collaborates effectively in all areas of the organization.
  • Recognizes urgent and sensitive issues/incidents and escalates in a timely manner to facilitate appropriate and timely response.
  • Communicates the status of assignments in weekly internal meetings for discussion and direction.
  • Demonstrates sufficient knowledge of complaint and understanding of related plan processes or functions to adequately articulate issue and resolution.

Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree or equivalent
  • 1+ years of related work experience or the knowledge, skills, and abilities to succeed in the role
  • Ability to maintain high ethical standards
  • Good critical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to multi-task and operate effectively in both remote and in-person settings
  • Skilled problem-solver with the ability to take on basic problems and achieve a solution within a reasonable amount of time
  • Good investigatory skills with ability to organize, review, and effectively assess risk and appropriate response
  • Ability to remain fair and identify facts
  • Organizational skills for prioritizing tasks to meet set deadlines
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to interact at all levels
  • Good customer service skills

Working Conditions

Factors that may be used to determine your actual pay rate include your specific skills, experience, qualifications, location, and comparison to other employees already in this role. In addition to the base salary, certain roles may qualify for a performance-based incentive and/or equity, with eligibility depending on the position. These rewards are based on a combination of company performance and individual achievements.

$44,100.00-$54,825.00

  • Paid Time Off (PTO, Sick Time, Paid Leave, Volunteer & Wellness Days)

As a virtual Relationship Manager II at The Standard, you will be providing best in class and profitable customer service to channel relationships, plan decision-makers, and plan participants for assigned accounts to achieve business growth and customer retention. This role supports a dedicated book of advisors and employers virtually.  

 

  • Develop and manage effective primary relationships with primarily advisors, and channel relationships through frequent contact, proactive touchpoints, proactive phone calls, professional negotiation, responsive communication, and problem resolution.

Inform the customer in a timely manner of industry and regulatory changes and explain the impact on the client.

  • Drive client retention by providing value added information to advisors and delivering information such as plan reviews through virtual meetings.

This may include assisting in the data collection process, managing the new business submission process, delivering documents and agreements, communicating with the plan sponsor and channel relationship, and other activities related to a new plan.

In addition to the competitive salary range below, our employee-focused benefits support work-life balance. Learn more about working at The Standard.

  • Eligibility to participate in an incentive program is subject to the rules governing the program and plan. Any award depends on a variety of factors including individual and organizational performance.

The actual compensation for this role will be based on a combination of education and experience, knowledge and skills, position budget, internal equity, and market data.

$100,000 annual salary + Relationship Manager Bonus Program

You’ll own strategy and execution across our clients’ channels, build and run UGC programs that turn real customers and creators into a brand’s best content engine, and spot the cultural moments worth jumping on before everyone else does. You’ll know what drives views and engagement on every platform, optimize relentlessly, and report on results in a way clients understand and act on. You’ll be the day-to-day lead for social media client relationships, the person who solves problems before they become problems, and the creative mind who knows exactly when a post can be made in Canva and when it needs a designer’s touch. This is an ideal position for someone who lives at the pulse of culture, brings strategic rigor to every idea, and thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative agency environment.

Responsibilities:

Your role would include, but not be limited to, the following:

Social Strategy & Execution

Develop and lead organic social strategies across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest, and emerging platforms that ladder up to client business goals.
Own content calendars from concept to publish, writing platform-native copy and captions in each brand’s voice.
Create on-brand assets in Canva, and write clear, detailed creative briefs for designers on assets that require custom design or motion.
Oversee community management and engagement, ensuring every brand shows up consistently and responsively.

UGC Programs

Plan and run UGC campaigns within social, from concept and creator sourcing to briefing, content review, and publishing.
Write UGC briefs that deliver authentic, platform-ready content aligned with campaign objectives.
Manage usage rights and repurpose UGC across owned channels and paid support.
Build a repeatable UGC content engine that keeps client channels fresh and drives engagement and conversion.

Culture & Trendjacking

Monitor culture, trends, memes, and platform features daily, and identify trendjacking opportunities that fit each brand.
Move quickly from idea to approval to post so clients show up in the conversation while it still matters.
Bring proactive, culturally relevant ideas to clients that resonate with millennial and Gen Z audiences.

Performance, Optimization & Reporting

Optimize content for views and engagement by testing hooks, formats, lengths, captions, audio, and posting times, and apply what works to future content.
Understand how each platform’s algorithm distributes content, and adjust strategy to maximize reach, watch time, and retention.
Track views, reach, engagement rate, watch time, saves, shares, and follower growth across organic social and UGC.
Build and present monthly client reports that connect performance to business goals, with clear insights, wins, and recommended next steps.
Use native analytics and social reporting tools to monitor performance in real time and course-correct quickly.

Client Leadership

Serve as the day-to-day lead for client relationships, building strong rapport and trust.
Anticipate challenges and solve problems with clear, confident recommendations.
Mentor and guide coordinators, and contribute to internal process improvements.

Skills & Qualifications:

This is important | Please only apply if:
4+ years of agency experience in social media management (minimum).
Based in the US or Canada and authorized to work there.
Proven experience planning and running UGC campaigns within social, including briefing creators and managing usage rights.
A proven track record of growing views and engagement, with a strong understanding of platform algorithms, hooks, and retention.
Experience building and presenting client-ready performance reports that turn data into clear recommendations.
Advanced Canva skills, plus experience briefing designers on custom assets.
A track record of trendjacking and moving at the speed of culture for millennial and Gen Z consumer brands.
Excellent client rapport, with strong communication and presentation skills.
Sharp problem-solving skills and the ability to stay calm and decisive under tight timelines.
Organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple clients at once.
Familiarity with CapCut, social scheduling and analytics tools, Notion, and Google Drive is a plus.

Unfortunately, if you do not meet these requirements, we will not be able to respond.
