Position Highlights

Position Title: Project Implementation Manager

Department: Programs and Innovation Office – Workforce Acceleration Initiative

FLSA Classification: Exempt

Reports to: Project Manager - Workforce Acceleration Initiative

Location: Remote, must be based in the United States, Up to 10% domestic travel may be required.

Salary Range: $90,000 - $123,000 per year, plus benefits. Individual salary offers will be based on experience and qualifications unique to each candidate.

Position Type: Grant funded, limited-term opportunity

Position End Date: June 30, 2027

Hours of Work: Individual must routinely be available during core department business hours to collaborate with Illinois Department of Public Health staff.

Overview

The Project Implementation Manager will drive the delivery of data modernization projects that improve the use of public health data to inform decision making. This role is aligned to the Workforce Acceleration Initiative (WAI). WAI is a federally funded CDC Foundation program with the goal of helping the nation’s public health agencies by providing them with the technology and data experts they need to accelerate their information system improvements.

Working within the Illinois Department of Public Health the Project Implementation Manager will collaborate across technical and non-technical teams to define project objectives, allocate resources, coordinate with teams, and manage timelines to ensure the successful delivery and implementation of a public health data systems project.

The Project Implementation Manager will be hired by the CDC Foundation and assigned to the Illinois Department of Public Health. This position is eligible for a fully remote work arrangement for U.S. based candidates.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain data modernization workplans, serving as the Project Implementation Manager to develop detailed project plans and timelines, as well as maintain project documentation including project charters, plans, status reports, and post-project evaluations.
  • Drive project deliverables to ensure they are within scope, deadlines, and budget.
  • Develop and execute supporting plans including data communication, data training, and the data modernization initiative (DMI) evaluation plan. Support execution of enterprise-wide data maturity assessment. Develop and conduct surveys and focus groups as needed to assist in assessment. Create an evaluation plan for data modernization impact analysis. Assist with implementation of the data maturity roadmap.
  • Establish measurable metrics to be used to evaluate DMI activities and impact.
  • Schedule and organize regular recurring meetings with internal and external data interest holders to review project progress, address any issues or concerns, identify data needs and gaps.
  • Schedule and organize data modernization advisory committee meetings.
  • Collaborate with DMI core team including (data governance manager, metadata specialist, data training and communication specialist, business process analyst) to execute DMI workplan. Work with business analysts and other stakeholders to implement and adopt change management strategies.
  • Define clear roles and responsibilities and ensure standards and best practices are followed.
  • Work with user community, technical teams and vendors to meet implementation timeline.
  • Document business practices and workflows, identify opportunities for improvement, support process improvement, discover issues and deliver improved value.
  • Effectively communicating insights and plans to cross-functional team members and management. Facilitate communication between project team members, business analysts, and stakeholders. Create dashboards and generate reports.
  • Develop and implement change management strategies and plans to support the successful adoption and implementation of data modernization transformational activities.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in project management, public health, information systems, operations management or related field required. Master’s degree or other related advanced degree in a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years of related experience leading data management projects.
  • Expert knowledge of project management fundamentals, including the ability to develop and implement accurate work plans, schedules, staffing plans, and budgets, in an agile or iterative environment. Proficiency in Smartsheet, Confluence, SharePoint and/or other project management tools and techniques.
  • Experienced in change management and risk management principles and processes.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to describe difficult technical problems and solutions to technical and non-technical teams.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining working relationships with internal and external partners and can effectively promote collaboration among differing viewpoints.
  • Outstanding interpersonal and teamwork skills; and the ability to develop productive working relationships with colleagues and partners.
  • Experience working in a virtual environment with remote partners and teams.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
  • Knowledge of data management, data governance and change management.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification or equivalent is preferred.

Special Notes

This role is involved in a dynamic public health program. As such, roles and responsibilities are subject to change as situations evolve. Roles and responsibilities listed above may be expanded upon or updated to match priorities and needs, once written approval is received by the CDC Foundation in order to best support the public health programming.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status, and all other characteristics protected by law.

We comply with all applicable laws including E.O. 11246 and the Vietnam Era Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974 governing employment practices and do not discriminate on the basis of any unlawful criteria in accordance with 41 C.F.R. §§ 60-300.5(a)(12) and 60-741.5(a)(7). As a federal government contractor, we take affirmative action on behalf of protected veterans.

The CDC Foundation is a smoke-free environment.

Relocation expenses are not included.

About the CDC Foundation

The CDC Foundation is an independent nonprofit authorized by Congress to mobilize philanthropic partners to support the public health system, including the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), in preventing and responding to threats to health. In this role, we are focused on one priority: building catalytic, flexible and impactful partnerships—with corporations, philanthropies, individuals and organizations—to help improve the health and lives of people in all communities, everywhere. Visit for more information.

Job Title: Senior Director, Drug Safety Operations (remote)

Job Location: Indianapolis, Indiana, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


Overview


Centessa Pharmaceuticals, a wholly owned subsidiary of Eli Lilly and Company, is a clinical-stage company developing orexin receptor 2 (OX2R) agonists as a new class of medicines for the treatment of narcolepsy and potentially other sleep-wake disorders. Centessa’s lead investigational candidate – cleminorexton (formerly ORX750) – is being developed for narcolepsy type 1, narcolepsy type 2, and idiopathic hypersomnia. Centessa's OX2R agonist portfolio includes additional clinical and preclinical-stage assets with potential utility across a broader range of neurological, neurodegenerative, and neuropsychiatric conditions. Headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, Centessa was recognized as a Great Place to Work® in 2026.


We are seeking a highly experienced and detail-oriented Senior Director, Drug Safety Operations to lead and optimize the operational aspects of our global safety and pharmacovigilance (PV) function. Reporting to the AVP, Drug Safety & Pharmacovigilance, this role will provide strategic and operational leadership for our global drug safety and pharmacovigilance function. This role is responsible for overseeing end-to-end safety operations, including case processing, individual case safety report (ICSR) management, regulatory reporting, vendor oversight, inspection readiness, and compliance with global pharmacovigilance requirements across the product lifecycle. The Senior Director will lead the development and optimization of scalable processes, systems, and partnerships that ensure high-quality, efficient, and compliant safety reporting while supporting Centessa's growing portfolio. Operating in a dynamic environment, this individual will drive operational excellence, continuous improvement, and innovation to advance patient safety and regulatory compliance globally.


Responsibilities


  • Lead Drug Safety Operations activities and manage assigned team members, ensuring the timely, accurate, and compliant collection, assessment, processing, review, and reporting of safety information across clinical development programs.
  • Partner across the Drug Safety leadership team to implement and enhance operational processes, governance activities, and resourcing plans in support of an evolving development portfolio.
  • Lead execution of the global Drug Safety Operations strategy, operating model, governance framework, objectives, and resourcing plans to support an evolving portfolio and business priorities.
  • Oversee pharmacovigilance operations, including case intake, triage, processing, medical coding, quality review, Individual Case Safety Reports (ICSRs), SUSAR reporting, and submissions to global regulatory authorities.
  • Lead oversight and governance of pharmacovigilance vendors, CROs, safety database providers, and other external partners, ensuring high-quality service delivery, regulatory compliance, performance management, and financial stewardship.
  • Establish, maintain, and continuously improve pharmacovigilance processes, SOPs, work instructions, quality systems, and operational controls to ensure compliance with global regulations and industry standards, including FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, and ICH requirements.
  • Ensure ongoing inspection readiness and lead operational support for regulatory inspections, partner audits, and quality assessments, including CAPA development and implementation as needed.
  • Monitor operational performance through KPIs, quality metrics, dashboards, and trend analyses to drive data-informed decision-making, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Drug Safety physicians, Clinical Development, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Medical Affairs, Biometrics, and external partners to align pharmacovigilance operations with program and corporate objectives.
  • Support the preparation and operational execution of aggregate safety reporting activities, including DSURs, PBRERs, Risk Management Plans, and other regulatory deliverables, ensuring data integrity and inspection-ready documentation.
  • Drive operational excellence through process optimization, system enhancements, automation, and scalable solutions that improve efficiency, quality, compliance, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Build, develop, and mentor a high-performing Drug Safety Operations team while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and patient focus.

Basic Qualifications


  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing, Public Health, or a related scientific discipline.
  • 10+ years of pharmacovigilance and drug safety operations experience within the biotechnology and/or pharmaceutical industry, including increasing levels of responsibility.
  • Experience supporting small molecule development programs and/or neuroscience/CNS products within an emerging biotechnology environment strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience managing global safety operations, including case processing, Individual Case Safety Reports (ICSRs), SUSAR reporting, and regulatory submissions within a GxP-regulated environment.
  • Strong knowledge of global pharmacovigilance regulations and guidance, including FDA, EMA, MHRA, ICH, GVP, and applicable international reporting requirements.
  • Experience overseeing pharmacovigilance vendors, CROs, and external service providers, including performance management, governance, and compliance oversight.
  • Hands-on experience with safety databases and pharmacovigilance technologies (e.g., Argus, ArisG, or comparable systems), including familiarity with MedDRA, WHO Drug dictionaries, and E2B(R3) reporting standards.
  • Experience supporting clinical-stage development programs, with knowledge of aggregate safety reporting activities such as DSURs, PBRERs, Risk Management Plans, and related regulatory deliverables.
  • Proven ability to lead and develop staff, manage competing priorities, and operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving biotech environment.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across geographies and organizational levels.
  • Experience supporting regulatory inspections, audits, and health authority interactions, with a demonstrated commitment to quality, compliance, and patient safety.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (e.g., PharmD, MSN, MPH, or MS) in a related scientific discipline.

Work Location

The Senior Director, Drug Safety Operations role is a remote position based in the US, with occasional travel.

Software Engineer (Mid-Level–Senior)

HealthTech | Fully Remote — United States | Full-Time
Base salary: $140,000–$200,000 USD annually, plus bonus and equity
Flexible hours with Pacific Time overlap | No travel

Build what comes next in AI-powered healthcare

Our client is a fast-scaling, AI-enabled healthcare technology company. You’ll join a 30-person engineering team that’s hiring hands-on software engineers from mid-level through senior.

If you have 3–4 years of strong production experience and are ready for more ownership, we want to meet you. If you’re a senior engineer who wants to stay close to the code and help shape what comes next, there’s room for that too. We’ll match the scope and compensation to the experience and engineering judgment you bring.

You’ll build software that supports real healthcare delivery, working on systems used by operations teams, clinicians, and health-plan partners. This is a chance to join a company scaling quickly, take on meaningful technical challenges, and grow alongside the business.

What you’ll work on

  • Build applications, APIs, integrations, data workflows, and internal tools that make healthcare operations more effective
  • Take features from understanding the problem through implementation, testing, release, and improvement
  • Work with Ruby on Rails, Python, Node.js, and PostgreSQL in a database-intensive environment
  • Improve performance, data quality, reliability, and visibility into how systems behave in production
  • Collaborate with engineers, product partners, and business stakeholders to make practical tradeoffs and ship useful software
  • Use AI coding tools thoughtfully, with strong review, testing, and accountability for the result
  • At the senior level, lead larger technical initiatives, guide architecture decisions, and help raise engineering standards while remaining hands-on

What we’re looking for

  • At least 3 years of professional software engineering experience, with opportunities for mid-level and senior engineers
  • Production experience with Ruby on Rails or Python, plus the ability to learn and work across the stack
  • Strong SQL and hands-on PostgreSQL experience
  • Solid fundamentals in data structures, API design, testing, debugging, and system performance
  • Experience delivering web applications or full-stack features, with an understanding of how the user interface, services, and database fit together
  • Good habits around Git, code reviews, testing, deployment, and production support
  • Clear communication, curiosity, and the ability to work through changing requirements
  • Practical experience with AI-assisted development and the judgment to validate what it produces

You don’t need to know every technology we use. We care about what you’ve built, how you solve problems, and how quickly you can learn.

Helpful experience

  • Healthcare, insurance, or other sensitive-data environments
  • AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, or observability tools
  • Data pipelines, event-driven systems, or reliable third-party integrations
  • Node.js or C# in addition to your core backend language

Why join

  • A fully remote opportunity on a growing, 30-person engineering team
  • Real ownership and direct collaboration with product and engineering leadership
  • A fast-moving company putting AI to work in healthcare
  • Room to expand your responsibilities and influence as the company scales
  • Bonus and equity, giving you the opportunity to participate in the company’s growth
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k); generous PTO

Compensation and leveling

The annual base salary range is $140,000–$200,000 USD, plus bonus and equity. Expected base salary bands are:

  • Mid-level: $140,000–$165,000
  • Experienced mid-level: $165,000–$190,000
  • Senior-level: $190,000–$200,000

Your level and offer will reflect your demonstrated skills, relevant experience, and the scope you can own. Years of experience are a guide, not the sole deciding factor.

Location and schedule

This role is fully remote within the United States, with reliable overlap with Pacific Time. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship. No travel is required.

Interested? Apply and tell us about something you built, what you owned, and the impact it had.

Urrly uses AI to support application review against job-related role requirements. Applicants are assessed on relevant skills and experience, without regard to personal attributes.

Salary: $140,000 – $200,000 / year

Solve Complex Technical Challenges as our Next Technical Support Analyst!


Are you passionate about solving complex technical challenges and optimizing solutions for customers and partners using Trimble Transportation's diverse tools? Join Trimble Transportation to troubleshoot critical issues, identify product enhancements, and collaborate across engineering and product teams to make moving freight safer, simpler, and more efficient!


About Us:

Trimble Transportation is transforming the global supply chain through intelligent, connected technology and workflows that are rooted in industry standard commercial maps and data. At the intersection of the physical and digital worlds, Trimble Transportation offers SaaS, web, mobile and installed solutions that improve efficiency, promote safety, optimize utilization, and enable collaboration. From planning to delivery, we provide cutting edge procurement, transportation management, mapping, routing, dispatch, navigation, location, fleet management, ELD compliance and asset maintenance solutions. For more information, visit: transportation.trimble.com.


What Makes This Role Great:

In this role, you will serve as a vital technical conduit between commercial clients and internal development teams, taking ownership of deep root-cause troubleshooting and directly shaping the quality, reliability, and functionality of essential transportation management software.


Key Exciting Responsibilities

  • Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve hardware, software, and TMS solution issues using CRM and casing platforms.
  • Partner directly with developers, project managers, and quality assurance teams across global locations to report bugs and track resolution.
  • Deliver an outstanding customer support experience across phone, email, web, and chat channels while meeting team SLAs and KPIs.
  • Analyze device logs, database queries, and system behaviors to perform thorough root cause analysis on complex technical issues.
  • Recommend improvements for business processes, technical support tools, research approaches, and internal documentation.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor degree or equivalent practical experience in a technology-related field.
  • Demonstrated experience performing technical troubleshooting and root cause analysis across integrated systems.
  • Proficiency using and troubleshooting SQL, XML, HTML, and scripting languages.
  • Hands-on experience navigating and supporting various operating systems such as Windows, Linux, Android, iOS, or Microsoft Servers.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.

Bonus Points For:

  • Prior experience utilizing Jira software, CRM casing tools, or working within the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
  • Hands-on background with mobile communications, wireless devices, or device log analysis.
  • Domain knowledge or operational experience within the transportation and logistics industry.
  • Familiarity with REST/SOAP APIs, Web Services, or languages like Java, C#, Python, JavaScript, Angular, or React.

Logistics:

Location: Remote US

Travel Requirement: Less than 5%


Why You'll Love Working With Us

At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.


  • You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide. Our impact is tangible, from connected machines that save fuel to data-driven insights that reduce waste.
  • Collaborate with like-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging. We're a company of "visionary pragmatists" who think boldly and build things that work.
  • Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self-authored," empowering proactive "doers."

Technical Support Analyst, Technical Support Engineer, TMS Support, Transportation Management Systems, SQL, Software Troubleshooting, Root Cause Analysis, Application Support, APIs, Customer Support, Remote Jobs

Compensation: Trimble provides the following compensation range and general description of other compensation and benefits that it in good faith believes it might pay and/or offer for this position. This compensation range is based on a full time schedule. Trimble reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s sex or other status protected by local, state, or federal law.

Hiring Range

$55,000.00–$75,600.00

Pay Rate Type

Salary

Bonus Eligible?

Yes

Commission Eligible?

No

Benefits:Trimble offers comprehensive core benefits that include Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, Time off plans and retirement plans. Most of our businesses also offer tax savings plans for health, dependent care and commuter expenses as well as Paid Parental Leave and Employee Stock Purchase Plan. If this position is identified above as commission- or bonus-eligible, the terms of the commission plan or discretionary bonus plan for which you are eligible will be provided following the employee start date.

How to Apply: Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on one of the Apply buttons located in this posting.


At Trimble, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where everyone can thrive. Guided by our core values—Belong, Innovate, and Grow—we embrace and celebrate differences, knowing they make us stronger and more innovative. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds and advancing opportunities while embracing race, color, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, disability, veteran status, or any other protected and diverse characteristic. We are committed to offering our candidates and employees with disabilities or sincerely held religious beliefs the ability to seek reasonable accommodations in accordance with applicable law and/or where it would not constitute undue hardship for Trimble. For more, please see Trimble's Code of Business Conduct and Ethics at, under Governance->Governance Documents.

Across websites, magazines, newsletters, social channels and events, we bring expert content to audiences around the world. The Team

Future B2B delivers an unparalleled client experience across newsletters, digital advertising, lead generation, webinars, and live events. Through well-known specialist brands, we connect major companies with highly engaged professional audiences. Our sales team builds lasting partnerships with Fortune 500 corporations and growing startups. Joining us as a Sales Associate gives you hands-on experience and a strong foundation for career advancement in media sales.

What you'll do

What We Offer

Alabama, Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, West Virginia, and Wisconsin.

Diversity and Inclusion

At Future, we’re working to attract, retain and foster diverse talent, educate our colleagues in the importance of diversity, and review our internal processes so that they remain as free from bias as possible. We recognise that, in order to reach diverse communities through our content, we must first ensure ours is a culture in which diversity can thrive.

At Kognitiv Inc., we’re redefining what it means to be a Workday partner. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the ecosystem, we bring deep expertise, innovative thinking, and a people-first mindset to everything we do. We’re not just building better Workday solutions—we’re building a company where talented people thrive.

Ready to do your best work? Join us.

You’ll partner directly with enterprise clients to architect FP&A solutions, optimize post-production environments, and solve complex modeling challenges across the Workday ecosystem.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead & Architect: Own end-to-end client engagements—from discovery and sheet modeling to security and OfficeConnect setups—for global enterprise clients.
  • Bridge the Data: Leverage Workday Core Reporting (Calculated Fields, Custom Reports, EIBs) to seamlessly pipeline data into Adaptive models.
  • Be the Strategic Advisor: Conduct interactive client sessions, assess underlying business needs, and recommend future-proof FP&A architectures.
  • Elevate the Team: Review deliverables, mentor rising consultants, and shape Kognitiv’s Adaptive practice with your best-practice insight.

What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in Workday Adaptive Planning (implementations, AMS support, or internal client-side leadership).
  • Deep Adaptive Expertise in at least two core areas: Sheet/Structure Modeling, OfficeConnect/Reporting, Adaptive Security, or Native/Power of One Integrations.
  • Workday Reporting Mastery: Solid grasp of Workday custom reports and how core financial/HCM data feeds into Adaptive.
  • Proven Project Ownership: Comfortable running point on multiple concurrent client projects, phase X rollouts, and complex post-production initiatives without needing hand-holding.

Kognitiv is an Equal Opportunity Employer: All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. Kognitiv will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in a manner consistent with the requirements of the law, including any applicable fair chance law.


Work Authorization: Applicants for employment in the country in which they are applying (Employing Country) must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the Employing Country and with Kognitiv.


Recruitment Fraud Alert: Kognitiv Inc. will only contact job applicants via official email addresses ending in @kognitivinc.com or through our official Workday candidate portal. While our team may occasionally reach out by phone during the recruitment process, we will never ask candidates for money, banking details, or sensitive personal information as a condition of employment. Please ensure you are communicating through our official channels.


Candidates who are currently employed by a client of Kognitiv or an affiliated Kognitiv business may not be eligible for consideration.

Description

Terra Security provides agentic AI-powered continuous penetration testing aligned to code changes and evolving attack surfaces, combining a swarm of trained AI agents with human supervision for safety and control. Fortune 500 organizations trust Terra to ensure every attack surface is covered across the web, AI, internal apps, APIs, mobile, networks, and the cloud.

Terra is on track to become the next breakout cybersecurity company with $38 million raised to date, including a $30 million Series A led by Felicis Ventures with participation from Dell Technologies Capital, Silicon Valley CISO Investments (SVCI), SYN Ventures, LAMA Partners, Underscore VC, and Capital One Ventures.

﻿Summary

We’re looking for a Field & Growth Marketing Lead to help scale predictable pipeline across direct B2B and partner-led (B2B2B) motions. This role is responsible for designing, executing, and scaling field and growth programs that directly support revenue goals across regions, segments, and partners. You’ll work closely with Sales, Partnerships, and Revenue Operations to turn strategy into execution and execution into measurable pipeline impact. This is a highly visible, hands-on role for someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment and is comfortable being accountable for results.

Why This Role Matters

  • You’ll help move the company from ad hoc programs to scalable growth systems.
  • You’ll influence both direct and partner revenue motions.
  • You’ll be accountable for executing pipeline-driving programs with clear visibility into performance and impact on revenue.

What You’ll Do

  • Build the Field Marketing & Regional Pipeline
  • Execute field marketing programs across priority regions and segments in close alignment with Sales and Marketing leadership
  • Ensure each program is aligned to clear outcomes, including meetings set, pipeline created, and deal acceleration
  • Partner & B2B2B Growth - Execute partner-driven demand programs
  • Work with the Partnerships team to support partner-sourced pipeline and partner-influenced opportunities
  • Adapt messaging and programs for indirect sales motions
  • Launch scalable growth campaigns
  • Test and optimize messaging, offers, and channels to improve conversion and efficiency
  • Translate learnings into repeatable growth playbooks
  • Act as the primary marketing partner for Sales leaders and reps
  • Align programs to territory plans, target accounts and verticals, and quarterly pipeline goals
  • Build clear follow-up plans, sales assets, and enablement for every campaign
  • Own performance tracking and reporting for all field and growth programs
  • Measure impact across pipeline sourced and influenced, cost per opportunity, and conversion rates by channel and partner
  • Partner with RevOps to maintain clean attribution and forecasting confidence
  • Use data to prioritize what scales, and cut what doesn’t

Requirements

  • 4–7+ years of experience in B2B demand generation, field marketing, or growth marketing.
  • Proven track record of driving pipeline and revenue impact.
  • Experience working closely with Sales and Partnerships teams.
  • Strong program management skills with the ability to run multiple initiatives in parallel.
  • Analytical mindset with comfort using data to guide decisions.

﻿Advantage

  • Experience in a scale-up or high-growth B2B environment.
  • Experience supporting partner-led or indirect sales motions (B2B2B).
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot and Salesforce.com.
  • Hands-on experience with paid acquisition platforms (LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads).
  • Experience with ABM or account-based field marketing.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary plus variable or bonus tied to pipeline or revenue impact.
  • Equity participation.
  • Comprehensive benefits, PTO, and company holidays.

A FCamara está em busca de uma PessoaAnalista de Produtos Digitais Júnior (PO Jr.),para atuar em parceria com uma empresa do ramo da Educação.

﻿Missão

Contribuir para a operação de produtos digitais já com estabilidade mínima com foco em evolução contínua, atuando na especificação e refinamento do backlog a partir de requisitos de stakeholders e dados de uso, com atuação colaborativa, ética e orientada ao cliente, garantindo valor incremental para os clientes.

Principais atividades / responsabilidades

  • Refinar itens do backlog com o time, assegurando detalhamento de requisitos de negócio pactuados com partes interessadas, casosde uso, critérios de aceite claros e estimativas básicas.
  • Identificar riscos ou problemas iniciais no produto e escalá-los de forma transparente.
  • Coletar e organizar feedbacks de usuários e áreas parceiras como insumo para atividades iniciais de discovery (preferencialmente com metodologias em nível introdutório como: JTBD, design thinking, lean UX).
  • Apoiar em entrevistas e validações simples, com orientação do time de design.
  • Eventualmente, apoiar análises simples de mercado, como pesquisas de mesa (desk research) e benchmarks.
  • Registrar aprendizados e evidências para apoiar decisões futuras.
  • Acompanhar métricas básicas de uso e satisfação do produto.
  • Compartilhar aprendizados e sinais de melhoria com o time, apoiando decisões operacionais.
  • Comunicar-se com stakeholders operacionais (Suporte, Comercial, Atendimento), garantindo alinhamento sobre requisitos, dependências e status.
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com Tech, UX, Marketing e áreas parceiras no trato diário do produto.
  • Atuar como apoio no relacionamento com clientes: coletar feedbacks, registrar evidências e coordenar respostas com Suporte.
  • Apoiar o planejamento de releases e atualizações.
  • Contribuir para uma transição clara das entregas para Vendas e Suporte.
  • Apoiar a construção e manutenção do roadmap de curto-médio prazo, com alinhamento à estratégia definida para o produto.
  • Atuar no Product Ops, articulando com áreas correlatas e atendendo demandas operacionais do dia-a-dia.

Formação acadêmica

Graduação ou tecnólogo em áreas correlatas (Administração, Engenharia, TI, Design ou afins). Cursos ou extensões em Gestão de Produto são desejáveis.

Experiência profissional

Desejável de 1 à 2 anos de experiência em produto ou tecnologia, com contato com métodos ágeis e especificação de requisitos. Preferencialmente com experiência na utilização das ferramentas: Azure DevOps, PowerBi, Microsoft Clarity.

Competências comportamentais

· Comunicação clara e objetiva

· Organização e atenção a detalhes

· Colaboração no trabalho em equipe

· Ética no tratamento de informações, decisões e relacionamentos

Creating Peace of Mind by Pioneering Safety and Security


At Allegion, we help keep the people you know and love safe and secure where they live, work and visit. With more than 40 brands, 14,000+ employees globally and products sold in 130 countries, we specialize in security around the doorway and beyond.


Additionally, Allegion is proud to be recognized with the 2026 Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award (GEWA) for the third consecutive year, earning distinction in both the employee engagement and strengths categories. This year, Allegion also received Gallup’s With Distinction honor — a designation reserved for a select group of organizations that go above and beyond in building exceptional workplace cultures.


Residential Support Representative 1-US Remote

Work Schedule:

Monday to Friday 8 am -4:30pm CST.

May need to work weekends or holidays as needed.


Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States. The company does not intend to provide sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B, TN, etc.) for this employment position.


At Allegion, we recognize that great talent and breakthrough ideas can come from anywhere. That’s why this position offers a flexible remote work arrangement, with occasional on-site visits as needed based on the role. Whether you’re working remotely or collaborating in person, we’re committed to providing the tools, support, and dynamic environment you need to succeed. At Allegion, your career thrives where innovation meets flexibility, empowering you to achieve your goals while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.


While this is the current structure and we currently have no plans to change, we reserve the right to make changes to the remote schedule as needed at the Company’s discretion.


Job Summary:

As a Residential Support Representative 1, you are a crucial part of the Allegion team. You will drive consumer loyalty for the business through exceptional customer service, warranty support, pre-purchase support, technical support, and issue resolution. This role will portray a positive image for the company by providing superior customer service, accurately addressing all customer inquiries professionally and courteously, and acting as a customer advocate to continually improve customer satisfaction.


What You Will Do:

  • Provide positive customer experiences to help troubleshoot basic technical problems primarily through verbal communication over the phone, both inbound and outbound. May also need to provide support via our digital channels as needed.
  • Assist customers in troubleshooting issues with Schlage products and ensure a resolution or suitable next steps. Escalate or seek guidance from internal resources or SME’s as needed.
  • Guide customers through how-to-related inquiries such as installation, app setup, product registration, etc.
  • Be the voice of the customer by communicating case drivers and known issues to internal stakeholders, ensuring a swift resolution.
  • Build trust through complete follow-through on customer commitments.
  • Learn, develop, and maintain product knowledge of mechanical and electronic Allegion consumer products and components.
  • Level up through continued education and gaining knowledge of more complex troubleshooting scenarios and advanced Allegion products such as integrated locks.
  • Participate in ongoing training and development to enhance product knowledge and customer service skills.
  • Develop a working knowledge of all reference material, such as product catalogs, manuals, instruction sheets/templates, and price books.
  • Adhere to processes and maintain a high quality of performance.
  • Participate in team activities and engage with fellow Allegion team members positively and respectfully.
  • Meet set goals and metric expectations consistently.
  • Support Allegion's values and mission to create a customer-centric culture.



What You Need to Succeed:

  • Minimum 1 year of customer service experience preferred.
  • An HS Diploma or GED is required; an associate’s degree is preferred.
  • Ability to type 55 wpm, corrected speed.
  • 1+ years’ experience handling high-volume inquiries.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with proper grammar and punctuation knowledge.
  • Knowledge of and the ability to perform basic computer skills.
  • Working knowledge of PC-based software applications (Microsoft Office – Outlook, Word, Excel) & basic web applications.
  • Experience with Zendesk/ Five 9 and other CRM systems Preferred
  • Familiarity with and/or comfort in using smart device applications is preferred.
  • Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and manage time efficiently.
  • Ability to identify recurring customer issues.
  • Ability to develop cross-functional, professional working relationships.
  • Availability to work Monday to Friday 10-6:30PM EST. May need to work weekends or holidays as needed.
  • Bilingual in Spanish and/or French is an asset.

Why Work for Us?

Allegion is a Great Place to Grow your Career if:


  • You're seeking a rewarding opportunity that allows you to truly help others. With thousands of employees and customers around the world, there’s plenty of room to make an impact. As our values state, “this is your business, run with it”.
  • You’re looking for a company that will invest in your professional development. As we grow, we want you to grow with us.
  • You want a culture that promotes work-life balance. Our employees enjoy generous paid time off, because at Allegion we recognize that you have a full life outside of work!
  • You want to work for an award-winning company that invests in its people. Allegion is proud to be a recipient of the Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award for the second year in a row, recognizing our commitment to employee engagement, strengths-based development, and unlocking human potential.

What You’ll Get from Us:


  • Health, dental and vision insurance coverage, helping you “be safe, be healthy”
  • Competitive Paid Time Off
  • A commitment to your future with a 401K plan, which currently offers a 6% company match and no vesting period

Position Overview

Autodesk's GTM Tech organization is hiring a Senior Principal Product Manager to own the strategy, vision, and execution of Pipeline Management, Forecasting, and AI-Powered Sales Productivity. These capabilities will support our global sales force with proactive and predictive insights, productivity improvements, and a deep understanding of their customers. This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the Group Product Manager. Your stakeholder surface extends up to VP level across the CRO organization, Global Forecasting Leadership, Sales Leadership and Sales Operations, and the Salesforce and Clari platform teams.

You will own the forecasting and pipeline management experiences end to end that is used by 2,500 sellers, managers, and executives worldwide. You will also define what comes next: an AI-assisted approach to forecasting and pipeline guidance that sellers trust enough to act on.


Responsibilities

  • Own the product vision and multi-quarter roadmap for forecasting and pipeline management across Enterprise, Mid-Market, Strategic, and Territory segments, aligned to Autodesk's GTM strategy
  • Define and prioritize scalable capabilities: pipeline creation, coverage, quality, and health; opportunity inspection and prioritization; commit, best-case, upside, roll-ups, and forecast confidence and explainability
  • Identify and frame the highest-leverage problems through discovery with sellers, managers, SalesOps, and field leadership, converting insights into clear PRDs, measurable success criteria with baselines and targets, telemetry-first launches, and non-functional requirements

  • Serve as the primary product leader accountable for maximizing value across the sales organization
  • Own the vendor relationships: influence the partner roadmaps on Autodesk's behalf, hold the vendor accountable to committed capability

  • Design experiences that let sellers review forecasts, manage pipeline, update opportunities, and act on recommendations through AI assistants, conversational interfaces, Slack, Microsoft Teams, mobile, and voice, rather than depending solely on a singular classic user interface, prioritizing reliability, explainability, and trust
  • Establish frameworks for AI-assisted capabilities: adoption, task completion, seller satisfaction, error rates, and business impact
  • Influence decisions as the forecasting and pipeline SME, recommend best practices, propose tradeoffs, and guide stakeholder decisions through clear narratives and data-backed reasoning, up to VP level

  • A credible, hands-on point of view on enterprise AI, spanning predictive analytics, AI-driven recommendations, workflow automation, and agentic systems, paired with the judgment to recognize when an output is not trustworthy enough to ship

SAP TM S/4HANA Rollout Consultant, Bulgaria

Contract: 6 months initially, extensible. Long-term programme. Start: 1 November 2026 Location: Remote, for consultants based in Bulgaria. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

A global manufacturing organisation is moving its transportation processes onto SAP Transportation Management (TM) on S/4HANA. The global template is the base, and it is being rolled out to sites in waves. Each wave brings new plants, new carriers and new country requirements into the template.

You will own the TM solution for the waves you are given. You will run fit-to-standard sessions with the business, decide what the template already covers and what is a real local gap, and design the answer without breaking the global standard. You will then carry that design through build, testing, cutover and early support after go-live.

What you will work on

Fit-gap for each rollout wave. Local transport practice, carriers, legal and document needs measured against the global design. TM solution design on S/4HANA. Freight planning, carrier selection and tendering, freight order execution, charge calculation and freight settlement. Integration across the S/4HANA logistics chain. Outbound sales orders and deliveries, inbound purchasing flows, warehouse execution, and freight cost through to finance. Carrier connectivity. EDI or business network onboarding, tracking, and status messages from carriers. Functional specifications for the build team, working closely with integration, development and test leads. Test planning and defect resolution through integration and user acceptance testing. Cutover, hypercare and handover to support for each wave. Feeding what each wave teaches back into the template, so the next wave starts from a better base.

What you bring

8 or more years in SAP logistics, with SAP TM on S/4HANA as a core part of it. At least one TM rollout or global template programme for a manufacturing business, where you did the fit-gap and the solution design yourself, not only the configuration. Working knowledge of how TM connects to SD, MM, EWM and FI/CO, and where those integrations tend to break. Experience running workshops with business users and turning what they say into a design and a specification. Comfort working remotely across countries in a programme team made up of several companies.

Useful but not essential:

SAP Business Network for Logistics, or a carrier visibility platform. Both embedded and side-by-side TM deployments. Automotive, industrial or process manufacturing. Multimodal, international or dangerous goods transport. SAP TM certification.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent TM rollout: the countries or sites in scope, whether TM was embedded or side-by-side, and what you personally designed.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced SAP TM people in front of a global manufacturing organisation.

About the Client

We're helping a growing AI and process automation consultancy based in Munich, Germany find a Senior AI Automation Engineer to design and deliver sophisticated automation and AI-powered business solutions.

The company works with small and medium-sized businesses across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland, helping them streamline operations, improve efficiency, and scale through intelligent automation. Its solutions span CRM systems, AI agents, automated workflows, business intelligence, and custom software integrations.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior AI Automation Engineer who combines a strong software development background with advanced hands-on experience in automation engineering and AI integrations.

You'll design and build complex automation systems, integrate AI technologies, develop custom code, and create tailored software solutions when existing platforms aren't sufficient.

Working closely with the founder and delivery team, you'll take ownership of projects from requirements gathering and technical design through development, deployment, and optimization.

This isn't a role for someone who only builds simple automations. We're looking for a software engineer who understands system architecture, can solve complex technical challenges, and knows when to use low-code platforms versus custom development.

Role Details

Commitment: Full-Time (40 hours/week)
Working Hours: CET
Location: Fully Remote
Engagement: Independent Contractor
Monthly Rate: $1,800-$2,400 (can be higher, depending on level of experience)

What You'll Do

AI Automation & Workflow Development

  • Design, build, and maintain complex automation workflows using n8n, Make.com, and Zapier.

  • Develop end-to-end integrations connecting business applications, APIs, databases, CRMs, and AI models.

  • Build and optimize HubSpot CRM automations, including contacts, deals, pipelines, properties, and workflows.

  • Develop AI-powered solutions and agents for sales, research, customer support, and other business processes.

  • Troubleshoot and optimize workflows for reliability, scalability, and maintainability.

Software Development & AI Systems

  • Develop custom integrations, scripts, and applications using JavaScript/TypeScript and/or Python.

  • Design robust system architectures involving APIs, webhooks, databases, and authentication.

  • Build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems using LLMs, embeddings, document retrieval, and vector databases.

  • Evaluate existing platforms and develop custom solutions when off-the-shelf tools are insufficient.

  • Apply software engineering and cybersecurity best practices to ensure secure, reliable, and maintainable systems.

Project Ownership & Collaboration

  • Take ownership of projects from requirements gathering and solution design through testing, deployment, and optimization.

  • Translate business requirements into practical technical solutions.

  • Collaborate with the founder and delivery team on technical decisions and project execution.

  • Maintain clear documentation and high standards of quality.

  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve systems, workflows, and development processes.

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

  • Several years (at least 3+) of professional software development experience, complemented by substantial hands-on automation engineering experience.

  • Advanced proficiency in n8n and Make.com, including complex, multi-step workflows and integrations.

  • Strong hands-on experience with HubSpot CRM, including its data structures, pipelines, properties, and automation capabilities.

  • Practical experience building RAG-based AI systems, including LLM integrations, embeddings, document retrieval, and vector databases.

  • Strong programming skills in JavaScript/TypeScript and/or Python.

  • Solid understanding of APIs, webhooks, databases, authentication, and system architecture.

  • Experience developing AI-powered workflows, LLM integrations, and AI agents.

  • Ability to independently design, troubleshoot, and deliver complex technical solutions.

  • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with Zapier, Close CRM, or other automation and CRM platforms.

  • Familiarity with Claude Code or similar AI-assisted development tools.

  • Experience building custom business applications or replacing/extending SaaS platforms.

  • Background in an AI automation consultancy, agency, or client-facing technical environment.

  • Previous technical leadership experience.

Ideal Candidate Profile

You're a software engineer at heart who understands both traditional development and modern automation platforms. You know when to use n8n or Make.com, when custom code is necessary, and how to design solutions that are secure, scalable, and maintainable.

You're analytical, structured, detail-oriented, and methodical in your approach. You think through technical challenges carefully, make logical and well-reasoned decisions, and value precision and quality over quick fixes.

You're also reliable, accountable, and calm under pressure. You take ownership of projects, communicate proactively, and can be trusted to deliver consistently high-quality work with minimal supervision.

Above all, you're curious about emerging AI technologies and motivated to build practical, innovative solutions that solve real business problems.

Why Join?

  • Work on complex AI automation, RAG, CRM integration, and custom software projects.

  • Collaborate closely with the founder of a growing AI consultancy serving the DACH market.

  • Take ownership of technical solutions with significant autonomy.

  • Help shape technical standards, processes, and future engineering capabilities.

  • Join a long-term, fully remote opportunity with room for professional growth.

Recruitment Process

  1. Initial Interview with Bamboo Works

  2. Client Interview

  3. Technical Assessment / Test Assignment

  4. Offer & Onboarding

The technical assessment will take place after the interview stage.

About the Job



Welcome to Ovation Healthcare!

At Ovation Healthcare (formerly QHR Health), we’ve been making local healthcare better for more than 40 years. Our mission is to strengthen independent community healthcare. We provide independent hospitals and health systems with the support, guidance and tech-enabled shared services needed to remain strong and viable. With a strong sense of purpose and commitment to operating excellence, we help rural healthcare providers fulfill their missions.

The Ovation Healthcare difference is the extraordinary combination of operations experience and consulting guidance that fulfills our mission of creating a sustainable future for healthcare organizations. Ovation Healthcare’s vision is to be a dynamic, integrated professional services company delivering innovative and executable solutions through experience and thought leadership, while valuing trust, respect, and customer focused behavior.

We’re looking for talented, motivated professionals with a desire to help independent hospitals thrive. Working with Ovation Healthcare, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with highly skilled subject matter specialists and operations executives, in a collegial atmosphere of professionalism and teamwork.

Ovation Healthcare’s corporate headquarters is located in Brentwood, TN. For more information, visit .


GENERAL SUMMARY:

The Patient Access Scheduler reflects the mission, vision, and values of Amplify RCM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines, and all other regulatory and accreditation standards. This position reports to the Patient Access Manager.


This detail-oriented, patient-focused role is responsible for scheduling hospital outpatient services, patient information, and ensuring a seamless registration process. The ideal candidate will understand human anatomy, medical terminology, CPT codes, ICD-10 codes, and medical insurance. The candidate must also have excellent communication skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to provide outstanding customer service in a fast- paced environment.


DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Confirm necessary authorizations for hospital outpatient procedures.

• Update demographic and insurance information in the hospital's system.

• Communicate appointment details and preparation instructions to patients.

• Handle patient inquiries, reschedule appointments, and manage cancellations professionally.

• Work closely with hospital departments, including radiology, cardiology, and surgical services, to ensure seamless scheduling processes.

• Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with HIPAA regulations.

• Utilize hospital scheduling software and electronic health records (EHR) efficiently.


KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

• Knowledge of medical terminology and insurance verification.

• Strong customer service and communication skills.

• Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment.

• Proficiency in electronic medical records (EMR) and hospital scheduling software


WORK EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS:

100% Remote

raw.title: Software Engineer, Voice - Milan
raw.excerpt: If you are here, it is because you know that we are looking for a Software Engineer, Voice for our Product team.
raw.description:
If you are here, it is because you know that we are looking for a Software Engineer, Voice for our Product team.

indigo.ai is the leading platform in Italy for building next-generation AI Agents that transform the way companies communicate with their customers. Since 2016, we’ve been helping enterprises in industries such as finance, insurance, utilities, retail, and e-commerce to evolve their Customer Experience through conversational AI. We don’t just “sell software”: we enable a shift in how organizations interact with people, automating millions of conversations every year, reducing operational costs, improving conversion rates, and creating more personalized, scalable, and compliant customer journeys.

Backed by a recent €10 million investment from Azimut, we are on a mission to take this technology global. This is a unique opportunity to join a well-funded, highly ambitious team and play a direct role in shaping the future of enterprise AI.

To make this happen, we are looking for a Software Engineer, Voice to support our Chief Product Development Officer in making talking to AI on the phone feel human.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for a Software Engineer, Voice to own the real-time voice layer of our AI Agents. Voice is where conversational AI is being decided right now, and our voice agents already handle production phone traffic for large companies. The bar is moving fast: we want to make the leap from "works reliably" to "feels human on a real phone line", and we want one person to own that leap. This is a specialist role with end-to-end ownership: the architecture, the model and provider choices, the latency budget, the way a conversation feels. You'll join our Product Engineering team, reporting to our Chief Product Development Officer, as our first full-time engineer dedicated to voice. And if voice grows the way we believe it will, you'll shape the team that grows around it.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the real-time voice pipeline end-to-end. From audio ingress on the telephony edge, through streaming STT and turn-taking, to the agent brain and back out through streaming TTS. Every millisecond in between is yours.

  • Engineer how fast the agent feels. Semantic end-of-turn detection, preemptive generation on partial transcripts, eager TTS, filler and backchannel strategies that mask tool calls. All measured on real 8kHz phone audio, not in a browser demo.

  • Make turn-taking human. Barge-in that survives noisy lines. Endpointing policies that know the dialog state, so a caller never gets cut off mid-IBAN. The difference between an IVR and a conversation lives here.

  • Raise voice quality on the channel that actually ships: the phone. Benchmark and A/B STT and TTS providers on real G.711 calls (Italian first: WER, naturalness, numbers and codes read right), exploit wideband/HD voice where the carrier allows it, and experiment with context-aware TTS and conversational speech models as they mature.

  • Build the evaluation harness. Turn "this voice sounds better" into numbers we trust: per-stage latency budgets, turn-taking metrics, regression suites on recorded calls, quality gates before anything reaches a client.

  • Keep production boringly reliable. Per-stage observability, live-call incident debugging (dead air, stuck turns, provider hiccups), graceful degradation when a vendor blinks.

  • Track a weekly-moving ecosystem and turn it into strategy. New STT/TTS/speech-to-speech releases land every month. You decide what we integrate, what we self-host for EU compliance and data residency, and what we skip. And you make provider swaps cheap.

You will need:

The filter is not your degree, and it's not years-of-experience arithmetic. It's having built it. Tell us about a real-time voice or audio system you designed and shipped: the latency budget, where it broke, and what you changed to make it feel right. That tells us more than any title.

  • Real-time audio systems, shipped. You've built voice agents, telephony systems, conferencing or live-streaming products that ran in production. You know what it means to move audio over WebSockets/WebRTC, through codecs (G.711/μ-law, Opus), against a latency budget.

  • The modern voice AI stack, hands-on. Streaming STT and TTS, VAD and turn detection, voice orchestration frameworks (Pipecat, LiveKit Agents or equivalent), speech-to-speech models. You have opinions on the trade-offs, grounded in things you've actually built, not blog posts.

  • Strong software engineering. TypeScript/Node.js and/or Python, and the maturity to own a production service end-to-end: containers, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, observability.

  • A latency obsession. You think in milliseconds per stage, you instrument before you optimize, and you know the difference between measured and perceived latency, and how to exploit it.

  • A product ear. You can hear the difference between a demo and a conversation, and you can translate what you hear into engineering priorities and measurable evals.

  • An AI-native way of working. You use agentic coding tools (e.g. Claude Code) daily and you're good at directing them: setting up the problem, judging the output.

  • Language Skills: Fluent English.

We will really like (but they are not required):

  • Italian: our voice market is Italian-first, and you'll be tuning pronunciation, prosody and evals for it every week.

  • Contact-center / CCaaS ecosystem experience: SIP trunking, SBCs, enterprise telephony platforms.

  • ML audio experience: evaluating or fine-tuning ASR/TTS models, working with speech datasets.

  • Elixir: our agent platform is built on it.

  • Open source: contributions to open-source voice/audio projects.

Our values:

At indigo.ai we prize Vision (curiosity and courage to challenge the status quo), Connection (empathy, candor, and trust), Responsibility (ownership, reliability, and follow-through), and Excellence (the habit of raising the bar and refining until it’s right). If you naturally think ahead, build strong relationships, take accountability, and obsess over the quality of what you deliver, we’re probably a great match.

What do we offer?

  • A key role in one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI scale-ups, backed by a €10M investment from Azimut.

  • A competitive salary in the range of 40-70k RAL, commensurate with experience + a performance-based Bonus.

  • A flexible, remote-friendly work environment.

  • Meal vouchers and Welfare programs to support your everyday life.

  • Access to a dedicated education budget for continued learning and growth.

  • Career Development Plan, ensuring a clear path for both personal and professional growth.

  • Top-grade equipment, which may include a MacBook Air, iPhone, and other top-tier devices.

  • Unlimited coffee.

  • Company retreats in stunning locations throughout the year.

Where is the job?

This position is fully remote, so there's no need to be in a specific location to do your work. That said, we have an amazing office at SPACES, Piazza Gae Aulenti 1/Torre B in Milan, available to anyone who wants to use it. We also love getting together and organize various retreats and meetups throughout the year to stay connected.

Why join us?

At indigo.ai you’ll be part of a fast-growing SaaS company where your ideas and work can turn into products used by millions. Join us and you’ll:

  • Work with the most advanced AI technologies, shaping how enterprises across industries engage with their customers.

  • Be part of a dynamic and passionate team, where everyone has a direct impact on company growth.

  • Grow in a culture that values transparency, continuous learning, and career development, with clear paths for personal and professional progression.

  • Enjoy a flexible, people-first environment, with remote-friendly policies, stunning retreats, and a strong focus on well-being.

  • Contribute to our mission of reshaping how companies and people communicate worldwide.

Company Overview

At Avahi, we’re redefining what it means to be a premier cloud-first consulting company, recognized for our people, culture, and innovative solutions. With expertise in Managed Services, Staffing, and Professional Services, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional value and putting customers first.

As a remote-first, global team spanning North America, Europe, and Southeast Asia, we foster a collaborative and diverse environment where professional growth, creativity, and mutual respect thrive. Guided by our values—Customer-Centricity, Collaboration, Agility, Innovation, Integrity, and Diversity & Inclusion—we empower businesses to embrace the full potential of a cloud-first approach.

Role Summary

Avahi is seeking a results-driven Account Manager to engage with potential AWS clients and drive business growth. In this role, you will build and nurture relationships with key decision-makers, collaborate with AWS teams, and position Avahi as a trusted partner in cloud solutions. The ideal candidate will have experience in consultative selling, a strong understanding of AWS services, and the ability to identify opportunities for cloud transformation projects.

As part of our dynamic and collaborative team, you will play a pivotal role in growing Avahi’s footprint within the AWS ecosystem by delivering innovative solutions to our clients.

Due to our team structure and collaboration needs, this role is open to candidates in the following locations: Southern California, Boston, Austin, or Seattle.

Key Responsibilities 

Business Development

  • Identify, qualify, and close new business opportunities within assigned territories or verticals.
  • Develop account strategies to achieve revenue goals and expand Avahi’s customer base.
  • Build productive relationships with AWS sales teams to foster collaboration and drive mutual success.

Client Relationship Management

  • Establish and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including C-level executives, at client organizations.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor by understanding clients' challenges and aligning Avahi’s cloud solutions to address their needs.
  • Engage clients with tailored presentations and solutions that showcase Avahi’s expertise in AWS cloud transformation.

Solution Selling

  • Collaborate with Avahi’s technical teams and Solutions Architects to craft customized proposals for cloud migrations, modernization, and DevOps services.
  • Lead discussions with clients to demonstrate the ROI of AWS solutions and secure buy-in from decision-makers.

Pipeline and Reporting

Collaboration and Teamwork

  • Collaborate with marketing teams on prospecting campaigns and demand-generation activities.
  • Share insights and feedback to enhance Avahi’s sales strategies and service offerings.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Proven experience in a sales or account management role, ideally within a technology or cloud services company.
  • Strong understanding of AWS cloud services and their applications in solving business challenges.
  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage C-level executives.
  • Experience managing complex sales cycles and navigating technical discussions with clients.
  • Familiarity with HubSpot or similar CRM for pipeline management and reporting.
  • A consultative sales approach with a focus on delivering tailored solutions to clients.

Bonus Qualifications

  • AWS Cloud Practitioner certification or equivalent knowledge of AWS services.
  • Experience working with or for an AWS Partner organization.
  • Familiarity with sales methodologies like MEDDIC, Challenger, or Sandler.
  • Strong network within the AWS ecosystem or cloud computing industry.

Why Work Here

raw.description:
About Us

At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 250 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data.

For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data, quickly, dependably, and at scale. And today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Today, over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.

The Integration Squad helps developers and data teams find, adopt and keep using Zyte for web data. We focus on coding agents and agent-based workflows. We make Zyte API and Scrapy Cloud easy to reach from the tools people already use: coding agents like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor; frameworks like LangChain and LlamaIndex; cloud platforms like AWS and Google Cloud; and later, automation and app-building tools. We measure success by how many customers use Zyte through these integrations, not by how many integrations we publish.

We’re hiring an Integrations Engineer to help build this program from the start. You’ll build and publish integrations, including MCP-based setups, a Zyte command-line tool (CLI), framework packages and data-delivery connectors. You’ll also write the documentation that lets developers and their agents use them without help, and the tracking that shows whether they work.

We employ agile methodologies and work in cross-functional pods, which lets us respond quickly to both community feedback and internal product needs.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Build and publish integrations that bring Zyte into coding-agent environments (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Docker), building on the existing Zyte MCP server.
  • Design, build and release the Zyte CLI as a shared base for integrations, published to both PyPI and npm.
  • Build and maintain packages and tools for developer frameworks and agent SDKs (e.g. LangChain, LlamaIndex) and for browser automation tools.
  • Build recurring data delivery into customers’ cloud and data platforms (e.g. AWS, Google Cloud Storage and BigQuery, Snowflake), reusing existing export routes where possible.
  • Assess app and automation platforms (e.g. Dify, Flowise, Make, Zapier, Lovable, Replit). Prototype integrations or templates where they’ll lead to repeat Zyte use.
  • Give early engineering estimates of feasibility, effort, dependencies and upkeep for each candidate integration, to help decide what we build next.
  • Add tracking so signups and usage can be traced back to each integration, and report gaps where tracking isn’t possible.
  • Write clear setup guides, examples and docs that work for both people and coding agents, on docs.zyte.com and in public repositories.
  • Prepare and manage submissions to partner directories, registries and marketplaces, including responding to partner review feedback.
  • Maintain live integrations: keep up with changes in partner tools, fix issues, and handle releases and versioning.
  • Work with Product, Product Marketing and Developer Relations on launches, positioning and community support.
  • Work with the SaaS and Platform teams to keep the Zyte API and Scrapy Cloud surfaces that integrations rely on stable.
  • Take part in code reviews, planning and squad routines.

Requirements

  • Strong Python skills and solid TypeScript/Node.js. You’ll publish packages in both ecosystems.
  • Experience building SDKs, client libraries, CLIs, plugins or third-party integrations used by outside developers.
  • Hands-on use of coding agents and AI tooling (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex), and familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar tool-calling interfaces.
  • Experience publishing and maintaining packages (PyPI, npm), including versioning, CI/CD, tests and releases.
  • Good working knowledge of REST APIs and authentication, including keeping credentials secure in client and server setups.
  • An outcome-focused mindset: you care whether developers adopt and keep using what you ship, and you use data to decide what to improve.
  • Clear writing in English. Documentation and examples are a core part of the job.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and early-stage scoping in a new squad.
  • Experience in a distributed, remote-first team is a strong plus.
  • Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex or agent SDKs is a plus.
  • Experience with AWS or GCP data services (S3, Cloud Storage, BigQuery) or Snowflake is a plus.
  • Familiarity with web scraping, Scrapy or browser automation (Playwright, Selenium) is a plus, but not required.
  • Open-source maintenance or Developer Relations experience is a plus.

Benefits

As a new Zytan, you will:

Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team.

Have the freedom and flexibility to work from where you do your best work.

Work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools.

35 days paid holidays
