raw.description:
Social Discovery Group (SDG) is a group of social discovery companies. SDG solves the problems of loneliness, isolation, and disconnection - transforming virtual intimacy into the new normal. SDG’s products redefine the way people interact and connect with one another.

Our portfolio includes social entertainment platforms designed to connect people online across different cultures and regions of the world.

We bring together a team of like-minded people and IT professionals who specialize in creating and developing globally impactful social discovery products. Our international team of digital nomads works remotely from all over the world.

We’re proud to be a two-time “Great Place to Work” winner (USA & Japan, 2024–2025) and a Top-5 Company for Work-From-Anywhere Jobs (FlexJobs, 2025).

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Product Analyst to become the independent analytical voice of our Matching & Relationships team. You'll work across several closely connected product areas - spanning matchmaking, messaging and AI-assisted user experiences - and help us answer the questions that matter: are we moving in the right direction, and where do we invest the least effort for the greatest impact?

This isn't a role about building pretty dashboards. It's about designing rigorous experiments, challenging assumptions with data, and turning numbers into decisions. If you believe in the craft of real analytics - not just prompting an AI for a chart - and you like being the person who keeps the team honest with the data, you'll feel at home here. You'll partner directly with the product managers behind each area and report to the Head of Product, who cares deeply about analytics and will be a highly engaged collaborator.

What you'll do

  • Design and run product experiments end to end - form hypotheses, define test duration and required sample size, assess whether the expected result is achievable, evaluate A/B tests and determine statistical significance.
  • Unify metrics across our product areas into one coherent picture, cascading them from our core company metric (MAP) down to the drivers of acquisition, retention, reactivation and churn.
  • Be the independent analytical check on whether the team is moving in the right direction - grounding decisions in data rather than intuition.
  • Find the highest-leverage growth opportunities - where the smallest effort delivers the biggest effect on key metrics.
  • Track whether we're winning in the numbers - connect metrics to goals, estimates and costs, and flag early when we drift off course.
  • Generate, prioritize and validate hypotheses ("what would happen if…?") together with product managers.
  • Investigate anomalies and metric deviations, get to the root cause, and raise the alarm on product issues before they grow.
  • Calibrate our work against corporate goals and challenge the flood of initiatives with a clear, numbers-based point of view.
  • Improve our analytical processes where you see room - we're an open team and we act on good ideas.

What we're looking for

Must-have:

  • 4+ years in product analytics, ideally at a product with large data volumes.
  • A degree in mathematics, engineering or a related technical field.
  • Strong command of mathematical statistics and probability theory, applied in practice.
  • Proven, hands-on experience designing and running A/B tests — including sizing, significance and interpretation.
  • Fluency in SQL and Python; comfortable with data extraction, processing and visualization (Superset a plus).
  • Deep understanding of product and marketing metrics — LTV, CPA, Retention, CR — and how they connect to the business.
  • Product thinking — you see the user behavior behind every metric.
  • High autonomy and ownership — you find the growth points yourself and see them through to impact.
  • Critical thinking — you question the data and the decisions around it, and cross-check your conclusions.
  • Clear communication — you back arguments with numbers, explain the complex simply, and structure findings around a clear recommendation and estimated impact.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with products where data and causal inference are central - social products, dating, gaming, or two-sided marketplaces (B2B + B2C).
  • Hands-on experience with recommender systems.
  • Background at a data-rich, high-volume product.

What do we offer

  • REMOTE OPPORTUNITY to work full-time.
  • Vacation 28 calendar days per year.
  • 7 wellness days per year (time off) that can be used to deal with household issues, to lie down and recover without taking sick leave.
  • Bonuses up to $5000 for recommending successful applicants for positions in the company.
  • 50% payment for professional training, international conferences, and meetings.
  • Corporate discount for English lessons.
  • Health benefits. According to the paychecks, if you are not eligible for corporate medical insurance, the company will compensate you with up to $ 1,000 gross per year per employee. This can be spent on self-purchase of health insurance or on doctor’s fees for yourself and close relatives (spouse, children).
  • ​Workplace organization. The company provides all employees with an equipped workplace and all the necessary equipment (table, armchair, wifi, etc.) in our offices or co-working locations. In the other locations, the company provides reimbursement of workplace costs up to $ 1000 gross once every 3 years, according to the paychecks. This money can be spent on the rent of the co-working room, on equipping the working place at home (desk, chair, Internet, etc.) during those 3 years.
  • Internal gamified gratitude system: receive bonuses from colleagues and exchange them for our merchandise, team building activities, massage certificates, etc.

Sounds good? Join us now!
The initial pay level or pay range for this role will be shared with candidates during the recruitment process and before the commencement of employment.

raw.description:
SAP TM S/4HANA Rollout Consultant, Czechia

Contract: 6 months initially, extensible. Long-term programme. Start: 1 November 2026 Location: Remote, for consultants based in Czechia. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

A global manufacturing organisation is moving its transportation processes onto SAP Transportation Management (TM) on S/4HANA. The global template is the base, and it is being rolled out to sites in waves. Each wave brings new plants, new carriers and new country requirements into the template.

You will own the TM solution for the waves you are given. You will run fit-to-standard sessions with the business, decide what the template already covers and what is a real local gap, and design the answer without breaking the global standard. You will then carry that design through build, testing, cutover and early support after go-live.

What you will work on

Fit-gap for each rollout wave. Local transport practice, carriers, legal and document needs measured against the global design. TM solution design on S/4HANA. Freight planning, carrier selection and tendering, freight order execution, charge calculation and freight settlement. Integration across the S/4HANA logistics chain. Outbound sales orders and deliveries, inbound purchasing flows, warehouse execution, and freight cost through to finance. Carrier connectivity. EDI or business network onboarding, tracking, and status messages from carriers. Functional specifications for the build team, working closely with integration, development and test leads. Test planning and defect resolution through integration and user acceptance testing. Cutover, hypercare and handover to support for each wave. Feeding what each wave teaches back into the template, so the next wave starts from a better base.

What you bring

8 or more years in SAP logistics, with SAP TM on S/4HANA as a core part of it. At least one TM rollout or global template programme for a manufacturing business, where you did the fit-gap and the solution design yourself, not only the configuration. Working knowledge of how TM connects to SD, MM, EWM and FI/CO, and where those integrations tend to break. Experience running workshops with business users and turning what they say into a design and a specification. Comfort working remotely across countries in a programme team made up of several companies.

Useful but not essential:

SAP Business Network for Logistics, or a carrier visibility platform. Both embedded and side-by-side TM deployments. Automotive, industrial or process manufacturing. Multimodal, international or dangerous goods transport. SAP TM certification.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent TM rollout: the countries or sites in scope, whether TM was embedded or side-by-side, and what you personally designed.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced SAP TM people in front of a global manufacturing organisation.

We are seeking a Marketing Operations Strategist to develop and execute strategic marketing plans that drive brand awareness, customer acquisition, and revenue growth. You will build repeatable, measurable marketing systems that align with company goals, using HubSpot, AI-driven automation, and data science to turn marketing data into smarter decisions. This role is ideal for a results-driven, creative, and collaborative leader with a strong B2B SaaS background who enjoys managing projects, documenting processes, analyzing performance, and optimizing the website for better user experience, conversion rates, and lead generation.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing Strategy & Planning

  • Design and execute a comprehensive marketing strategy aligned with company objectives, target markets, and healthcare IT industry trends.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to define marketing goals, KPIs, and budgets.

AI-Focused Marketing Workflows

  • Design and implement AI-powered workflows for lead scoring, content generation, audience segmentation, chatbots, and campaign personalization.
  • Evaluate and integrate AI tools (including HubSpot's AI features) into the marketing stack, with clear guidelines for quality, brand voice, and HIPAA-conscious data use.

Data Science & Marketing Analytics

  • Apply statistical analysis, predictive modeling, and attribution modeling to forecast pipeline, identify high-value segments, and measure channel effectiveness.
  • Design and analyze A/B and multivariate tests across emails, landing pages, and website experiences, turning results into actionable recommendations.

HubSpot & Marketing Automation

  • Manage HubSpot (Marketing, Sales, Service, and CMS Hubs), including automation workflows, processes, and data hygiene.
  • Analyze reports and dashboards in HubSpot to track KPIs, campaign performance, and ROI for stakeholders.

Campaign & Website Optimization

  • Build and manage the email marketing program from segmentation to execution.
  • Improve forms, email templates, landing pages, and website experiences to increase conversion rates and lead generation.

Project Management & Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Manage marketing operations projects from initiation to completion, tracking progress, risks, and bottlenecks to stay on schedule and within budget.
  • Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Service teams to integrate processes and document repeatable workflows.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Management, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • At least 5 years of experience in marketing, marketing operations, and project management, preferably in B2B SaaS.
  • Advanced expertise in HubSpot (Marketing, Sales, Service, and CMS Hubs) and strong proficiency in marketing automation technologies.
  • Hands-on experience building AI-assisted marketing workflows (e.g., predictive lead scoring, AI content tools, chatbots, or personalization).
  • Strong analytical and statistical skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
  • Advanced database management and data visualization skills.
  • Solid understanding of customer journey mapping and business processes.
  • Excellent project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple projects at once.
  • Strong communication skills, including knowing how to ask the right questions and turn answers into systems.

Preferred

  • HubSpot certifications (Marketing, Sales, Operations, or related).
  • Experience as a HubSpot trainer or in HubSpot customer support.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, Python, or R for marketing data analysis.
  • Experience with BI tools such as Looker Studio, Tableau, or Power BI.
  • Familiarity with marketing attribution, predictive analytics, or machine learning concepts.
  • Experience marketing to healthcare providers or in health IT, with awareness of HIPAA considerations.

A Day in the Life

Your day blends strategy, systems, and data. You might start by reviewing HubSpot dashboards to check overnight campaign results and pipeline movement, then meet with Sales to refine how AI-driven lead scores route new leads to the right reps. Later, you could be building an automated nurture workflow that personalizes content by specialty, analyzing an A/B test on a demo-request landing page, or running a quick attribution analysis to show leadership which channels are actually driving booked demos. Along the way, you're cleaning up data, documenting processes so they can be repeated, keeping marketing projects on track, and testing new AI tools to see where they can save the team time without compromising quality.

Success Metrics

  • Pipeline and revenue growth: Measurable increases in marketing-qualified leads (MQLs), demo requests, and marketing-sourced revenue.
  • Conversion improvements: Higher conversion rates across the website, landing pages, forms, and email campaigns, validated through A/B testing.
  • AI-driven efficiency: AI and automation workflows in place that reduce manual work, improve lead scoring accuracy, and speed up campaign execution.
  • Data quality and insight: Clean, reliable HubSpot data and accurate dashboards and attribution reporting that leadership uses to make decisions.
  • Operational excellence: Marketing projects delivered on time and within budget, with documented, repeatable processes adopted across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Service.

Make finance transformation happen

We are looking for an experienced Finance Transformation Delivery Lead to turn an ambitious FY27 change agenda into measurable, well-controlled delivery.

This is a high-visibility role at the centre of a multi-entity, highly acquisitive international group. You will connect strategy with execution across a portfolio of finance transformation programmes, ensuring that plans are integrated, dependencies are actively managed and teams are set up to deliver.

A major part of the role will be supporting acquisitions. You will lead the finance integration journey from Day 1 readiness through to a stable handover, working with country finance teams, functional leaders, vendors and an offshore build team. You will also help deliver major change across NetSuite, including chart of accounts and multi-book, O2C and P2P, e-invoicing and Brazil tax reform.

This is an opportunity to shape how Finance Transformation delivers change: creating a consistent way of working, developing project managers and bringing the right level of pace, transparency and accountability to a complex portfolio.

What you'll do

Lead the integrated delivery plan

  • Own the single integrated plan across the FY27 finance transformation programmes.
    - Set sequencing and priorities across each quarter, making dependencies, decision points, delivery gates and build capacity visible.
    - Coordinate delivery across programmes so that teams can plan effectively and issues are addressed early.
    - Work closely with the Senior ERP Manager to align demand with offshore build capacity.

Deliver acquisition integrations

  • Own the finance integration plan for each acquisition from Day 1 readiness through to handover.
    - Coordinate entity onboarding, chart of accounts mapping, close activities and related finance readiness requirements.
    - Work with country finance teams and other stakeholders to resolve issues and maintain momentum.
    - Ensure every integration has a clear knowledge-capture deliverable, with appropriate funding agreed before delivery begins.
    - Hand delivery to the named run-side integration lead once the agreed outcomes and handover requirements are complete.

Provide strong programme control

  • Maintain the portfolio RAID log and ensure risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies have clear owners and actions.
    - Identify slippage early and drive recovery within agreed tolerances.
    - Escalate when thresholds are crossed, including proposing recovery plans or a re-baseline to the Director.
    - Prepare weekly reporting for the Director and the monthly programme board.
    - Provide the evidence required for quarterly outcomes assessments.

Build trusted senior relationships

  • Act as the day-to-day delivery contact for country finance teams, finance function owners and vendors.
    - Be the first point of resolution for delivery disputes involving country finance or stakeholders outside Finance.
    - Build confidence through clear communication, fact-based reporting and consistent follow-through.
    - Balance the needs of global standards with the practical realities of local finance teams and statutory requirements.

Develop the delivery team and approach

  • Lead, coach and develop the project managers across the portfolio.
    - Establish a consistent delivery method, governance rhythm and set of templates.
    - Create an environment where project managers can move between programmes quickly and work to a common standard.
    - Promote practical knowledge sharing and ensure lessons from each migration are captured and reused.

Drive readiness, go-live and handover

  • Coordinate the evidence required for each go/no-go decision.
    - Ensure readiness risks are visible and owned before a programme reaches its critical gates.
    - Produce a complete handover pack for the run owner.
    - Obtain the run owner’s sign-off, marking the formal end of delivery responsibility.

The environment

You will be working in a complex and fast-moving finance transformation landscape, including:

  • A multi-entity, acquisitive international group.

- NetSuite as the core ERP platform.

  • Finance teams across Europe, Brazil and other countries.
    - A significant FY27 M&A integration workload.
    - Chart of accounts and multi-book transformation.
    - O2C and P2P improvements.
    - Regulatory change, including e-invoicing and Brazil tax reform.
    - Distributed delivery, with build capability in the Philippines working EMEA hours.

This role is about making complex change happen. You will bring structure, pace, transparency and effective decision-making across the portfolio. Those responsibilities remain with the Director, Group Finance technical accounting, ERP and build teams, and the relevant function owners.

Why this role matters

You will have a direct influence on how Finance Transformation delivers one of the group’s most important change portfolios. You will work at the intersection of M&A, finance, technology and operations, helping newly acquired businesses integrate quickly while improving the foundations of the wider finance function.

Success in this role will be visible: clearer plans, faster issue resolution, confident country teams, stronger project managers and finance programmes that reach go-live with the right evidence and a clean handover.

What we are looking for

You will bring:

  • Significant experience leading complex finance transformation, ERP or business change programmes.
    - Strong programme planning and dependency management skills across multiple workstreams.
    - Experience managing acquisition or entity integrations, ideally from Day 1 through to operational handover.
    - The confidence to work with senior stakeholders, country finance teams, vendors and delivery teams.
    - A track record of identifying risks early and recovering delivery when plans move off track.

Required

  • Highly structured, outcome-focused and comfortable managing ambiguity
  • Credible partner to senior finance, technology and business leaders
  • Relentless on clarity, pace and delivery discipline
  • Has led finance integration for acquisitions, from Day 1 readiness through entity onboarding and close to handover.
  • Has delivered ERP or finance transformation programmes end to end in a multi-entity group, with several workstreams and dependencies running at once.
  • Knows finance well enough to challenge country finance directors on dates and scope: record to report, month-end close, statutory and tax reporting.
  • Has run delivery with offshore build teams across time zones, and has led project managers or a PMO.
  • Has worked as the senior delivery lead under a design authority: decides how delivery runs, and escalates anything that changes scope, design or outcomes.
  • Has handed programmes to a named run owner with formal acceptance.
  • Can brief a CFO on status and risk in plain terms.

• Fluent English.

Nice-to-have:

• Knowledge of NetSuite or Oracle.

  • Experience building a repeatable integration playbook.
  • Brazil or regulatory change programmes such as e-invoicing.
  • A recognised programme method certification, and Portuguese.

Brand Director

As Brand Director, you'll lead with vision, craft, and strategy, shaping how brands show up across every digital and physical touchpoint. Building on Parallel's reputation for design, you'll own the creative direction and strategic development of brand experiences that resonate with people, move the business, and expand what a brand can be in a digital-first world.

As a director, you'll pair thought leadership with hands-on mentorship. You'll create the conditions for teams to do their best work, and make sure every brand we touch carries clarity, creativity, and craft.

What You'll Do

Lead the work

  • Define the vision for brand design at Parallel and raise our brand practice to a new level of creative excellence.

  • Guide and mentor brand designers at every level, through the whole journey from insight to identity to expression.

  • Partner with clients strategically, helping founders and executives shape, evolve, and scale their brands for a digital-first world.

  • Build and refine brand systems that carry cleanly into product experiences, marketing, and motion.

  • Make sure every engagement, ours or a client's, holds clarity, consistency, and purpose.

Shape creative direction

  • Drive the creative process on major brand initiatives, setting the tone for identity systems, storytelling frameworks, and brand guidelines.

  • Work closely with product design leadership so brand and product feel like one coherent experience.

  • Lead cross-disciplinary critique, lifting the team's fluency in storytelling, systems thinking, and craft.

  • Push creative boundaries with motion, 3D, and interaction to create brand moments that feel alive.

Champion collaboration and growth

  • Partner with design leadership and help win new work by pitching bold, brand-led approaches.

  • Keep Parallel's own brand at the highest bar of craft and cohesion across everything we put out.

  • Build a team culture rooted in openness, mentorship, and curiosity, where designers grow and thrive.

  • Connect brand, product, and marketing so the experience holds together end to end.

What You Bring

  • Visionary brand leadership. You inspire creative excellence, communicate a clear and compelling brand vision, and earn client trust. You balance creative risk with strategic rigour, so every direction is both aspirational and grounded in business value.

  • Hands-on craft. You don't just direct great design, you do it. As one of the most senior makers in the room, you lead by example with exceptional craft and detail, and bring real design energy to pitches, reviews, and live work.

  • Brand systems expertise. You turn complex ideas into coherent, scalable systems across visual, verbal, and experiential, and you know how an identity holds up across environments, from a screen to motion to a physical moment.

  • Strategic storytelling. You see brand as narrative, where story, identity, and experience meet, and you guide teams and clients to articulate what makes their brand meaningful and distinct.

  • Cross-disciplinary collaboration. You move fluidly across product, strategy, and marketing, bringing a systems mindset that connects every touchpoint.

  • Mentorship and critique. You raise the people around you through coaching, high standards, and a culture of honest, constructive feedback.

Requirements

  • 8+ years in brand design, creative direction, or design leadership, ideally in a digital-first environment.

  • Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and large-scale brand engagements from strategy through execution.

  • A portfolio that shows mastery of visual identity, brand systems, and storytelling across digital touchpoints.

  • Experience presenting to executive stakeholders and turning creative thinking into strategic outcomes.

  • Fluency in modern design tools (Figma, Illustrator, After Effects) and a real grasp of how brands extend through motion, interaction, and content.

  • Comfort with emerging tools, including everyday use of AI in your craft.

  • Strong facilitation and communication skills, guiding workshops and strategic sessions with confidence and empathy.

  • Deep knowledge of design trends and the evolving role of brand in the digital ecosystem.

  • A passion for mentoring and shaping design culture.

How We Hire

The bar is high and the role is senior, so we take the process seriously and move quickly. Expect a couple of conversations with the team, then a small, paid real-world project so we can see how you actually think and work. The role is remote. Compensation matches the seniority we're hiring for.

25WD92702

Principal Product Manager - Flow Studio (GenAI Products)

Location: East Coast Canada or US (Remote)

About Autodesk Media & Entertainment

Autodesk empowers creators and studios around the world with tools for digital content creation, visual effects, animation, and production.

Generative AI is rapidly reshaping how entertainment is made, and Autodesk Flow Studio is at the center of that transformation. We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to help bring the next generation of AI-powered creative workflows to artists and studios worldwide. This Product Lead will work very closely with the development team from Europe.

The Opportunity

As the Principal Product Manager for Flow Studio, you’ll help turn product strategy into action. You’ll connect teams across Autodesk, translate emerging GenAI opportunities and customer needs into clear priorities, and help drive products and capabilities from strategy through launch.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, UX, Marketing, Sales, Legal, Trusted AI, and customers—bringing clarity to complex initiatives, removing blockers, and keeping teams aligned in a fast-moving AI landscape.

This is an opportunity to work hands-on with emerging generative AI technology and help shape how it transforms visual effects and content creation.

What You’ll Do

  • Turn strategy into execution: Translate Flow Studio’s product strategy and emerging GenAI opportunities into clear roadmaps, priorities, decisions, and action.
  • Drive roadmap alignment: Keep priorities, dependencies, risks, owners, and next steps visible across teams.
  • Bring the customer perspective: Engage with customers and partners to understand how AI is changing creative workflows and turn feedback, usage patterns, and market signals into actionable insights.
  • Stay ahead of the GenAI landscape: Experiment hands-on with leading AI tools and track new models, competitors, workflows, and capabilities to identify implications for Flow Studio.
  • Orchestrate across teams: Coordinate Product, Engineering, UX, Marketing, Sales, Legal, Trusted AI, and other stakeholders to keep initiatives moving.
  • Support successful launches: Partner with go-to-market teams on positioning, readiness, enablement, dependencies, and launch execution.
  • Remove blockers: Navigate a large, matrixed organization, surface risks early, drive decisions, and escalate when needed.
  • Communicate with impact: Build executive-ready presentations and narratives that simplify complex product and AI topics and drive alignment.

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of experience in product management, product operations, program leadership, or a related role.
  • Strong knowledge of generative AI and AI-powered creative workflows, with hands-on experience using modern image, video, animation, performance, AI filmmaking and AI production tools..
  • Experience bringing AI/ML or other technically complex products from concept through production and launch.
  • Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Legal, governance, and customer-facing teams.
  • Strong product judgment and the ability to translate strategy into actionable plans, manage competing priorities, and make pragmatic trade-offs.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, including executive-level storytelling.
  • A highly organized, proactive working style and a track record of creating clarity and momentum in fast-moving environments.
  • Commitment to responsible AI development and effective partnership with Legal, Trusted AI, and governance teams.
  • Media & Entertainment, VFX, animation, gaming, or creative technology experience is required
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Flow Studio, Autodesk Production Management, Maya, Unreal Engine, Blender, or similar creative production tools
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum and large, matrixed organizations.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, analytics, 3D graphics, or rendering pipelines.

Help shape the future of AI-powered entertainment production.
Join Flow Studio and help turn rapidly evolving AI capabilities into creative workflows that artists and studios can put to work.

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Benefits

From health and financial benefits to time away and everyday wellness, we give Autodeskers the best, so they can do their best work. Learn more about our benefits in the U.S. by visiting

Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For U.S.-based roles, we expect a starting base salary between $149,000 and $266,200. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

At Autodesk, we're building a diverse workplace and an inclusive culture to give more people the chance to imagine, design, and make a better world. Are you passionate about technology and enjoy explaining complex solutions in a way that everybody gets excited? If so, read on!

About Picus

Picus Security is an exposure validation company. One platform proves what attackers can exploit and what your defenses stop, turning every exposure into a defensible decision, autonomously and at the machine speed today's AI threats demand.

Picus validates attack surfaces, exposures, and security controls as one continuous loop: validate, decide, fix, re-validate. Instead of ranking findings by severity score, Picus proves which exposures are genuinely exploitable in your environment, including the business-critical, restricted, and air-gapped assets a live exploit can never safely touch, so teams act on what truly matters and resolve each exposure into a clear call to patch, mitigate, monitor, or accept with evidence.

The Picus Platform spans Autonomous Penetration Testing, Exposure Validation, and Breach and Attack Simulation, unified by Picus Swarm, a swarm of AI agents that runs the whole validation loop continuously. It reaches across on-prem, hybrid cloud, and endpoint environments, with 75+ integrations that ingest from scanners like Tenable and Wiz and operationalize through your EDR, SIEM, firewall, and ticketing tools.

The pioneer of Breach and Attack Simulation, Picus proves and improves the security controls you already own, doubling control effectiveness within three months. Picus holds a 95% recommendation rate, 4.9 on G2, and 4.8 on Gartner Peer Insights, and is the #1 Leader on Frost Radar for Automated Security Validation.

We are looking for a purpose-driven, high-performing Enterprise Account Executive with experience in enterprise technology sales. You will be passionate about building good relationships with customers, solving customer problems, and driving sales of our world-class software products. In this role, you will be working with enterprise and public sector clients where you will become a subject matter expert through the entire sales process. Working at Picus

This approach allows for the identification of imminent threats, provides recommended actions, and produces valuable metrics about cyber-risk levels.

Who We Are

Great Minds is a high-growth, mission-driven organization founded by educators in 2007. As a for-profit, Public Benefit Corporation, we believe all students deserve access to meaningful, challenging content—and all teachers deserve tools that are intuitive, effective, and built for the realities of today’s classrooms.

We develop high-quality, knowledge-rich math, science and ELA curricula grounded in research and designed in collaboration with educators. Our materials reflect real classroom needs and are built to drive lasting student outcomes.

We are committed to usability, coherence, and practical implementation—supporting teachers not just through curriculum, but with professional learning, purposeful technology, and responsive service that enable strong adoption and impact.

What We Build

Our products—Eureka Math and Eureka Math², Wit & Wisdom, Geodes, and the newly launched Arts & Letters ELA—are trusted by thousands of schools and districts nationwide.

  • Eureka Math is the most widely used math curriculum in the U.S., and is focused on balancing conceptual understanding, procedural fluency, and application.

  • Wit & Wisdom® and Arts & Letters ELA™ anchor our reading strategy with content-rich, grade-level instruction that integrates literature, history, and the arts, grounded in the science of reading. Geodes® complements our reading suite with decodable texts that pair phonics with meaningful content to support early literacy.

These programs reflect a shared belief in high expectations, joyful rigor, and deep respect for educators and students.

Where We’re Headed

Great Minds is entering a new stage of growth and product maturity. We are focused on building more connected, customer-informed experiences across the full educator journey—from curriculum to professional learning to platform and support.

Our long-term vision is to become a true partner in impact—not just delivering curriculum, but supporting educators in achieving outcomes at scale.


Job Purpose

The Senior Planning & Operations Specialist, Manipulatives owns end-to-end operational planning and execution for physical instructional manipulatives, including forecasting, production planning, and fulfillment readiness. Reporting to the Senior Director, Strategic Operations, this role partners closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, ePMO, and external vendors to ensure manipulatives are available, cost-effective, and aligned to go-to-market timelines and instructional priorities.

This position plays a critical role in balancing demand variability, manufacturing constraints, and district-level delivery expectations—particularly during peak adoption and back-to-school cycles.


Responsibilities

Planning & Forecasting

  • Participate with various stakeholders on forecasting for manipulatives across adoption cycles, pilots, samples, and replenishment.

  • Develop and maintain long-range capacity and inventory models to support growth and seasonality.

  • Communicate and monitor forecasts with vendors to ensure product availability

  • Partner with Sales and Marketing to assess component availability risk and mitigation strategies.

Inventory & Supply Chain Operations

  • Monitor established inventory strategy for manipulatives, including safety stock, reserve inventory, and obsolescence management.

  • Monitor inventory health (on-hand, committed, backordered, reserved) and drive corrective actions as needed.

  • Manage manufacturing and vendor relationships, including lead times, MOQs, cost controls, and quality standards.

Cross-Functional Execution

  • Work with Order Management and Customer Success to resolve fulfillment issues, shortages, or escalations.

  • Serve as the primary operational point of contact for manipulative-related inquiries.

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop dashboards and reporting for manipulative inventory levels, forecast accuracy, fulfillment performance, and risk indicators.

  • Identify process improvements to reduce cost, increase reliability, and improve cross-team visibility.

  • Document and maintain SOPs related to planning, inventory management, and fulfillment workflows.

  • Coordinate RFP and RFQ processes with internal and external stakeholders.

Requirements

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in education space with extensive experience in operations, supply chain, planning, or production management.

  • Experience managing physical products (print, kits, manipulatives, or educational materials).

  • Strong forecasting, analytical, and inventory planning skills.

  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations teams.

  • Experience working with ERP and CRM systems (e.g., NetSuite, Salesforce).

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex operational data into clear insights.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with adoption-driven demand cycles and back-to-school fulfillment.

  • Experience managing 3PL relationships and overseas or domestic manufacturing vendors.

  • Advanced Excel / data modeling skills; familiarity with BI tools a plus.

Required Education

Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Full-time

Remote

CTM II - Sao Paulo, Brazil - FSP

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

  • Responsible for site management oversight, clinical monitoring and central monitoring deliverables with a focus on patient safety, protocol/GCP/regulatory compliance and data integrity.
  • Oversees site interactions post activation through site closeout. This may include patient recruitment, investigator payments or other related activities.
  • May be responsible for identification of critical data and process, protocol execution risks and risk mitigations related to completion of the Risk Assessment and Categorization Tool (RACT).
  • Reviews the study scope of work, budget and protocol content and ensures the clinical project team (CRAs/Central Monitors) is aware of the contractual obligations and parameters.
  • Uses prior clinical experience, operational data, metrics and reports to identify risks to clinical trial management deliverables.
  • Escalates to the project manager any risks to clinical trial management deliverables (timeline, quality and budget) and any activities and requests which are out of contracted scope.
  • Employs strategic thinking and problem-solving skills to propose and implement risk mitigations.
  • Participates and presents in key meetings such as Kick Off Meeting.
  • Serves as an escalation point for communications with investigator site staff and may be required to interact on the phone or in person with principal investigators or other site staff members. This may include accompanying CRA team members to sites for observation or conflict resolution.
  • Collaborates with other functional leaders such as Study Start Up, Patient Recruitment and Data Management to coordinate delivery handoffs and meet expected study milestones such as site activation targets, enrollment targets and database lock timelines. Reviews and provides feedback on other functional plans (e.g. Data Management Plan, Communication Plan) as they relate to the clinical trial management activities.
  • Responsible for development and ongoing maintenance of clinical study tools and templates, including the Clinical Monitoring Plan. Ensures CTMS, dashboards and other systems are set up and available for use by the clinical team, including overseeing user acceptance testing (UAT) as needed. Ensures access and audit trail reviews are conducted as required.
  • Coordinates initial and ongoing training to the study team regarding protocol specificities, Case Report Form (CRF) completion, dashboards, Sponsor Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), clinical plans and guidelines, data plans and timelines for the study.
  • Oversees resourcing allocations for CRAs and Central Monitors, site assignments and study team members' conduct, and identifies risks to delivery or quality.
  • Ensures quality of the clinical monitoring, central monitoring and site management deliverables within a project and maintain proper visibility of its progress by the use of approved systems and / or tracking tools.
  • Reviews the project oversight dashboards and other clinical trial systems (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS), Electronic Data Capture (EDC), eDiary, Electronic Patient Reported Outcomes (ePROs),Trial Master File (TMF), IVRS/IWRS, Central Monitoring dashboards), to oversee site and patient activities, study team conduct and to ensure the data has been updated to reflect timely execution of all operational aspects (required visits/calls, duration, and frequency) according to plan.
  • Understands the monitoring strategy required for the study and, where required, participates in the development of the study risk assessment plan. Is accountable for their assigned clinical team members' understanding, ongoing compliance and delivery according to the stated monitoring strategy, CMP/SMP, and risk plans.
  • Reviews the content and quality of site and central monitoring documentation (site monitoring calls, site visit reports, site letters, central monitoring reports and pertinent correspondence), to ensure they represent site management activities and conduct and that they appropriately convey any risks to protocol/GCP compliance, trial conduct, patient safety or data integrity. Document requested revisions and approvals in CTMS. Ensures these deliverables are provided according to company and/or sponsor specifications, including delivery deadlines.
  • Interacts with the client and other functional departments related to clinical monitoring, central monitoring and site management activities and deliverables. Provides status updates on the clinical deliverables and risks to clients, project management and leadership as per departmental or study agreements. Provides solutions for obstacles in protocol execution and site management.
  • Demonstrates understanding of other functions' roles in achieving compliance and delivery according to protocol, SOPs, ICH GCP and country regulations. This may include data management, study start up, patient recruitment, medical monitoring, pharmacovigilance and Quality Assurance (QA). Supports Inspection Readiness for clinical trial management scope.
  • Oversees CRAs and Central Monitors assigned to the study and routinely assesses study-specific process and training compliance, CMP compliance, and identifies emerging risks. May develop and support execution of corrective action plans at site and study level. Supports and completes activities to achieve data cut and lock deadlines.
  • Provides feedback to line managers on staff performance including strengths as well as areas for development. May be assigned to larger,more complex trials.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and align teams in the achievement of project milestones
  • Demonstrated capability of working in an international environment.
  • Demonstrated expertise in site management and monitoring (clinical or central)
  • Preferred experience with risk-based monitoring
  • Demonstrates understanding of clinical trial management financial principles and budget management
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills
  • Good communication, presentation and interpersonal skills among project team and with sites
  • Strong conflict resolution skills
  • Demonstrated ability to apply problem solving techniques to resolve complex issues, and apply a risk management approach to identifying and mitigating potential threats to the successful conduct of a clinical research project.
  • Demonstrates critical thinking to determine the cause and appropriate solution in the identification of issues
  • Moderate travel may be required, approximately 20%

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Additional Information

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. raw.description:
About the Role

We're growing the customer success function at a fintech startup. We're seeking a Client Support Representative who will be the first line of support for our clients. This role is critical in ensuring a seamless experience by handling incoming phone calls and support tickets with urgency and care. You'll also assist with daily operational reports and play a key role in identifying and escalating high-priority issues such as card declines, account access issues, and fraud.

As a Client Support Representative, you'll work directly alongside our Customer Success Manager, supporting a growing portfolio of clients across commercial card and accounts payable products. You'll own day-to-day client interactions, help manage our inbound support line, and get hands-on exposure to every part of the payments stack we're building.

Startup environment: You'll be doing real work from day one — not shadowing or ticket triaging. If you're looking for a place to build something and grow with it, this is that opportunity.

Work arrangement: Fully remote (US)

What You'll Do

  • Support day-to-day client relationships across a portfolio of commercial card and accounts payable clients, under the guidance of the Customer Success Manager.
  • Cover the inbound client support phone line during business hours — fielding questions, logging issues, and resolving common card operations problems independently.
  • Handle first-level support requests: card issuance questions, authorization inquiries, transaction research, and basic dispute intake.
  • Escalate complex processor-side or compliance-related issues to the CSM with full context and documentation.
  • Maintain accurate client records, support logs, and issue tracking across internal systems.
  • Assist in preparing client-facing materials — onboarding guides, QBR supporting data, and program update communications.
  • Help document support processes and resolution workflows as the team scales.
  • Stay current on product updates, payment network changes, and new channels as they launch — you'll be a key part of bringing clients along.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree required; a focus in Business, Finance, or a related field is preferred or equivalent experience strongly demonstrating the competency.
  • 4–6 years in a client-facing customer support role within banking, fintech, or financial services.
  • Practical understanding of commercial card programs — how cards are issued, managed, and supported at a bank or processor level is a major plus.
  • Familiarity with accounts payable workflows and how commercial clients use card programs to manage vendor payments.
  • Comfortable on the phone — you can handle a live support call with calm and professionalism, even when the client is frustrated.
  • Strong written and verbal communication — clear, concise, and appropriate for a business banking.
  • Detail-oriented, and excellent follow-through — you close the loop and don't let things fall through the cracks.
  • Adaptable and curious, must be comfortable with evolving products and processes in a startup environment.

Preferences

  • Experience supporting clients on any of the major processor-based card platform (disputes, card controls, back-office tools).
  • Exposure to ACH, wire, or other payment rails — especially in a support or operations context.
  • Familiarity with virtual card programs, expense management tools, or AP automation platforms.
  • Prior use of CRM or CS tools (Zendesk or similar).
  • Experience at community or regional banks, or financial services-adjacent fintech.

Growth Path

This role is designed with upward mobility in mind. As our product channels expand — across commercial cards, ACH, virtual cards, and AP automation — you'll gain hands-on experience across all of them.

CSR → Customer Success Manager is the intended trajectory. We'll invest in your growth from the start — through mentorship from the CSM, exposure to product and ops teams, and direct client ownership as you're ready for it.

Who You Are

  • You know enough about how banks work to speak credibly with commercial clients — and you're eager to learn what you don't know yet.
  • You take ownership of your work — if a client issue lands with you, you see it through.
  • You thrive in environments where the playbook is still being written.
  • You're a team player who can work independently — in a small team, both matter equally.

title: Sr Life Underwriting Business Systems Analyst
description: Job FamilyIT - Business AnalysisAbout Us At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward.

raw.title: Sr Life Underwriting Business Systems Analyst
raw.excerpt: Job FamilyIT - Business AnalysisAbout Us At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward.
raw.description:
Job Family

IT - Business Analysis

About Us

At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests.

Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there.

   

Who We Are

 

We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life.

Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them.

We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms.

What We Do

Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2) Protection Solutions and Savings & Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs.

Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group servingapproximately 23.9 million customersworldwide.* For more information, visit transamerica.com. 

Job Description Summary

This position serves as a key stakeholder in life underwriting system implementations and transformation initiatives, facilitating the implementation of strategic projects, process improvements, and technology solutions that support the evolution of life underwriting operations. The Senior Enhanced Life Underwriting Analyst partners across Life Underwriting, New Business, Operations, Product, Technology, QA, Distribution, Training & Development, Project Management, and vendor organizations and serves as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams. The position supports the project lifecycle from business analysis and requirements gathering through solution design, testing, implementation, training, and post-launch support.

Job Description

Responsibilities

  • Support life underwriting transformation initiatives focused on modernization, automation, process improvement, and operational excellence.
  • Collaborates with underwriting project team and related stakeholders to gather requirements, provide feedback, and ensure alignment with IT on project goals and deliverables
  • Prepares “as is” and “current state” documentation in written and graphical form (flows).
  • Use Business Process Modeling techniques and tools to create business process models
  • Lead effort to develop new or revised processes or procedures in lieu of system development.
  • Facilitate the elicitation, analysis, and documentation of business and system requirements, translating underwriting business needs into clear requirements for technical teams.
  • Analyze business unit requests and understand business requirements. Work with various technical staff members to determine possible solutions and communicate business and system impacts to IT and Operations staff.
  • Prepare documentation for business and system requirements in various formats.
  • Works on project teams that are developing or modifying highly complex information systems. Includes analysis and documentation of business and system requirement and revising existing system logic difficulties as necessary.
  • Conducts research and analysis to quantify business opportunities and develops formal recommendations to management.
  • May use project management and program management methodologies to support a systems development methodology to meet project deliverables.
  • Provide test scenarios or test criteria based on knowledge gained through business and systems analysis. Prepare cases for test beds. Provide approval or quality check on test plans or test matrix.
  • Coordinate business readiness activities and assist with training, knowledge transfer, stakeholder communications, and training materials as needed.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education/experience, preferably in IT or a business area discipline
  • Minimum of 5 or more years of experience in business systems analysis.
  • 2-4 years of industry experience also preferred.
  • Two years of experience managing technical projects in a complex environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of life insurance products, underwriting processes, and operational workflows.
  • Two or more years of underwriting experience within Transamerica or two or more years of experience supporting an enhanced underwriting project.
  • Strong analytical, decision-making, problem-solving, and organizational skills with attention to detail.
  • Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively with business and technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to accept and manage changing priorities and address issues quickly and professionally.
  • Demonstrates a high degree of initiative and accountability.

Working Conditions

  • Remote Environment

The Salary for this position generally ranges between $85,000-100,000 annually. Please note that the salary range is a good faith estimate for this position and actual starting pay is determined by several factors including qualifications, experience, geography, work location designation (in-office, hybrid, remote) and operational needs. Salary may vary above and below the stated amounts, as permitted by applicable law.


Additionally, this position is typically eligible for an Annual Bonus of 10% based on the Company Bonus Plan/Individual Performance and is at the Company’s discretion.


Disclaimer:

  • We will never request personal information such as ID or payment for equipment upfront.
  • Official offers are sent via DocuSign following a verbal offer—not through text or email

This job description is not a contract of employment nor for any specific job responsibilities. The Company may change, add to, remove, or revoke the terms of this job description at its discretion. Managers may assign other duties and responsibilities as needed. In the event an employee or applicant requests or requires an accommodation to perform job functions, the applicable HR Business Partner should be contacted to evaluate the accommodation request.

What We Offer

For eligible employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support both the personal and financial well-being of our employees.

Compensation Benefits

  • Competitive Pay

  • Bonus for Eligible Employees

Benefits Package

  • Pension Plan

  • 401k Match

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

  • Tuition Reimbursement

  • Disability Insurance

  • Medical Insurance

  • Dental Insurance

  • Vision Insurance

  • Employee Discounts

  • Career Training & Development Opportunities

Health and Work/Life Balance Benefits

  • Paid Time Off starting at 160 hours annually for employees in their first year of service.

  • Ten (10) paid holidays per year (typically mirroring the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) holidays).

  • Be Well Company holistic wellness program, which includes Wellness Coaching and Reward Dollars

  • Parental Leave – fifteen (15) days of paid parental leave per calendar year to eligible employees with at least one year of service at the time of birth, placement of an adopted child, or placement of a foster care child.

  • Adoption Assistance

  • Employee Assistance Program

  • Back-Up Care Program

  • PTO for Volunteer Hours

  • Employee Matching Gifts Program

  • Employee Resource Groups

  • Inclusion and Diversity Programs

  • Employee Recognition Program

  • Referral Bonus Programs

Inclusion & Diversity 

 

We believe our commitment to diversity and inclusion creates a work environment filled with exceptional individuals. We’re thrilled to have been recognized for our efforts through the Human Rights Campaign Corporate Equality Index, Dave Thomas Adoption Friendly Advocate, and several Seramount lists, including the Inclusion Index, 100 Best Companies for Working Parents, Best Companies for Dads, and Top 75 Companies for Executive Women.

 

To foster a culture of inclusivity throughout our workforce, workplace, and marketplace, Transamerica offers a wide range of diversity and inclusion programs. This includes our company-sponsored, employee-driven Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), which are formed around a shared interest or a common characteristic of diversity. ERGs are open to all employees. They provide a supportive environment to help us better appreciate our similarities and differences and understand how they benefit us all.

  

Giving Back 

 

We believe our responsibilities extend beyond our corporate walls. That's why we created the Aegon Transamerica Foundation in 1994. Through a mix of financial grants and the volunteer efforts of our employees, the foundation supports nonprofit organizations focused on the things that matter most to our people in the communities where we live and work.   

 

Transamerica’s Parent Company 

Aegon acquired the Transamerica business in 1999. Since its start in 1844, Aegon has grown into an international company serving more than 23.9 million people across the globe.* It offers investment, protection, and retirement solutions, always with a clear purpose: Helping people live their best lives. As a leading global investor and employer, the company seeks to have a positive impact by addressing critical environmental and societal issues, with a focus on climate change and inclusion and diversity.  

* As of December 31, 2023

raw.description:
At Contegris, we're not just focused on building great products — we're equally committed to making sure they work reliably and deliver a seamless experience for the people who use them.

As a System Support Engineer, you'll be part of the team responsible for helping customers resolve technical issues, troubleshoot system-related problems, and ensure a smooth customer experience.

This is an entry-level technical support role suited for someone who enjoys troubleshooting, learning how systems work, communicating with customers, and finding practical solutions to technical problems. You'll work closely with customers to investigate issues, provide timely support, document incidents, and escalate complex problems when required.

If you're technically curious, comfortable communicating with customers, and looking to build your career in IT Support Network Support, this role might be for you.

What This Role Does

  • Handle Customer Support: Respond to customer inquiries and technical issues received through phone, email, chat, and other support channels.
  • Troubleshoot Technical Issues: Analyze reported problems, identify possible causes, and provide appropriate solutions.
  • Drive First Contact Resolution: Resolve customer issues efficiently at the first point of contact whenever possible.
  • Monitor & Escalate: Identify system alerts or complex technical issues and escalate them to the relevant technical team when required.
  • Understand Customer Needs: Ask the right questions, actively listen to customer concerns, and gather the information required to diagnose issues.
  • Provide Clear Communication: Explain technical issues and solutions in a simple and professional manner to customers.
  • Document Incidents: Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, technical issues, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions in the CRM/HelpDesk system.
  • Follow Up: Stay connected with customers on pending issues and ensure they receive timely updates until resolution.
  • Collaborate with Technical Teams: Work with relevant internal teams to investigate and resolve issues that require further technical assistance.
  • Maintain Customer Experience: Ensure every customer interaction is handled professionally, patiently, and with a customer-first mindset.

Who This Is For

  • Bachelor's degree, preferably BS Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 6 months - 1 year of experience in technical support or a high-paced call center environment.
  • Students currently enrolled in a BS CS/IT-related program at VU (Virtual University) are also encouraged to apply.
  • Candidates who have completed CCNA, CCNP, or relevant networking/IT courses from Corvit are encouraged to apply.
  • Basic understanding of Linux, Networking, and Network Security.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Customer-oriented approach with the ability to handle customer concerns professionally.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Good attention to detail and ability to accurately document technical issues.
  • Ability to remain calm and effective under pressure.
  • Good team player with a willingness to learn and grow.
  • Comfortable working in Rotational shifts.

What Won't Work

This role won't be a fit if you:

  • Don't enjoy troubleshooting or investigating technical problems.
  • Prefer to simply forward customer issues instead of trying to understand and resolve them.
  • Struggle to communicate clearly with customers.
  • Find it difficult to remain patient and professional when dealing with frustrated customers.
  • Are uncomfortable working in a fast-paced support environment with rotational shifts.
  • Don't want to learn about Linux, networking, SaaS products, and technical systems.
  • This is primarily a Product Support role where you'll learn our products and technologies and provide technical support to our customers. If your career goal is to move into pure Networking or Network Engineering, this role may not be the right fit.
  • Avoid documenting issues, troubleshooting steps, or customer interactions properly.
  • Struggle to work under pressure or manage multiple support requests.
  • Prefer working independently and are not comfortable collaborating with technical teams.

Mission North is a strategic communications agency for influential companies to build, protect, and renew their impact. Market-shaping brands like Brex, Canva, Ginkgo Bioworks, Google, LinkedIn, Mozilla, Recursion, Snowflake, and Zoom have turned to us to navigate change and accelerate impact at every stage. Our award-winning culture of curiosity allows us to attract the best communicators and mobilize them around tackling some of the world’s biggest challenges. Our stories about breakthrough innovations and movements—and the iconic teams behind them—have influenced hundreds of billions of dollars in market value.

🔍 Don’t see what you’re looking for? Submit an application here! We’re always on the lookout for amazing talent and will reach out as soon as we have a role that’s a fit.

Whether your expertise is in strategy, communications, digital marketing, content writing, data and analytics, or operations, we believe the best teams are built by connecting with exceptional people early. As a benefit corporation, we’re committed to making a positive difference through our work, culture, and community investments.

Job Title

Senior AI Developer - Finance Automation & Enterprise Integration


Location(s)

India - Remote

About Us

Revvity is a developer and provider of end-to-end solutions designed to help scientists, researchers, and clinicians solve the world’s greatest health challenges. We pair the enthusiasm of an industry disruptor with the experience of a longtime leader. Our team of 11,000+ colleagues from around the globe are vital to our success and the reason we’re able to push boundaries in pursuit of better human health.

Find your future at Revvity

Principal AI Developer - Finance Automation & Enterprise Integration (India)

About You:

You're a seasoned AI professional with deep expertise in artificial intelligence and enterprise system integration, passionate about how generative AI and large language models (LLMs) can transform financial operations at scale. You embody our core values:

Embrace the unknown: You lead with a "What if?" mindset, architecting innovative AI solutions that revolutionize traditional finance processes and enterprise workflows across global operations.

Partner with purpose:You're excited to mentor teams, collaborate with global stakeholders, and use AI to drive measurable business outcomes across finance, operations, and technology departments.

Passion for people: You understand that AI's true potential lies in empowering finance professionals, analysts, and business users to make faster, more informed decisions while maintaining human oversight.

Collaborate for success: You excel in leading cross-functional initiatives, building consensus across time zones, and fostering a culture of transparency and integrity when handling sensitive financial data.

You're a proven technical leader, comfortable with complex enterprise architectures, and excited by the challenge of scaling cutting-edge AI technologies across global business operations.

What You'll Do:

Within 30 Days

  • Lead technical assessment of current AI automation infrastructure and identify optimization opportunities

  • Establish relationships with global finance leadership, IT architecture teams, and regional stakeholders

  • Conduct deep-dive analysis of existing SAP, Salesforce, and cloud platform integrations to identify AI enhancement opportunities

  • Mentor junior developers and establish technical standards for the India AI development team

  • Present strategic roadmap for AI-driven financial automation to senior leadership

Within 60 Days

  • Architect and lead development of enterprise-scale AI solutions for financial process automation (P2P, O2C, R2R cycles)

  • Design and implement advanced prompt engineering frameworks for complex financial document processing and analysis

  • Lead integration projects connecting AI models with SAP S/4HANA, Salesforce Financial Services Cloud, and multi-cloud environments

  • Establish CI/CD pipelines for AI model deployment with enterprise-grade security, compliance, and monitoring

  • Drive technical decision-making for cloud infrastructure scaling across AWS/Azure/GCP platforms

  • Collaborate with global teams to ensure 24/7 system reliability and performance optimization

Within 90 Days

  • Own end-to-end delivery of mission-critical AI automation platforms serving global finance operations

  • Lead technical presentations to C-suite executives, translating AI capabilities into strategic business value

  • Establish center of excellence for AI development practices, including code review standards, testing frameworks, and deployment protocols

  • Drive innovation in real-time financial analytics, predictive modeling, and intelligent reporting systems

  • Mentor and scale the India AI development team, establishing career development pathways

  • Lead vendor evaluations and technology partnerships for next-generation AI capabilities

  • Ensure compliance with global data governance, financial regulations, and security standards

Requirements:

Technical Leadership:

  • 5+ years of overall IT experience

  • 2+ years of enterprise AI/ML development experience with proven track record of scaling production systems

  • Experience with Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, or AWS CodePipeline

  • Expert-level proficiency in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, cloud-native architectures, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)

  • Deep experience with LLM integration, prompt engineering, and AI model optimization for enterprise applications

  • Proven expertise in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) with focus on AI/ML services and enterprise integration patterns

  • Strong background in API development, microservices architecture, and enterprise system integrations

Enterprise & Finance Domain:

  • Extensive experience with SAP modules (FI/CO, S/4HANA, BTP) and/or Salesforce platform development

  • Deep understanding of financial processes: accounts payable/receivable, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting

  • Experience with enterprise data governance, financial compliance (SOX, GAAP, IFRS), and audit requirements

  • Knowledge of real-time data processing, ETL pipelines, and financial data warehousing

Leadership & Communication:

  • Proven ability to lead technical teams and mentor junior developers

  • Experience presenting to senior executives and translating technical concepts to business stakeholders

  • Strong project management skills with experience in Agile/Scrum methodologies

  • Excellent English communication skills for global collaboration across time zones

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Experience with Indian financial regulations and compliance requirements

  • Background in fintech, banking, or life sciences industry

  • Certifications in cloud platforms ((AWS Solutions Architect, Azure AI Engineer, etc.)

  • Experience with MLOps, model governance, and AI ethics frameworks

  • Knowledge of emerging AI technologies (RAG, fine-tuning, multi-modal AI)

Overview

The Driver Recruiter’s primary responsibility will be to build and develop a pipeline of experienced CDL candidates for NFI. Accountable for sourcing and recruiting activities including: establishing and maintaining relationships by working with military contacts, employment offices, truck driving schools, and technical colleges; conducting job fairs and seminars; attending trade shows (truck shows); and developing other viable recruiting sources.
Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain a full understanding of the local CDL labor market, and identify effective market-specific sourcing tools
  • Know where and how to reach drivers and maintain relationships with those drivers from the point of introduction through hire
  • Source, recruit, screen, and interview experienced driver candidates, utilizing sales, research, and networking skills, including cold calling, e-mail, computer databases, and Internet recruiting resources
  • Maintain all pertinent applicant and interview data in the TenStreet applicant tracking system (ATS)
  • Sell NFI’s compensation and benefits package to those candidates
  • Coordinate and attend recruiting events at driving schools, job fairs, local communities, industry venues, etc.
  • Assist qualified candidates in completing their employment applications, and ensure all necessary paperwork is sent to the Processing Team
  • Work with Hiring Managers to understand staffing needs
  • Partner with operations management on recruiting activities
  • Perform other special projects as assigned

Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree preferred; or high school diploma with demonstrated pro-active recruiting or sales experience
  • 1-2 years professional experience in Sales, Customer Service, Human Resources or Recruiting (including internships)
  • Outside sales experience or experience in the Transportation or Logistics industry a plus
  • Ability to cultivate and maintain relationships
  • Excellent knowledge of Internet candidate data mining
  • Professional demeanor with excellent interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills
  • Exceptional planning, time management, and project management skills
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work independently
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to multi-task are essential
  • Proficiency with MS Office Suite; experience with recruiting technologies a plus
  • Knowledge of DOT requirements a plus
  • Ability to travel

We are excited to share that the base salary range for this position is $46,082.40 - 61,443.20 USD Annual, based on the national average for the position. NFI takes into consideration applicants' qualifications, experience, education, and geographic location when determining a starting rate of pay.

Employees are also eligible for a robust benefit program, which includes Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription Drug Coverage, 401k Plan, Wellness Program, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Paid Parental Leave, among other benefit plan options.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities

However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information. 41 CFR 60-1.35(c)
