raw.description:
At Contegris, we're not just focused on building great products — we're equally committed to making sure they work reliably and deliver a seamless experience for the people who use them.

As a System Support Engineer, you'll be part of the team responsible for helping customers resolve technical issues, troubleshoot system-related problems, and ensure a smooth customer experience.

This is an entry-level technical support role suited for someone who enjoys troubleshooting, learning how systems work, communicating with customers, and finding practical solutions to technical problems. You'll work closely with customers to investigate issues, provide timely support, document incidents, and escalate complex problems when required.

If you're technically curious, comfortable communicating with customers, and looking to build your career in IT Support Network Support, this role might be for you.

What This Role Does

  • Handle Customer Support: Respond to customer inquiries and technical issues received through phone, email, chat, and other support channels.
  • Troubleshoot Technical Issues: Analyze reported problems, identify possible causes, and provide appropriate solutions.
  • Drive First Contact Resolution: Resolve customer issues efficiently at the first point of contact whenever possible.
  • Monitor & Escalate: Identify system alerts or complex technical issues and escalate them to the relevant technical team when required.
  • Understand Customer Needs: Ask the right questions, actively listen to customer concerns, and gather the information required to diagnose issues.
  • Provide Clear Communication: Explain technical issues and solutions in a simple and professional manner to customers.
  • Document Incidents: Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, technical issues, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions in the CRM/HelpDesk system.
  • Follow Up: Stay connected with customers on pending issues and ensure they receive timely updates until resolution.
  • Collaborate with Technical Teams: Work with relevant internal teams to investigate and resolve issues that require further technical assistance.
  • Maintain Customer Experience: Ensure every customer interaction is handled professionally, patiently, and with a customer-first mindset.

Who This Is For

  • Bachelor's degree, preferably BS Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 6 months - 1 year of experience in technical support or a high-paced call center environment.
  • Students currently enrolled in a BS CS/IT-related program at VU (Virtual University) are also encouraged to apply.
  • Candidates who have completed CCNA, CCNP, or relevant networking/IT courses from Corvit are encouraged to apply.
  • Basic understanding of Linux, Networking, and Network Security.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Customer-oriented approach with the ability to handle customer concerns professionally.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Good attention to detail and ability to accurately document technical issues.
  • Ability to remain calm and effective under pressure.
  • Good team player with a willingness to learn and grow.
  • Comfortable working in Rotational shifts.

What Won't Work

This role won't be a fit if you:

  • Don't enjoy troubleshooting or investigating technical problems.
  • Prefer to simply forward customer issues instead of trying to understand and resolve them.
  • Struggle to communicate clearly with customers.
  • Find it difficult to remain patient and professional when dealing with frustrated customers.
  • Are uncomfortable working in a fast-paced support environment with rotational shifts.
  • Don't want to learn about Linux, networking, SaaS products, and technical systems.
  • This is primarily a Product Support role where you'll learn our products and technologies and provide technical support to our customers. If your career goal is to move into pure Networking or Network Engineering, this role may not be the right fit.
  • Avoid documenting issues, troubleshooting steps, or customer interactions properly.
  • Struggle to work under pressure or manage multiple support requests.
  • Prefer working independently and are not comfortable collaborating with technical teams.

raw.description:
SHIFT:

Day (United States of America)

Seeking Breakthrough Makers

Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP) offers countless ways to change lives. Our diverse community of more than 20,000 Breakthrough Makers will inspire you to pursue passions, develop expertise, and drive innovation.

At CHOP, your experience is valued; your voice is heard; and your contributions make a difference for patients and families. Join us as we build on our promise to advance pediatric care—and your career.


CHOP does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, sex, national origin, religion, or any other legally protected categories in any employment, training, or vendor decisions or programs. CHOP recognizes the critical importance of a workforce rich in varied backgrounds and experiences and engages in ongoing efforts to achieve that through equally varied and non-discriminatory means.


A Brief Overview

The Workday Payroll Administrator Principal is a strategic technology and transformation leader for Payroll operations, configuration, and optimization. This role is responsible for architecting and governing the payroll ecosystem within Workday, ensuring accuracy, compliance, scalability, and seamless integration with upstream and downstream systems. Operating with broad autonomy, the Workday Payroll Administrator leads enterprise‑level initiatives, defines payroll configuration standards, and drives continuous improvement across processes, reporting, and system functionality. This position partners closely with HR, Finance, IT, and executive leadership to align payroll strategy with organizational goals, resolve the most complex payroll and system issues, and guide the long‑term roadmap for Workday Payroll. As the top technical authority, the Workday Payroll Administrator Principal mentors senior staff, influences cross‑functional decision‑making, and ensures the organization maximizes the value of its Workday investment.

What you will do

Strategy Alignment

  • Partner with Human Resources, Workforce Management, Finance, and Technology stakeholders to develop technology strategies and roadmaps that align with business strategies and organizational goals.
  • Lead strategic planning for payroll system enhancements and integrations.
  • Translate business needs into system requirements and recommend scalable solutions.
  • Serve as a thought leader by staying current on evolving technologies and automation strategies, advising senior leadership on innovation opportunities and guiding the organization's long-term digital roadmap.

Continuous Process Improvement

  • Develop and monitor key performance indicators that align with best practices.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline payroll processes and improve operational efficiency.
  • Champion a culture of innovation and continuous improvement, mentoring senior administrators and influencing stakeholders to adopt modern tools, methods, and Workday capabilities.

Application Configuration

  • Configure and maintain Workday Payroll and Absence modules.
  • Manage system updates, testing, and deployment of new features.
  • Collaborate with Workday support and internal teams to resolve technical issues.

Dashboards and Reporting

  • Design and maintain custom reports, dashboards, and analytics to support payroll operations and compliance.
  • Provide actionable insights to stakeholders through data visualization and reporting tools.
  • Ensure data accuracy and integrity across all payroll reports.

Application Security

  • Maintain role-based security configurations and ensure compliance with internal controls and audit requirements.
  • Support regular security reviews and user access provisioning and deprovisioning.
  • Collaborate with IT and compliance teams to address security risks and vulnerabilities.

Training and Change Management

  • Lead change management efforts related to system upgrades, new features, and process changes.
  • Support the development of training materials and end-user training.
  • Act as a subject matter expert and provide ongoing support to payroll users.

Mentoring

  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to senior and mid-level team members, helping them deepen their Workday Payroll expertise and expand their problem-solving capabilities.
  • Lead knowledge-sharing sessions, workshops, and walkthroughs to ensure the team stays current on new Workday features, payroll regulations, and emerging technologies.
  • Model high standards of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement, encouraging others to adopt similar approaches in their work.

Education Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree - Required
  • Master's Degree Business or Healthcare related field - Preferred

Experience Qualifications

  • At least seven (5) years functional system administration experience - Required
  • At least ten (7) years within a healthcare environment - Preferred

icenses and Certifications

  • Workday Certification - Workday - upon hire - Preferred

  • Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) - PayrollOrg - upon hire - Preferred

Skills and Abilities

  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills
  • Critical thinking problem-solving skills
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office products
  • Documentation skills
  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships and work collaboratively
  • Knowledge of ERP systems and specialized systems as appropriate (Payroll = Kronos, Windstar, BSI), Accounts Payable (OnBase, Concur), Accounting (Banking), and Research systems.

To carry out its mission, CHOP is committed to supporting the health of our patients, families, workforce, and global community. As a condition of employment, CHOP employees who work in patient care buildings or who have patient facing responsibilities must receive an annual influenza vaccine. Learn more.

Job Description:

At GDIT, we put our people first. As a Senior Business Analyst supporting the Indian Health Service, you will be entrusted to work with clinicians, developers, and federal staff to document changes and requirements for clinical applications.

This a REMOTE BASED ROLE. Candidate must live in the US.

** Work visa sponsorship will no be provided for this position **

How the Senior Business Analyst will make an Impact:

  • Analyze user and stakeholder needs to define functional and non-functional requirements across projects for the electronic health record system.
  • Document and manage requirements throughout the full lifecycle within the requirements repository (Azure DevOps).
  • Perform functional modeling to support requirements analysis and solution design.
  • Manage project backlogs and support prioritization activities.
  • Consult with clients to determine optimal design solutions for assigned projects.
  • Create and maintain project documentation, including requirements documents, user manuals, addendums, presentations, and training materials.
  • Assist in developing test use cases and scripts for user acceptance testing.
  • Collaborate with software development teams and comply with contract reporting requirements.
  • Collect and report metrics related to requirements and client-identified priorities.
  • Respond to inquiries from clients, clinicians, field personnel, developers, and other stakeholders.
  • Provide status reports to the PMO and/or Lead Analyst.
  • Participate in special projects as assigned.

What You Will Need to Succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent combination of education, professional training, and work experience as described below.
  • 8+ years of technical requirements analysis and Requirements Engineering (RE) experience using Waterfall and Agile SDLC methodologies.
  • Experience creating process and data flow diagrams, prototypes, and wireframes.
  • Experience managing change control activities, including backlog management, scope control, and impact/gap analysis.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office suite of applications, including Microsoft Visio.
  • Experience writing use cases and user stories.
  • Ability to clearly explain technical issues to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated success working in a collaborative team environment with shifting priorities and deadlines.
  • Proven ability to work on a remote or geographically dispersed team.
  • Minimal travel (once per year) may be required.

Preferred Skills:

  • IIBA certification Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP) or PMI Professional in Business Analysis (PMI-PBA).
  • Experience working with and knowledge of electronic health record systems (EHR, Pharmacy, Immunizations, Practice Management, Revenue Cycle Management, Clinical Quality Reporting) highly desired
  • Experience with the Indian Health Service RPMS and/or Veterans Administration VistA EHR systems.
  • Working knowledge of Azure DevOps and/or Team Foundation Server.
  • Knowledge of Planview and/or Unanet.

Location: Remote within the USA

Clearance Level: Requires the ability to pass an IHS background check and meet the residency requirement for having resided in the US at least (3) three out of the last (5) five years in order to obtain an appropriate level Public Trust Level 5 (MBI or T2) clearance.

What GDIT Can Offer You:

  • Full-flex work week to own your priorities at work and at home, with core work hours Monday – Friday 9:00 AM ET – 3:00 PM local time.
  • 401K with company match.
  • Comprehensive health and wellness packages.
  • Internal mobility team dedicated to helping you own your career.
  • Professional growth opportunities including paid education and certifications.
  • Cutting-edge technology you can learn from.
  • Rest and recharge with paid vacation and holidays.
  • Challenging work that makes a real impact on the world around you.
  • Remote work.

Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. GDIT typically provides new employees with 15 days of paid leave per calendar year to be used for vacations, personal business, and illness and an additional 10 paid holidays per year. Paid leave and paid holidays are prorated based on the employee’s date of hire. Location

Business - Real Estate

Brookfield Real Estate Group is one ofBrookfield’s primary operating groups. The Real Estate Group is one of the world's largest investors in real estate, with a global portfolio that includes office, retail, multifamily, logistics, hospitality and alternative real estate assets on five continents. The Group owns and operates approximately $268 billion of assets representing the most iconic properties in the world’s most dynamic markets. We seek to generate value by leveraging our operating expertise and focusing on our core real estate capabilities of leasing, financing, development, design and construction as well as property and facilities management. For more information, visit .

Brookfield Culture

Brookfield has a unique and dynamic culture. We seek team members who have a long-term focus and whose values align with our Attributes of a Brookfield Leader: Entrepreneurial, Collaborative and Disciplined. Brookfield is committed to the development of our people through challenging work assignments and exposure to diverse businesses.

Job Description

Brookfield is seeking a Senior ML/AI Engineer to help build and scale an AI-first platform that amplifies Brookfield's intelligence and enables smarter investment decisions, faster.


This role is for a hands-on engineer who will design, build, and improve the ML and AI application systems that turn Brookfield's proprietary investment context, including deals, documents, research, decisions, and outcomes, into reusable institutional intelligence.


You will work across retrieval, document intelligence, knowledge graphs, and LLM-powered applications, supporting capabilities ranging from natural-language query over structured data to grounded Q&A across large virtual data rooms, cross-corpus search, and agentic workflows.


You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Investment teams to deliver ML/AI capabilities that are accurate, traceable, scalable, and trustworthy enough to support real investment decisions. The ideal candidate combines strong hands-on ML/AI engineering experience with product judgment, curiosity, and a pragmatic approach to solving complex problems.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, build, and maintain ML/AI systems across knowledge graph intelligence, document intelligence, retrieval, and LLM-powered applications.
  • Build retrieval capabilities that combine structured data, unstructured documents, embeddings, metadata, and graph-based relationships.
  • Contribute to the development of knowledge graph capabilities that support natural-language query, entity linking, and context assembly.
  • Build and improve document processing pipelines for large-scale virtual data rooms, including ingestion, OCR, layout-aware parsing, table extraction, structured fact extraction, and citation-grounded Q&A.
  • Develop hybrid retrieval and reranking systems combining lexical, dense, metadata, and graph-based approaches across large datasets.
  • Build LLM applications using RAG, agent and workflow orchestration, prompt and tool design, structured outputs, and grounding techniques.
  • Develop and maintain evaluation frameworks, including golden sets, automated evaluations, human validation workflows, online metrics, and regression testing.
  • Evaluate foundation models, embedding models, vector stores, and document AI services based on quality, latency, cost, and product requirements.
  • Build cost-efficient ML/AI systems using techniques such as caching, model cascading, tiered processing, and appropriate batch versus real-time processing.
  • Implement permissions-aware retrieval and AI pipelines that respect data access controls and audit requirements.
  • Ensure AI-generated outputs are grounded in and traceable to source evidence.
  • Partner with Full Stack, Platform, Product, and other AI Engineers to integrate shared ML/AI capabilities into products and workflows.
  • Contribute to model fine-tuning and adaptation initiatives where off-the-shelf models do not meet product requirements.
  • Support other engineers through code reviews, technical discussions, and shared engineering standards.
  • Improve retrieval, ranking, generation, and recommendation quality using user feedback, validated outputs, and other product signals.
  • Stay current with developments across LLMs, retrieval, document intelligence, agentic systems, and AI engineering, applying new approaches where they meaningfully improve the platform.

QUALIFICATIONS

SERVICE / PERSONAL SKILLS


  • Strong systems thinker with the ability to design practical ML/AI solutions for complex product and data problems.
  • Clear communicator who can explain ML/AI tradeoffs and model behavior to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Highly collaborative and comfortable working across Product, Engineering, Data, and Investment teams.
  • Execution-focused and pragmatic, with good judgment around build-versus-buy decisions.
  • Passionate about AI and interested in applying it to high-stakes, judgment-heavy domains where accuracy and trust are critical.
  • High-agency builder who is comfortable with ambiguity and enjoys getting close to users and their workflows.

EXPERIENCE

  • 5+ years of professional experience in machine learning, applied AI, software engineering with an ML focus, or ML/AI systems engineering, with experience shipping production systems.
  • Strong experience with retrieval systems, including embeddings, vector search, hybrid retrieval, and reranking.
  • Experience developing LLM applications using RAG, agent or workflow orchestration, prompt and tool design, structured outputs, and grounding.
  • Experience with knowledge graphs or relationship-heavy retrieval, including areas such as entity resolution, graph traversal, or graph-aware context assembly.
  • Experience with document intelligence pipelines, including OCR, parsing, table extraction, and citation-preserving chunking.
  • Experience developing and applying evaluation approaches for ML/AI systems, including automated evaluation, golden datasets, human validation, and regression testing.
  • Understanding of permissions-aware AI systems and access control within retrieval and generation pipelines.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and familiarity with modern ML/AI development frameworks and tooling.
  • Experience with cloud-native ML/AI infrastructure; experience with AWS, FastAPI, or TypeScript is an asset.
  • Understanding of the cost, latency, and quality tradeoffs associated with foundation models and AI infrastructure.
  • Experience with model fine-tuning, training, or adaptation is an asset.
  • Experience in data-rich, judgment-heavy domains such as real estate, finance, asset management, or legal is an asset.
  • Comfortable using AI coding tools and agents to improve engineering productivity.
  • Able to assess AI-generated code critically, understanding when outputs can be trusted and when deeper review is required.
  • Interested in improving AI engineering workflows, tooling, guardrails, and feedback loops over time.

EDUCATION / DESIGNATIONS / LICENSES

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related technical field required, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in a quantitative or ML/AI-related field is preferred.
  • Cloud certifications, including AWS, Azure, or GCP architecture or ML/AI certifications, are considered an asset.

Cash compensation tends to vary based on geography to account for local market conditions and is set to be market competitive. Compensation decisions are based on a number of factors including relative experience, overall years of experience, industry experience, education and designations.

Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Corporate

We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Corporate, you are integral to our company’s award-winning success.

  • Enrich your managerial and organizational talents – from finance, quality, and supply chain to human resources, IT, sales, and strategy

  • Augment your comprehensive skillset with expert training across decision-making, change management, leadership, and business development

  • Obtain 360-degree support throughout your career life cycle, from early-stage to seasoned leader

About the Role

The Trade Compliance Auditor is responsible for auditing customs-related import and export compliance within the United States, Canada and EMEA regions.

This role serves to audit all compliance-related functions in the regions. This role reports to the Audit Manager, Trade Compliance. You will create and maintain trade compliance procedures and requirements to support the growth from an audit perspective.

What You Will Do

  • Responsible for executing against the auditing standards and performance criteria, managing audits.

  • Complete an initial risk assessment of the regional trade compliance operation.

  • Create both a line level audit review and more strategic “deep dive” audit plan.

  • Create a comprehensive audit plan that feeds into the Global Trade Compliance audit strategy.

  • Create regional KPIs based on audit results.

  • Work closely with the Trade Compliance Operations team to communicate findings and follow through until sufficient risk is mitigated.

  • Present regional audit results.

  • Audit to ensure proper customs valuation, classification, country of origin.

  • Planning, scheduling, coordinating, reviewing and reporting on compliance metrics within the trade compliance value chain.

  • Ensure that local risk management frameworks and processes are aligned with global ones and address risks.

  • Work closely within the audit team to ensure cohesiveness across all audit regions.

  • Monitor and audit of regional import and export processes and documentation to ensure compliance with trade laws.

  • Test processes for adherence to Harman’s Trade Compliance Policy, manuals and internal procedures.

  • Prepare audit reports & gap analysis, proposed remediation measures and targeted training to foster continuous improvement across the trade compliance value chain.

  • Monitor to ensure Trade Compliance recordkeeping requirements are followed, including adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOP’s).

  • Identify and integrate ‘best practices’ standards for the organization based on global cooperation.

  • Build partnerships with third-party customs brokerage firms and trade compliance service providers.

What You Need to Be Successful

  • Bachelor’s degree in Trade Compliance or related field.

  • Experience in auditing trade-related functions preferred.

  • 7+ years of experience in Trade Compliance operations.

  • Global/multinational mindset and awareness.

  • Areas of Expertise: Customs compliance; export/import activities; documentation; HTS classification.

  • Experience with US, CA, and EMEA compliance operation

Bonus Points if You Have

  • Customs Broker License (LCB) or Certified Customs Specialist (CCS) credentials

  • Experience with Thomson Reuters OneSource or similar global trade management (GTM) software

  • Expertise with automotive parts and consumer electronics commodities is a plus

  • Multi-cultural awareness and ability to adjust communication accordingly.

What Makes You Eligible

  • Be willing to travel up to 10% domestic and international travel.

  • Be willing to work in an hybrid office environment and/or fully remote, with occasional trips into the office required.

What We Offer

  • Flexible work environment, allowing for full-time remote work globally for positions that can be performed outside a HARMAN or customer location

  • Access to employee discounts on world-class Harman and Samsung products (JBL, HARMAN Kardon, AKG, etc.)

  • Extensive training opportunities through our own HARMAN University

  • Competitive wellness benefits

  • Tuition reimbursement

  • “Be Brilliant” employee recognition and rewards program

  • An inclusive and diverse work environment that fosters and encourages professional and personal development

Pay Transparency
$ 78,750 - $ 115,500

Dependent on the position offered, other forms of compensation are also available, such as bonuses or commission.

While the above range is a reasonable estimate of the wage range for this position, please note the disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographical differential associated with the location where the position may be filled.

HARMAN is interested in the health and wellbeing of you and your family and offers a range of benefits designed to support your needs for holistic wellbeing. Benefits and perks may vary depending on the nature of your employment with HARMAN, and may include paid vacation and holidays, paid sick leave, volunteer leave, and paid bonding and care giver leave. Employees may also be eligible to participate in comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, fertility support and adoption assistance, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement savings plan with employer match, short and long term disability coverage, life insurance, and more.
About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology
Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.
Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.
If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!

No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. Job Description:

ICAM Data Engineer – Enterprise Reporting & Power BI Visualization

GDIT has an opportunity for a Data Engineer focused on designing, building, and optimizing Power BI reporting solutions that support enterprise Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) analytics. This role centers on transforming complex identity and entitlement datasets into intuitive, high‑value dashboards that enable leadership insights, compliance reporting, access governance visibility, and Zero Trust metrics. While the primary responsibility is Power BI dataset and report development, the role requires a working understanding of upstream ETL processes.


This is a fully remote position.


Meaningful Work and Personal Impact:
The ideal candidate is highly skilled in Power BI and proficient at turning raw data into meaningful visual narratives. You will work closely with data engineers, IGA operations, cybersecurity analysts, and mission stakeholders to ensure identity data is accurately represented and aligned with reporting needs.


Your work will directly influence enterprise decision-making, audit readiness, access risk analytics, certification performance metrics, and enterprise security posture.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and optimize Power BI dashboards, reports, and datasets supporting identity lifecycle, entitlements, access certifications, joiner/mover/leaver activities, and compliance workflows.
  • Create and maintain semantic models, data relationships, DAX measures, and reusable reporting components.
  • Partner with ETL engineers to understand the Azure Synapse data pipelines producing parquet datasets from SailPoint SQL sources.
  • Validate that incoming parquet datasets contain complete, accurate, and appropriately structured data needed for reporting.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather reporting requirements, design prototypes, refine KPIs, and ensure dashboards support mission needs.
  • Establish data quality validation checks and refresh monitoring to ensure accurate and timely reporting outputs.
  • Work with IGA, cybersecurity, and operations teams to align reporting with governance, audit, and Zero Trust requirements.
  • Document semantic models, business logic, data lineage, and visualization standards for enterprise use.
  • Support continuous improvement by recommending enhancements to datasets, transformations, and visualization techniques.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Active Secret Clearance at minimum. Interim Secret Clearances are not allowed.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in a related technical discipline and 8 yrs experience, or the equivalent combination of education, technical certifications or training, or work experience.
  • DoD 8140 certification (Security+ CE or higher)

Required Skills/Knowledge:

  • Strong hands-on experience designing Power BI dashboards and semantic models
  • Proficiency with DAX, Power Query, data profiling, and visualization best practices
  • Understanding of relational SQL concepts and ability to read/interpret upstream data structures
  • Familiarity with Azure Synapse, data lakes, and parquet datasets (high-level understanding sufficient)
  • Ability to partner with ETL developers to ensure dataset readiness and alignment with reporting needs
  • Strong communication skills for explaining complex data relationships to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience documenting reports, models, and data flows

Desired Skills/Knowledge:

  • Familiarity with DoD identity ecosystems, authoritative identity governance, and enterprise ICAM modernization efforts
  • Understanding of identity governance metrics, role/entitlement models, access reviews, and certification reporting
  • Exposure to Python, Spark, SQL, or data transformation scripts
  • Familiarity with CI/CD practices for Power BI deployment pipelines

JOIN THE LMI TEAM

Numbers matter. People matter. Every paycheck matters.

Lighting Maintenance Inc. (LMI) seeks a detail-driven, part-time Payroll Specialist to manage complex, deadline-sensitive payroll processes across our electrical service, construction, and roadway operations. The position requires construction payroll knowledge, exceptional document control, and the ability to work confidently in ComputerEase/Deltek and prevailing-wage reporting systems.

What You Will Own

  • Payroll Processing & Employee Records: Prepare, process, and verify each scheduled payroll cycle for hourly and salaried employees across applicable locations and jurisdictions. Import or enter approved time, overtime, paid leave, adjustments, and job-related labor allocations; research discrepancies before payroll is finalized.
  • ComputerEase, Deltek & Job Costing: Set up and maintain construction jobs, job numbers, project identifiers, labor categories, cost codes, and payroll-related job information in ComputerEase. Use Deltek ComputerEase software services to review time and labor allocations, process payroll-related transactions, and support payroll-to-job-cost accuracy.
  • Prevailing Wage & Certified Payroll Compliance: Prepare, verify, and submit certified payroll reports and required prevailing-wage forms for covered public works projects within contract and agency deadlines. Use LCPtracker to enter labor details, complete certified payroll submissions, track acknowledgments or rejections, and correct exceptions.
  • Payroll Accuracy, Audits & Controls: Audit payroll files, registers, employee setup, direct deposits, earnings, deductions, tax settings, and supporting approvals for completeness and accuracy. Reconcile payroll taxes, employee withholdings, benefit deductions, garnishments, net pay, and employer liabilities to reports and accounting records.

What You Bring

  • At least 3 years of hands-on payroll administration, preferably in construction, electrical contracting, or a multi-job environment.
  • Practical knowledge of ComputerEase/Deltek payroll and job setup, or closely comparable construction ERP experience; direct experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience preparing certified payroll and prevailing-wage documentation; working knowledge of LCPtracker strongly preferred.
  • Ability to review payroll taxes, deductions, direct deposits, reconciliations, wage-and-hour records, and complex payroll files.
  • Strong Excel and reporting skills, careful confidentiality, dependable deadlines, and ability to communicate across field and office teams.

Maryland Pay Transparency Disclosure

In accordance with Maryland state law regarding wage range transparency (Maryland Labor and Employment § 3-304.2), Lighting Maintenance Inc. is providing the good-faith compensation range and a general description of benefits and other compensation associated with this position. The disclosed range reflects the compensation LMI reasonably expects to pay at the time of posting.

Pay range: $30–$35 per hour

Benefits: Health, Dental, Vision, 401K, Legal Sheild, ERP, & BenefitsHub

Equal Employment Opportunity

LMI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to protected characteristics. Reasonable accommodations are available during the application process.

Salary: $30.00 - $35.00

raw.description:
Introductie

Ben jij een gediplomeerd apothekersassistent met oog voor kwaliteit, processen en samenwerking? Zoek je een veelzijdige functie waarin je farmaceutische zorg combineert met coördinatie, innovatie en digitale zorg? Dan is deze rol bij Wellis Pharmacy iets voor jou!

In deze functie werk je volledig remote, in een digitaal team dat farmaceutische zorg verleent aan cliënten door heel Nederland.

Over Wellis

Wellis is een snelgroeiende healthtech scale-up die één van de meest traditionele sectoren opnieuw uitvindt: de apotheek. Wat nog maar kort geleden begon, is inmiddels uitgegroeid tot een winstgevend Europees bedrijf met tienduizenden klanten — en we staan pas aan het begin.

Door medische expertise te combineren met technologie en data maken we de zorg slimmer, efficiënter en persoonlijker. We richten ons op thema’s zoals gewichtsbeheersing, leefstijlbegeleiding en medicatie op maat.

Bij Wellis sluit je je aan bij een jong, ambitieus team dat snel schakelt, conventies doorbreekt en bouwt met impact. We creëren een omgeving waar professionals zich thuis voelen: met korte communicatielijnen, veel eigenaarschap en de energie van een organisatie die hard groeit.

Over de rol

Als Online Apothekersassistent ben jij de verbindende schakel tussen cliënten, apothekers en het logistieke team. Je zorgt dat alles soepel verloopt: van intake tot medicatieverstrekking. Je combineert klantgericht contact met procesmatig inzicht en kwaliteitsbewust werken — volledig digitaal, vanuit huis.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • Cliëntcontact & farmaceutische zorg: uitvoeren van telefonische intakes, beantwoorden van vragen via telefoon, e-mail en chat.

  • Dossierbeheer: controleren en aanvullen van cliëntendossiers, bewaken van medicatieveiligheid en signaleren van bijzonderheden.

  • Samenwerking met apothekers: afstemmen over recepten en afwijkingen, zorgen voor correcte documentatie volgens wet- en regelgeving.

  • Procescoördinatie: ondersteunen van de logistieke processen op afstand en meedenken over verbeteringen in workflow en kwaliteit.

  • Kwaliteitsbewaking: bijdragen aan het borgen van procedures en meewerken aan optimalisatie van digitale zorgprocessen.

Requirements

Wie ben jij

  • Diploma MBO-4 Apothekersassistent, dokterassistent of verpleegkunde.

  • Minimaal 5 jaar werkervaring als apothekersassistent, doktersassistent of verpleegkundige.

  • Affiniteit met digitale zorg en ervaring met werken in online systemen.

  • Communicatief sterk, klantgericht en nauwkeurig.

  • Vloeiend Duits en (Nederlands of Engels)

  • Zelfstandig, verantwoordelijk en organisatorisch sterk.

  • Proactief en in staat om verbeteringen aan te dragen.

  • Beschikbaar voor minimaal 24 uur/week

Wat bieden wij

  • Een volledig remote functie met veel autonomie en flexibiliteit.

  • Marktconform salaris volgens CAO Apotheken, inclusief pensioen.

  • Flexibele werktijden tussen 08:00 en 23:00 uur (maandag t/m zondag).

  • Werken binnen een enthousiast en deskundig team dat digitale zorg vormgeeft.

  • Ruimte voor professionele ontwikkeling en persoonlijke groei.

  • De mogelijkheid tot volledig flexibel remote werken, zodat werk en privé in balans blijven;

  • De mogelijkheid om meer te werken en vrije tijd op te bouwen of uit te laten keren;

  • Meerdere leuke teamuitjes;

  • Hele leuke collega's :)

Hiring Proces

  • Sollicitatie – Stuur je CV en motivatie via onze website.

  • Kennismaking – Kort online gesprek met HR om jouw ervaring en motivatie te bespreken.

  • Inhoudelijk gesprek – Met onze apotheker en coördinator over de inhoud van de functie.

  • Finale kennismaking – Met het management, om te kijken of er een goede match is.

Als je vragen hebt, neem contact op met

Highlights

Een veelzijdige, volledig remote rol waarin je jouw farmaceutische kennis combineert met digitale zorg en procescoördinatie — met ruimte om door te groeien in een snelgroeiende organisatie.

raw.excerpt: About Us:STACK is a leading provider of cloud-based construction estimating and takeoff software solutions, committed to helping businesses transform through innovative solutions.
raw.description:
About Us:

STACK is a leading provider of cloud-based construction estimating and takeoff software solutions, committed to helping businesses transform through innovative solutions. We pride ourselves on fostering a collaborative, dynamic environment where team members have the opportunity to grow and make a real impact.

About the Role:

The Senior Director of Revenue Operations will lead the strategy, processes, technology, and data behind STACK's revenue teams, with a focus on building a signal-led go-to-market motion that helps us attract prospects, grow accounts, and retain customers. This role turns buying, usage, and partner signals into clear, timely action for our revenue teams. Our Senior Director of Revenue Operations will report to the Chief Growth Officer, lead the Revenue Operations team, and work collaboratively with the Revenue, Product, and Finance teams.

Your Most Important Initiatives:

  • Own the revenue operations strategy and roadmap, aligning sales, account management, marketing, partnerships, product, and customer success around shared KPIs and a signal-led go-to-market motion
  • Build and lead a signal-led revenue engine that captures and unifies buying signals (product usage, website and content engagement, third-party intent, partner and ecosystem overlap, and firmographic or hiring changes) into a single view of account readiness
  • Design signal-based account scoring, routing, and plays so sales and customer success teams engage the right accounts at the right time, and measure the pipeline and revenue impact of each signal
  • Instrument the product-led funnel, including trial starts, activation, paywall hits, self-serve purchases, and product-qualified lead handoffs to sales, and reconcile e-commerce and rep-sold revenue so self-serve results never hide in reporting gaps
  • Track partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, deal registration, and co-sell attribution
  • Own forecasting, pipeline health, and revenue analytics, and run the operating cadence, including weekly pipeline reviews, forecast calls, QBR packs, and the board metrics deck
  • Build dashboards leaders actually use, explain the "why" behind every number, and flag risks early, such as aging pipeline, slipping close rates, renewal risk, and rep activity gaps
  • Support Customer Success with renewal forecasting, health scoring, churn analysis, and expansion pipeline tracking, and make sure customer lifecycle data flows back into GTM planning
  • Own one source of truth for funnel stage definitions (MQL → SAL → SQO → Pipeline → Closed), conversion math, and attribution rules; enforce data hygiene across duplicates, ownership rules, required fields, and lead routing SLAs; and resolve Sales and Marketing lead disputes with clear rules, not opinions
  • Own the revenue technology stack, including Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, and Pendo, so the systems integrate cleanly and report the same numbers; manage tool rationalization, vendor contracts, and renewals to prevent stack sprawl; and own automation for routing, scoring, alerts, and cross-team handoffs
  • Lead the use of AI across revenue operations, including AI-assisted forecasting, signal detection, account research, and workflow automation, with clear guardrails for data quality, security, and responsible use
  • Build the annual and quarterly revenue plan, including bookings, pipeline coverage, capacity models, and quotas, and partner with Finance on forecasting methodology, ARR reporting, and compensation plan design
  • Design territories, account segmentation, and ICP tiering so coverage matches where the revenue is
  • Run systems and process onboarding for revenue teams, document playbooks, and train teams on new processes and signal-driven workflows, making the right way the easy way for reps
  • Serve as the primary strategic partner between Sales, Account Management, Marketing, Finance, Product, and Operations leadership
  • Lead, hire, and develop the Revenue Operations team, setting clear goals and helping each person perform their best

What You Bring:

  • 8+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or go-to-market operations, including 3+ years leading teams (required)
  • Experience building or scaling a signal-led or intent-based go-to-market motion, such as account scoring, intent data, product usage signals, or partner and ecosystem data (required)
  • Experience operating a product-led or self-serve motion, including trial and activation instrumentation, product-qualified lead handoffs, and reconciling e-commerce with rep-sold revenue (strongly preferred)
  • 5+ years working with Salesforce (required) and other systems like HubSpot, Gong, Pendo, Intercom, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and signal or intent platforms such as Crossbeam, 6sense, or Clay (each ideal)
  • Hands-on experience applying AI in go-to-market operations, such as AI agents and copilots in Salesforce, Gong, or Clay, LLM-based workflows, and prompt design (required)
  • Ability to evaluate AI tools, measure their impact on productivity and pipeline, and drive adoption across revenue teams
  • Experience building annual revenue plans, capacity models, forecasts, territories, quotas, and compensation plans in partnership with Finance
  • Track record of defining and governing funnel stages, attribution rules, and lead routing across Sales and Marketing
  • Strong data and analytics skills; SQL or BI tool experience is a plus
  • B2B SaaS experience required; construction technology experience is a plus
  • Project and change management
  • Strong executive communication (verbal and written)
  • Strong organizational skills, time management, and the ability to prioritize and multi-task

Why Join STACK?

  • Opportunity to work in a fast-paced, growth-oriented, remote-first environment.
  • Async-friendly environment with a focus on ownership and deep work.
  • Be part of a dynamic, supportive team where your contributions are valued.

At STACK, our values shape how we work, collaborate, and serve our customers:

  • Radical Honesty: Communicate directly, respectfully, and transparently—even when conversations are difficult. Give and receive feedback with care.
  • Customer Obsession: Put the customer at the center of every decision. Solve real problems, follow through, and measure success by customer outcomes.
  • Move With Purpose: Take thoughtful action, remain accountable, and own both successes and mistakes. Anticipate what’s next and adapt as you learn.
  • Grow Together: Share knowledge, collaborate across teams, and invest in one another’s development. Celebrate collective wins and treat setbacks as opportunities to learn.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas.

We take into account an individual’s qualifications, skillset, and experience in determining final salary. This role is eligible for health insurance (medical, dental & vision), life insurance, 401(k) & paid time off. The compensation range for this role is around $165k- $220k USD. The actual offer will be at the company’s sole discretion and determined by relevant business considerations, including the final candidate’s qualifications, years of experience, skillset, and geographic location.

raw.description:
EHS Support is a specialty environmental consulting firm that provides solutions to complex environmental, health, and safety challenges across a range of market sectors and industries. With experts located throughout the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, and South Africa, we form long-lasting partnerships with our clients through a culture of excellence, innovation, work ethic, and integrity. We focus on hiring and retaining talented, motivated people who enjoy collaborating with and delivering value to our clients. Our team does more than identify problems— we provide solutions.

Location: Remote, California-Based

Experience: 0-5 Years

As a project-level staff member, you’ll have the opportunity to support a variety of environmental investigation, remediation, and water resources projects in California and beyond. Typical responsibilities include a blend of field and office activities such as environmental investigation fieldwork planning and implementation (e.g., sample collection, monitoring well installation, aquifer testing, etc.); reporting on the results of fieldwork programs, including analysis of laboratory and field-derived datasets to derive conclusions and provide recommendations within project teams and to regulators; remediation implementation support (e.g., groundwater system installation support, soil excavation, in-situ soil and/or groundwater treatments, etc.); and project management support, including proposal development, cost estimating, and subcontractor management.

We believe the fundamentals of consulting are best learned by doing. That’s why we place a strong emphasis on project team integration with a focus on learning about the project lifecycle early on in your career. We get you into in the field so you can understand the ‘why’ behind what we are doing. We also get you involved in work plan and report writing (related to the work you are executing in the field), as well as in cost estimating to arm you with the tools to manage tasks and projects as you gain experience. Ours is a structure that focuses on team building—one that supports both individual and team growth—and not on management structures that limit creativity and flexibility. Here, opportunity and advancement are not dictated by your years of service, but rather your contributions to ensuring EHS Support continues to be a great place to work and a global leader in providing environmental solutions for our clients.

Our approach to career development is focused on providing opportunities to gain experience and develop skills that result in well-rounded consultants. This includes opportunities to be involved in the critical process of scoping, planning, and implementing fieldwork that produces high-quality and reliable data that is essential for sound, scientific decision-making for our clients. What sets us apart is our commitment to ensuring that the individuals involved in collecting that data are also involved in reviewing, evaluating, and reporting on the results. Not only does this provide the opportunity for our team to develop practical critical thinking skills and hone their writing skills, but it ultimately results in better work products for our clients.

Position Requirements

  • B.S. or M.S. degree in geology, hydrogeology, environmental science, or other relevant science degree.
  • Ability to work remotely from a home office
  • Strong writing and communication skills
  • Interest in conducting fieldwork including environmental sampling and contractor oversight
  • Interest to travel out of state and overnight, with the potential for longer work assignments (days to weeks).
  • Travel throughout California and out-of-state anticipated 30%
  • Proficiency in standard Microsoft Office software

Typical Traits for a Successful Career at EHS Support

  • Inquisitiveness and curiosity
  • Willingness to learn new things and gain technical expertise by working on multiple projects and with experts in technical areas of practice
  • Ability to develop and maintain positive relationships with clients and co-workers
  • Ability to think strategically and conceptually, as well as translate strategy into practical and tactical plans 
  • Ability to work independently and seek guidance at key points in the project
  • Willingness to tackle difficult problem

Benefits

  • Generous Vacation Policy
  • Health Benefits (medical, dental, vision)
  • 401k w/matching options
  • Short- & Long-Term Disability
  • Life Insurance
  • Sick Time
  • Bonus Opportunities

Our Principles

  • Strive for excellence, always
  • Be open, honest, and direct
  • Assume good intentions
  • Trust coworkers, leadership, and clients
  • Listen to learn
  • Be accountable for our work
  • Foster teamwork
  • Demonstrate integrity
  • Take pride in one’s work
  • Live your personal values
  • Provide a safe and health work environment that promotes wellness
  • Have fun!

EHS Support is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

Job Description Summary

‎

Leads assigned strategy and transformation workstreams, conducting analysis, developing recommendations, and coordinating execution activities that advance the organization’s strategic priorities. Applies advanced analytical and problem-solving skills to complex organizational and market challenges.

The Strategy and Transformation Consultant works independently with limited supervision. Decisions influence project- and program-level strategic outcomes, and the role sets direction on analytical methodology and approach within assigned workstreams.

‎

How will you make an impact & Requirements

‎

Key Responsibilities• Lead assigned strategy and transformation project workstreams, including situation analysis, hypothesis development, research, and recommendation development.• Conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses — including financial modeling, market research, and operational benchmarking — to support strategic recommendations.• Develop executive-facing materials, including strategy presentations, business case documents, and transformation roadmaps.• Coordinate cross-functional project activities, managing timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder engagement across assigned workstreams.• Identify transformation risks and interdependencies, escalating critical issues and recommending mitigation approaches.• Monitor industry trends, competitive dynamics, and organizational performance to inform strategic analysis.• Guide and review work of developing Strategy and Transformation staff on assigned analytical tasks.
